articleTitle: Frequency Support from Multiple Utility-Scale Grid-Forming Battery Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy sources has led to challenges related to frequency stability in low-inertia power systems. Utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESSs) based on grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) inverters are being explored to enhance networks’ resilience. For example, by providing new frequency control ancillary services (FCAS) such as fast frequency response (FFR) and simulated inertia. However, only a limited number of delivered utility-scale BESS projects with GFM technology have been reported, while GFM for microgrid or small island applications have been well studied, it is rare in large-scale power grid studies. This paper studies the FFR and simulated inertia services of utility-scale GFL and GFM BESSs. The dynamic study is performed by using an existing large-scale power network with two renewable penetration levels. The theoretical differences between a set of BESSs with GFL and GFM inverters have been validated based on simulation studies for critical generation trip events. The results demonstrate that the simulated inertia of GFM-BESSs benefits the FFR service in terms of frequency nadir, power reserve and the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF). This research contributes to the appropriate assimilation of new frequency control mechanisms of utility-scale BESSs towards converter dominated grids.

articleTitle: Improving Virtual Synchronous Generator Control in Microgrids Using Fuzzy Logic Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generators (VSG) are designed to mimic the inertia and damping characteristics of synchronous generators (SG), which can improve the frequency response of a microgrid. Unlike synchronous generators whose inertia and damping are restricted by the physical characteristics of the SG, VSG parameters can be more flexibly controlled to adapt to different disturbances. This paper therefore proposes a fuzzy logic controller designed to adaptively set the parameters of the VSG during a frequency event to ensure an improved frequency nadir and rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) response. The proposed control method is implemented and tested on the power inverter for the battery energy storage system of the Banshee Microgrid Feeder 2 test case system using MATLAB/SIMULINK. The effectiveness of the adaptive control scheme is validated by comparing its performance with a constant parameter VSG, a virtual inertia only fuzzy controller, and an inertial-less inverter control.

articleTitle: An Optimal Operation Strategy for Integrated Energy-Logistics System in Green Port
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Increasing penetration of renewable energy sources in the green ports calls for more flexible regulation approaches. This paper proposes an optimal operation strategy for the integrated energy-logistics system to minimize the operation cost of a green-port multi-energy microgrid. A comprehensive model for hybrid hydrogen-battery-thermal energy storage is established for the operation optimization of the emission-free energy system. A coordinated demand management approach for the thermal and electrical loads of reefer containers is developed to enhance the flexibility of logistics system. Considering the demand managements of the logistics system, the life degradation properties of energy storages and the operation costs of the renewable energy sources, the whole optimization model is formulated as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Numerical simulations are carried out to verify the merits of the proposed operation strategy.

articleTitle: New Technology of the Substation Green Construction under the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the process of electric energy transmission, the substation undertakes the task of adjusting voltage levels. As an important part of the power transmission and transformation projects, massive carbon emissions are generated from the production and construction to the waste recycling stage, and the new technology for green construction of substations is one of the important means to achieve carbon reduction. In this paper, based on the carbon emission sources of the substation civil construction, the technical characteristics, application scenes, advantages and disadvantages of four new green construction technologies are analyzed.

articleTitle: Offshore Wind Power Development and Transmission Technology Research in Shandong
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, with the further improvement of offshore wind power technology and construction level, and the continuous improvement of electricity price policy, China's offshore wind power has developed rapidly. As a major coal consuming Province, Shandong has great pressure on the transformation of energy structure. Using the abundant wind energy resources along the coast of Shandong to speed up the development of new energy industries such as wind power can fundamentally optimize the energy structure and reduce coal consumption. The large-scale development and adoption of large- capacity wind turbines in offshore is an important way to improve the economy of offshore wind power transmission. This paper analyzes three different transmission schemes of offshore wind power AC transmission, conventional DC transmission and flexible DC transmission. The technical and economic comparison of three different transmission technology is presented.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Framework for Power System Load Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy and power electronic devices, the frequency fluctuation of the power system will increase sharply, the inertia will decrease significantly, the damping characteristics will be poor, and the frequency adjustment ability needs to be improved. In this paper, a DRL (deep reinforcement learning) based framework is propsed to solve the LFC (load frequency control) problem for power system. This paper first introduces the model of LFC and basic description of DRL. Then the flow of twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) algorithm and a general framework for load frequency control. Finally, the proposed method is verified through a single area LFC test system. The implementation demonstrates that the proposed method is effective in LFC problem.

articleTitle: Electricity and Carbon-aware Task Scheduling in Geo-distributed Internet Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Besides the enormous power consumption, carbon emission from data centers is also a concern for cloud service providers (CSPs). Based on cloud computing technology, the spatial-temporal transfer of workloads between geographically distributed internet data centers (IDCs) gives CSPs the potential to reduce their carbon footprint. However, workloads in real-world production are highly heterogeneous, which vary in resource demand, duration et al. Without ignoring the workload heterogeneity, we proposed an integer linear programming formulation of the task scheduling problem for geo-distributed IDCs. Extensive numerical studies are performed using real task information, electricity price, and marginal emission rate. Results show that CSP can better meet emission reduction demand and optimize its electricity expenses by spatial-temporal task scheduling.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Power Supply Network Topology Identification Based on Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The automatic identification of the topology of low-voltage power supply network is the basis for the intelligence of low-voltage distribution network. The widespread installation of smart meters and the development of intelligent remote meter reading technology have brought a large amount of power grid operation data, providing a new path for topology identification of low-voltage power supply networks. In this paper, a topology identification method of low-voltage power supply network based on measurement data is proposed. Firstly, the feature extraction by wavelet transform is performed on the power sequence of the branch node, and the connection of branch nodes is obtained according to the power value and the similarity of the feature power sequence. Then the position of user nodes is obtained by using the idea of 0-1 integer quadratic programming. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method for complex topological structures is verified by an example of 12 branches and 114 users.

articleTitle: Inertia Characteristic Analysis and Inertia Estimation of New Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As more and more renewable energy generations and distributed energy sources are connected to the power system, the characteristics of power system inertia have changed. In order to realize the stable operation of new energy power system, the inertia of new energy power system needs to be analyzed and evaluated. The article firstly defines a new definition of system inertia, which contains different forms of inertia and describes each inertia in detail; then proposes a power system inertia evaluation method based on kinetic energy theorem and a disturbance time location method based on wavelet transform, which does not need to measure the rate of the change of frequency (ROCOF). In addition, the distribution characteristics of power system inertia is studied and the inertia distribution of the system is visualized to provide more reference information for the safe, stable and flexible operation of the new energy power system. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation in the IEEE 39-bus system in DigSILENT/PowerFactory environment.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Operation Method of Integrated Energy System in Ecological Park Considering Carbon Footprint
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Reducing carbon emission is vital for the ecological park construction. A low-carbon operation strategy of integrated energy system (IES) in eco-parks is proposed in this paper. The accurate quantification of carbon emissions of different power generation equipment is executed in the way of carbon footprint. The participation of IES in the carbon trading market is considered, and a stepped carbon trading mechanism is used to guide the IES in eco-parks to control its carbon emissions. The combined heat and power (CHP) unit with adjustable thermoelectric ratio is introduced to improve the operation economy of the ecological park. A low-carbon operation model is established, with the operation target of minimizing the operation cost, including the carbon emission cost, electricity and gas purchase cost and cost of abandoning wind power and photovoltaic. The results of numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Improved Singular Perturbation Based Model Reduction of PMSG Integrated Power Systems for Large Disturbance Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With more and more wind farms connected to the power grid, it becomes more and more difficult to analyze the large disturbance fault of power system based on the detailed model of wind turbine. This paper propose an improved method of reduced order model of wind turbine based on singular perturbation theory. Firstly, the linearized model is obtained by the state trajectory of wind turbine after transient fault. The multi time scale characteristics of wind turbine are divided by dominant degree analysis, and the model is simplified by ignoring the fast dynamic variables. Time domain simulation results show that this method has the advantages of high accuracy and can capture the dynamic response of wind turbine after large disturbance fault.

articleTitle: Overview of Electric Vehicle Charging Standards
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the introduction of the "new infrastructure" policy, the construction of electric vehicle charging piles has been accelerated in China. However, due to the current inconsistency of charging standards in different cities, the charging convenience and large-scale development of electric vehicles have been limited. This paper introduces the existing electric vehicle charging standards, compares and analyzes the differences of charging standards at home and abroad, and discusses the future development trend of charging standards in details.

articleTitle: PEM Fuel Cell Thermal Management Strategy Based on Multi-model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Temperature is a key factor affecting the efficiency and safety of proton exchange membrane fuel cells. It is especially important to keep the fuel cell stack temperature stable under the operating conditions where the load current changes frequently. Firstly, a nonlinear model of the stack and cooling system is developed for a 50kW commercial fuel cell system. Then, a series of local models are established at different operating points to accurately describe the nonlinear characteristics of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) system. Finally, a multi-model predictive control method based on an adaptive switching strategy is proposed. The simulation results show that the temperature overshoot can be controlled within 1K in the operating range of 50-200A. Compared with the PID and model predictive control(MPC) methods, the multi-model predictive control(MMPC) method has better robustness.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on CEEMDAN and Parallel CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of short-term Wind Power Prediction (WPP), a novel short-term WPP method based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN), Fine-To-Coarse (FTC), and parallel CNN-LSTM is proposed in this paper. In the first stage, the CEEMDAN signal decomposition method is introduced to decompose wind speed sequence in different height into IMF components and the FTC signal reconstruct method is used to reorganize IMF components into a high frequency component, a low frequency component, and a trend component. In the second stage, a novel parallel CNN-LSTM neural network architecture is proposed as WPP model, in which the input feature consists both three frequency components derived in the first stage and the original wind speed sequence in different height. The results show that the proposed method is an effective short-term WPP method which improves the prediction accuracy.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Prediction

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling for Park-based Load Aggregator with Multiple Demand Response Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The growth of load demand and the rapid development of renewable energy sources have brought insufficient supply and renewable consumption problems to the power grid. Demand response loads bring an effective way to solve these problems. Through the market mechanisms, such loads are guided to change their electricity consumption behavior to reduce the peak pressure of electricity consumption and consume renewable energy. In this paper, various types of loads in the park are assembled into load aggregators, which jointly participate in load-side demand response. A demand response optimization dispatching model with tariff and subsidy incentives is established to maximize revenue. The changes in various loads, energy storage, and new energy consumption before and after participation in demand response are compared, and the effectiveness of the model is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Collaborative Planning Method of Source, Network, Load and Energy Storage in Distribution Network Considering Adjustable Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper propose a multi-objective collaborative planning method of source, network, load and energy storage in distribution network considering adjustable load. Firstly, aiming at the minimum annual comprehensive cost of the distribution network and the maximum installed capacity of distributed new energy, a multi-objective collaborative planning model of the distribution network source, network, load and energy storage considering the adjustable load is established. Secondly, the second-order cone relaxation technique is used to convert the model to convex, and the ε − constraint method is used to solve the model with multiple objectives. Finally, case studies are carried out on the IEEE 24-bus distribution network to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Research on Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling of Wind-photovoltaic-thermal-energy Storage Combined Power Generation System Based on Opportunity-constrained Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reasonably quantify the influence of wind and photovoltaic power output uncertainty on optimal scheduling, a day-ahead optimal scheduling model of wind-photovoltaic-thermal-energy storage combined power generation system considering opportunity-constrained programming is established. The model takes the system operation cost, which contains the operation cost of thermal power units, the penalty cost of pollutants, the operation cost of energy storage system and the penalty cost of new energy curtailment, as the optimization goal. In order to characterize the influence of wind and photovoltaic power prediction errors on the optimal scheduling, an opportunity-constrained programming method is used to calculate the rotating reserve capacity of the system in each period. The simulation calculation is performed on a typical day. The results show that the established model can realize the multi-energy complementary operation of the wind-photovoltaic-thermal-energy storage system. By reasonably quantifying the influence of the wind and photovoltaic power prediction error on the optimal scheduling, the system operation cost can be reduced, which verifies the validity of the model.

Author Keywords: wind-photovoltaic-thermal-energy storage combined power generation system
wind and photovoltaic power prediction error

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Transient Equivalent Circuit of Grounding Fault in Distribution Network with Neutral Point Grounded Through Low Resistance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: There are three main neutral grounding modes in medium voltage distribution network: neutral ungrounded mode, neutral grounded through arc suppression coil mode and neutral grounded through low resistance mode. When the neutral point is grounded through low resistance in distribution network, the fault current is small in case of high resistance grounding fault. The sensitivity of using steady-state electrical quantity to realize protection is poor. In fact, the transient fault current in the initial stage of fault occurrence is large, which can be used as an effective protection characteristic quantity. Transient equivalent circuit is the main tool of fault transient analysis, so it is necessary to accurately model the transient equivalent circuit. Firstly, the transient equivalent circuit of single-phase grounding fault in low-resistance grounding distribution network is established. Secondly, the transient and steady-state zero sequence currents of each outgoing line and neutral point are theoretically calculated, and their distribution laws are summarized. Finally, the correctness of the transient equivalent circuit and the theoretical calculation results are proved by simulation in MATLAB. This paper provides theoretical support for the grounding fault protection of low-resistance grounding distribution network based on transient electrical quantity.

Author Keywords: neutral point grounded through low resistance

articleTitle: Stochastic Robust Hybrid Energy Storage System Sizing for Shipboard Microgrid Decarbonization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a sizing method to determine the respective rated power/energy capacities of different types of ESSs in uncertain navigation speed scenarios. The proposed model is hierarchically formulated as two sequential sub-problems: 1) a two-stage stochastic robust programming to determine the power/energy requirements of hybrid ESS (HESS), and 2) an optimization-based sizing strategy to determine the respective power/energy capacities of each type of ESS. The first sub-problem of stochastic robust programming is reformulated by a series of convexification process. A ship case with 2 diesel generators and 1 fuel cell is studied to show the validity of proposed method.

articleTitle: Wind Power Forecasting Based on Prophet Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of wind power forecasting, a wind power time series forecasting model based on Prophet al-gorithm is established. The wind power data of a region from 2018 to 2020 are used for forecasting, and compared with the long short- term memory neural network forecasting model to explore the feasibility of the model in wind power forecasting.

Author Keywords: the long short-term memory neural network forecasting model

articleTitle: Data-driven Predictive Control for Grid-forming Converter Stability Enhancement in Island Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Microgrids on the islands integrate multiple types of renewable energy resources, e.g., PV, tidal energy, and wave energy, to support local power consumption. The grid-forming converters equipped with battery energy storage systems play a vital role in regulating the system frequency and voltage in island microgrids while smoothing the fluctuations of these renewable energy resources. However, for grid-forming converters, there exists a high risk of transient instability in the case of large disturbances. In this work, a data-driven predictive control strategy is proposed to enhance the stability of the grid-forming converter in island microgrids. By replacing the mathematical model predictor with a two-layer gate recurrent unite (GRU) neural network, the data-driven predictive control strategy can precisely predict the virtual power angle trajectory. Furthermore, the proposed control strategy is capable of driving participating grid-forming converters to follow the center of inertia, which can effectively enhance the convergence performance and avoid significant power oscillations. Extensive case studies are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed DPC strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Shortage in India and Enlightenment on Power Gird Development
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Since the second half of 2021, the world has seen prominent contradiction between energy supply and demand, rising energy prices, and energy shortages first in Europe and then around the globe. From the end of September to the end of October, many parts of India were plagued by supply and demand imbalances and some suffered long power outages, which impaired economic recovery to some extent. This paper screened out the basic situation of tight power supply and demand in India, analyzed the direct reasons such as higher-than-expected power demand and insufficient power supply capacity, as well as the deep-seated reasons such as power supply structure, power grid construction and operation, power system and mechanism, judged the impact and development trend, carried out international comparison and enlightenment analysis, and put forward relevant suggestions for the development of China’s power grid.

articleTitle: Hybrid Portable and Stationary Energy Storage Systems with Battery Charging and Swapping Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As a key technology for renewable energy integration, battery storage is expected to facilitate the low-carbon transition of energy systems. The wider applications of battery storage systems call for smarter and more flexible deployment models. Here we propose a hybrid energy storage system (HESS) model that flexibly coordinates both portable energy storage systems (PESSs) and stationary energy storage systems (SESSs) in power grids. PESSs are batteries and power conversion systems loaded on vehicles that travel between grid nodes with locational marginal price (LMP) difference to alleviate grid congestion. Meanwhile, they integrate renewable energy by charging and discharging at these nodes or swapping (part of) batteries with SESSs. We introduce an on-demand spatiotemporal decision-making model for HESS and analyze the optimal operation strategy and economic benefits of HESS in the case study. The results show that, compared with the total revenue and battery degradation of SESS and PESS alone, the spatiotemporal arbitrage revenue of HESS could increase by up to 6.4% with the amount of battery degradation decreased by 19.6%, in some representative operating periods.

articleTitle: Review on RUL Prediction Methods for Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Prediction of Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of lithium-ion battery is important contents of battery management. It is of great significance to prolong battery life and ensure the reliability of battery system. Researchers all over the world have done a lot of research on battery RUL prediction and proposed a variety of methods. This paper first introduces the definition of RUL, then classifies the main methods into three kinds. This paper also introduces and compares these methods. Finally, the challenges of lithium-ion battery RUL prediction methods are summarized, and the future research direction is proposed.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Scenario Generation Method Based on Order-Preserving Wasserstein Distance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration rate of renewable energy generation, how to describe the uncertainty of renewable energy output is a key problem to overcome these challenges. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a day-ahead scenario generation method for renewable energy based on order-preserving Wasserstein distance. In this method, order-preserving Wasserstein distance is used as the loss function of discriminator to design a network structure suitable for day-ahead scenario generation. Through the game training of a conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN), the mapping between noise distribution and day-ahead scenario set under the prediction condition can be learned by the generator. In this paper, actual wind power data (including forecasting and actual generation data) are used to test the proposed method, and the results show that the proposed model can more accurately describe the day-ahead wind power uncertainty.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of Virtual Synchronous Generator Integrated Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, traditional wind turbines lack independent frequency support and voltage support capabilities, which is not conducive to the transient stability of wind power system. In order to effectively improve the wind power capacity of the system, the virtual synchronous generator technology is applied to the PMSG bus to provide the necessary frequency support and voltage support for the PMSG. Firstly, the mathematical model of PMSG and VSG station-level system is established. Then, the transient stability of the station-level system is analyzed. Finally, the system is incorporated into the 4-machine 2-area system to verify the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Black Start of Multiple Mobile Emergency Energy Storage Vehicles without Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The extreme weather and natural disasters can cause outage of power grid while employing mobile emergency energy storage vehicle (MEESV) could be a potential solution, especially for critical loads in disaster relief. In such situation, the speed to build up the MEESVs system is a key point, which requires starting the emergency power networks in a simplest way. That means fewer knowledge of loads and avoiding interaction of communication are expected during starting up the MEESVs system. For these reasons, black start for the MEESVs, with no communication, is core technique for building up a stable emergency power supply system. In this paper, a communicationless serial black start control strategy is introduced, which is composed of pre-synchronization and current-limiting strategy. The proposed strategy can black start MEESVs without communication, so that to establish a stable power supply system quickly and reliably. Simulation and experimental results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Instrument Transformer Calibration Method Based on Synchrophasor Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Instrument transformers with deviation will affect the measurement accuracy of Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs). It causes problems for various applications that based on PMU data. This paper presents a method for calibrating instrument transformers using synchrophasor measurement data and system model, while the validity of the proposed method is verified via simulation. It is shown that the proposed method can evaluate the instrument transformers and the Ratio Correction Factors (RCFs) of instrument transformers can be calculated. The proposed approach is robust to line parameter uncertainty and system noise.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on Deep Bayesian Active Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a deep Bayesian active learning (DBAL)-based scheme for online transient stability assessment in power systems. The Bayesian neural network (BNN) is used to predict the transient stability status while adaptively evaluating the predicting confidence by the posterior probability. The uncertainty-based active learning strategy is used to select the most informative samples to maximize the predicting performance of the BNN-based transient stability predictor while reducing the computational burden of time-domain simulation-based stability assessment for sample labeling. Case study on the IEEE 39-bus system demonstrates that the proposed scheme can achieve both the predicting accuracy and the data efficiency.

articleTitle: A Bi-Level Optimization Model for Independent System Operator Considering Price-Based Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The participation of demand response in the regulation of the power system is an effective supplement to the regulation on the generation side. In order to fully tap the load-side demand response potential and maximize the benefits of the power system and the load, this paper designs a bi-level optimization model that considers the interaction between the independent system operator and the price-based demand response load. Taking the minimum operator's comprehensive cost and the maximum load response benefit as the objectives of the upper and lower levels of the model respectively, the constructed bi-level optimization problem is transformed into an easy-to-solve linear programming problem through the KKT condition and the big M method. The results of the calculation example show that the price-based demand response load can adjust its own electricity consumption according to the change of the real-time electricity price. After the system operator adjusts the electricity price for optimal scheduling, both the operator and the response load can realize cost savings.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptive Control Strategy of Battery Energy Storage for Power Grid Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to fully play the role of battery energy storage (BES) in primary frequency regulation, this paper proposes a self-adaptive control strategy of BES for power grid primary frequency regulation. Firstly, an equivalent model of BES participation in grid primary frequency regulation is established, followed by analyzing the characteristics of virtual droop control and virtual inertia control in the frequency regulation process, and introducing a self-adaptive factor considering system frequency deviation and system frequency deviation rate based on fuzzy logic control. Finally, a regional frequency regulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink software to compare different strategies under load step disturbance and load continuous disturbance respectively, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Review of Load Forecasting Methods for Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As a major tool for reducing carbon emissions, the ownership of electric vehicles is increasing year by year. When EV numbers reach a certain level, it is equivalent to a huge load randomly connected to the network, bringing new challenges to the daily monitoring and management of EV charging stations. Accurate load prediction methods for EV charging stations with high reliability are the basis for ensuring safe operation of charging stations and supporting the planning decisions of new construction and expansion of charging infrastructure. In this paper, the charging station load prediction methods are divided into three categories: charging station angle prediction, unsupervised learning charging load prediction and supervised learning charging load prediction, and the representative studies on load prediction for EV charging stations in these categories are reviewed respectively.

articleTitle: Transaction Path-based Market Clearing and Pricing Mechanism Design in Interregional Power Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Interregional transactions have effectively promoted the consumption of renewable energy and optimized the allocation of resources. The transaction path-based model is proposed, used for interregional transaction market clearing. Although this model can figure out the occupation of transmission line capacity corresponding to the transaction between nodes, it cannot address the pricing problem effectively. This paper improves the transaction path-based model and proposes a pricing method for interregional transaction, considering the principle of locational marginal price adopted in the European market and PJM market. The physical meaning of locational marginal price is analyzed, and the transaction path-based model is adjusted, figuring out the corresponding constraints to solve the Lagrange multipliers, which can be used for market pricing. Case studies based on an IEEE 9-node system prove the effectiveness of the proposed improved transaction path-based model. This model can create incentive compatible pricing scheme.

articleTitle: Complementary Operation Optimization of Multi-energy Power Systems Considering Water Sensitivity of Pumped Storage and Deep Regulation of Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As penetration of wind power and photovoltaic increasing, security and stability of power grid have been influenced. Renewable energy is usually characterized by anti-peak shaving and fluctuation, which thus may result in power imbalance. In this case, thermal units are usually utilized to provide regulating power. However, deep peak regulation would have a negative effect on thermal power units, which can be alleviated by pumped storage. Given this background, this paper presents an optimal dispatching model for the power system with pumped storage, wind power, photovoltaic and thermal power units involved. Firstly, the operation model of thermal units is proposed to formulate the extra operational cost caused by deep peak regulation. Pumped storage model considering water head sensitivity characteristics is established as well. Then a day-ahead optimal power flow model is proposed including deep-peak-regulation thermal units and head-sensitive pumped storage. Finally, the IEEE-39 test system is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Coordinated Constant Voltage Control Method Considering Power Margin for Parallel Bidirectional Power Converters in AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Parallel bidirectional power converters (BPCs) play an important role in achieving mutual support between AC and DC grids and in improving the power quality. Rather than distributing the steady state transmission power evenly among parallel BPCs, it was identified that optimal distributing the power according to the efficiency curve of each BPC is more beneficial, which can reduce the total steady state power loss of BPCs and can improve the economy of the AC/DC hybrid microgrid. In view of this, this paper proposes an adaptive coordinated constant voltage control method considering power margin for the BPCs. The method can realize the economically optimal power distribution among BPCs in steady state, to improve the economy of system operation. In case of power disturbances, the transient transmission power can be distributed adaptively among BPCs according to the power margin of each BPC, meanwhile ensure the DC area operation with the rated voltage, so as to improve the voltage quality of the system and avoid BPC overload. The effectiveness of the proposed control method is illustrated and the conclusions are verified by simulation and Hardware-in-loop tests.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Scheduling Model for Wind Power Integrated Systems with Data Centers Based on Chance Constrained Goal Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Data centers (DCs) are energy consumers with high electricity demand. Due to their Spatio-Temporal demand response (DR) capabilities, DCs are crucial DR participants. This paper presents a scheduling model for wind power integrated systems with DCs. To maximize the total social welfare, it is considered that the reserve capacity can be flexibly adjusted based on its reference value. Accordingly, a coordinated optimization model based on the chance-constrained goal programming (CCGP) is proposed. To overcome the solving difficulty of the probabilistic chance constraints, a conversion method is adopted in this paper to convert the probabilistic constraints into deterministic forms. Finally, the proposed model is verified on an IEEE 30-bus power system with wind farms. Simulation results prove that DCs’ participation in DR has a positive effect on reducing wind power curtailment and increasing social welfare.

articleTitle: Calculation Method for Maximum Accommodation Capacity of Distributed Photovoltaic in Distribution Network Considering Various Electrical Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the gradual increase of distributed photovoltaic (PV) connected to the distribution network, to promote the consumption of distributed clean energy generation on the basis of maintaining the safe and stable operation of the distribution network, this paper proposes a calculation method for the maximum consumption capacity of distributed PV in the distribution network. Firstly, the fuzzy C-means clustering method is used to construct typical scenarios of PV output to ensure the applicability of the calculation method of photovoltaic accommodation capacity. Secondly, multiple active management (AM) measures existing in the distribution network are modeled, such as on-load voltage regulation, reactive power compensation, control of the battery energy storage system, etc., to promote distributed PV consumption in the distribution network. Then, with the objective function of maximizing the distributed PV accommodation capacity, the calculation model of the distributed PV accommodation capacity in distribution network is established by comprehensively considering various electrical constraints, such as harmonic current and voltage fluctuation constraints. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by an improved IEEE 33-bus system, and the promoting effect of various AM measures on PV consumption is verified.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatch of Distribution Network with Carbon Capture Power Plant Considering Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Carbon capture and storage technology (CCS) and carbon trading mechanism are emerging ways to reduce the carbon emissions. Due to the abundant resources, e.g., demand response, that can be flexibly scheduled in the distribution network, the distribution network has great potential for carbon emission reduction. In order to promote the low-carbon transition of the distribution network, a low-carbon economic dispatch model of the distribution network with the carbon capture power plant considering carbon trading is proposed in this paper. This model introduces a ladder-type carbon trading mechanism and demand response and puts the carbon trading cost in the objective function to cooperate economic and environmental benefits. This problem can be converted into a mixed integer linear programming which is easy to solve by existing solvers. Based on the IEEE 33-bus distribution system, case study shows that the ladder-type carbon trading mechanism can significantly reduce carbon emissions compared with the traditional carbon trading mechanism. Participation of demand response in distribution network dispatch can reduce the total cost.

articleTitle: Immunity Study: Port Impedance Measurement of PMU and PCI testing under EMP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) are critical for the Wide Area Measurement System (WAMS), especially for real-time grid monitoring, disturbance location, and situation awareness. Once they are damaged, the stable operation of the power system will be affected directly and greatly. Therefore, it is urgent and necessary to study their immunity to electromagnetic pulse (EMP) events. In this paper, an effective impedance measurement scheme is proposed for port impedance measurement of PMU. The equivalent non-uniform transmission line model is established to eliminate the impact of the fixture in the de-embedding process. Then circuit of pulsed current generator is established to generate damping sinusoid and double exponential wave applied to the port. Finally, by using measured impedance as a load of the generator, the voltage and current responses of different ports are calculated in the pulsed current injection (PCI) testing simulation. Results show that common-mode impedance is large and differential mode impedance is small. The critical condition will appear in the common mode for voltage and differential mode for current.

articleTitle: Pre-charge Control Strategy of Three-level Converter Based on Flying Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For bi-directional converters, a pre-charging strategy based on single switch control for flying capacitor three-level is proposed. By controlling the on-off of the three-level outer tube, the flying capacitor can be pre-charged efficiently and quickly. The pre-charging control strategy is applied to bi-directional converter. The pre-charging of flying capacitor is completed in 1s in Buck mode and 5s in boost mode, after pre-charging, the flying capacitor voltage remains half of the high voltage side voltage, and the input capacitor voltage remains as the input voltage. No additional pre-charging power device is needed, which not only simplifies the topology, but also ensures the reliable and fast pre-charge of flying capacitor.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Forcasting with Multiple Train-Test Splits Integrated Temporal Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate wind power prediction models are very important for the stable and economic power systems operation. In this paper, multiple train-test splits and temporal convolutional network are combined for one-hour ahead wind power prediction. This model uses both expansion convolution and causal convolution and is able to efficiently handle wind farm data with long-term historical data. Simulation results also show that it performs better than other baseline algorithms in terms of convergence speed and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Control of AC-DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Active Injection of High-Frequency Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid distribution network is an important development direction of future distribution system, and DC interpole short circuit fault is the most serious fault type in DC distribution network. Usually, the blocking converter is used to isolate the fault current. Under this protection, the effective value of fault information is less, and the fault location is difficult to be identified by the protection device. To solve this problem, a new fault control strategy is proposed. By switching the control strategy of PET (Power Electronic Transformer), the input stage adopts current limiting control and changes the switching frequency of the output stage. A high frequency signal is injected into the fault point to make the protection device quickly identify the fault. Firstly, the short-circuit fault characteristics of DC distribution network are analyzed. Secondly, the generation mechanism and selection principle of characteristic signal are given from the perspective of feasibility. Then, the control strategy of injecting characteristic signal into fault lines is discussed. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The Allocation Strategy Optimization of Mobile Energy Storages for Power System Restoration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: After power system blackout, a large number of energy storages have been integrated into power grid for system operation, which can increase the stability of the grid and improve the flexibility of power system. In existing research, the fixed energy storages have been employed to be the blackstart power source. However, the location and capacity of fixed energy storages limit the restoration efficiency of power system. Therefore, the optimal allocation strategy of mobile energy storages (MESs) is proposed in this paper to increase the efficiency of power system restoration. Firstly, the objective function of the proposed strategy is to maximize the total power generation by all generators during restoration process. optimization variables of the propose optimization model are the capacity and location of MESs and the constraints for system operation are considered. Then, the Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm is employed to solve the optimization model. Finally, the modified IEEE39 node system is employed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-microgrid Optimization Based on Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A hierarchical reinforcement learning optimization method is proposed for multi-microgrid system. Decompose the multi-microgrid optimization problem into upper and lower layers for solving. The upper layer determines the energy storage optimization strategy of each microgrid and the power interaction strategy between microgrids. In lower layer each microgrid autonomously optimizes the power of distributed generation within the microgrid based on the upper layer policy, and feeds back reward signals to the upper layer to guide the update the policy of upper layer. The decoupling of multi-microgrid optimization problem in time and space is realized, and each microgrid can complete the optimization of multi-microgrid system based on its own state information, which effectively protects the internal privacy of each microgrid. And the reinforcement learning method and mathematical programming method are combined to solve the model, which can not only improve the training speed, but also effectively improve the accuracy of the solution. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and compared with the traditional method, it is proved that the solution speed and accuracy of the proposed method are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Model Simplification and Parameter Identification of Generator Speed Governor System with Dead Zone Counting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a least-squares estimation (LSE) based model simplification and parameter identification method for the governor system of generator sets is proposed, considering the primary frequency regulation dead zone. The transfer function of the second-order speed regulation system is obtained by simplifying the governor system of hydropower and thermal power units commonly used in power grids, which retains the main links and parameters and is applicable to both water and thermal units. Then, the LSE method is used to identify the parameters of the second-order transfer function considering the primary frequency regulation dead zone, and the results are verified based on the detailed model simulation. The results show that the proposed simplified model can better describe the dynamic characteristics of the generator speed control system, and the physical parameter identification results of the simplified model are basically consistent with the detailed model after considering the dead zone.

articleTitle: Network Structure and Power Quality of DC Distribution System: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the innovation of energies and technologies, DC distribution system (DDS) is an inevitable trend of the power system development. Thus, the voltage level and network structure of the DDS are firstly generalized in terms of application scenarios, thereby proposing its three layers network architecture. Secondly, based on the variation mechanism of DC voltage, an index frame is established to evaluate the power quality of a DDS, providing an assessment method for a DDS. Finally, the key technologies for improving each index of the DDS are explored and prospected in this paper, hopefully enriching the DDS in terms of theoretical research development and application.

articleTitle: Stochastic Joint Planning of Energy Storage and Transmission for Power System Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to provide sufficient margin for the power system to counteract the fluctuations brought about by renewable energies, a joint energy storage and transmission planning method is proposed for flexibility. A Monte Carlo sampling method is used to generate a large number of scenario sets including wind power, solar power and load demand. An improved k-means clustering algorithm is used to reduce the scenarios by the Calinski-Harabasz index (CHI) to obtain the typical scenario sets for wind power, solar power and load demand. And a combination of wind power, solar power and load demand stochastic scenarios is obtained according to the scenario probability. A joint energy storage and transmission planning model with quantitative grid flexibility index and flexibility resource construction cost as the objective functions is established and solved by the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm. The results showed that the proposed method can effectively reduce the power fluctuations brought about by renewable energies.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method of Complex Urban Distribution Network Based on MLP-GCN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To overcome the shortcomings of some traditional fault location methods which can't fully consider the topology of complex urban distribution networks, a novel MLP-GCN method which integrates Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) is proposed to locate the fault. By considering the overcurrent, overvoltage, circuit breaker status, and other information of each node and line in the distribution network, the physical properties of the feeder and load nodes are extracted as fault data feature vectors, and then the node and edge features of the feeder are converted by a multi-layer perceptron, and then input to the graph convolutional network to form a mapping between the fault data vector and the fault branch, and forms the fault location model to predict the fault point. Finally, the model is simulated in a S-SCDN (supply region of substation centralized distribution network) complex feeder cluster, and its effectiveness is verified.

Author Keywords: supply region of substation centralized distribution network

articleTitle: Economic Benefit Analysis for the Life Cycle of Electric Storage-Cooling Air Conditioning System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of economic benefit analysis of electric cold storage air conditioning system, this paper proposes a method for analyzing the economic benefits of electric storage-cooling air conditioning system in the whole life cycle. Based on the whole life cycle analysis method, the economics of the electric cold storage air conditioning system is analyzed, and the economic benefit analysis method of the electric cold storage air conditioning system is obtained from different perspectives such as the grid side, the user side, and the third-party investors. Finally, an example of an office building is used to analyze the investment income of different cold storage strategies and different investment subjects, and the rationality of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Operation of Microgrid Based on NSGA-III Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of the regional comprehensive energy Internet, the reasonable and efficient arrangement of units between the power generation equipment and the electricity load in the microgrid has become a hot issue in current research. On the premise of ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the microgrid system, it is hoped that the loss of wind power and photovoltaics in the microgrid can be reduced and economic benefits can be improved. To achieve this goal, this paper constructs the microgrid optimization model including micro gas turbine, fuel cell, energy storage device, wind power generation and photovoltaic power generation. In terms of algorithm, Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III) is adopted to obtain the microgrid scheduling scheme with maximum integral benefit on the premise of meeting the constraints. The simulation results show that the scheme obtained by the algorithm can achieve the highest energy utilization of the microgrid system and improve the economic benefits of the system.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Cascading Failures Considering Photovoltaic Power Uncertainty and Frequency Modulation under Extreme Weather Events
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Extreme weather events are prone to cause cascading failure of power systems with renewable sources. This paper proposes a risk assessment method for power systems with renewable sources under extreme sand storm due to windstorm. First, the impact of sand storm on the output of photovoltaic is quantified. An improved probabilistic load flow model considering the frequency modulation was discussed. Then risk assessment method based on the improved probabilistic load flow is proposed to assess the risk of cascading failure. Finally, the proposed method is tested in an IEEE 39 bus system. Results indicate that the proposed method can effectively assess the risk of power systems with renewable sources under sand storm.

articleTitle: Research on Composite Current Control Strategy for Wind Energy Storage Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional double closed-loop control strategy in grid-connected inverter control, such as inadequate performance in measuring the dynamic performance of inverter, ineffective suppression of harmonies, low steady-state accuracy and poor anti-interference ability, an improved compound current control algorithm based on double closed-loop control is proposed. Based on the double closed-loop current loop control and the repetitive control strategy, the repetitive controller is added to the current loop to ensure the stability and accuracy of the system. Simulation and experimental results show that the improved algorithm has high steady-state control accuracy, good dynamic performance and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Analysis and Solution of Commutation Failure Caused by Abnormal AC Voltage Measurement in HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the two UHVDC transmission projects of China Southern Power Grid, the event of abnormal AC voltage measurement on the inverter side is introduced. The phenomenon of commutation failure after abnormal AC voltage measurement in the event is analyzed in detail. It is concluded that the reason of commutation failure is the abnormal firing pulse caused by the abnormal voltage measurement after the power supply of the voltage measuring device, which is confirmed by the real-time simulation hardware in the loop platform simulation test. Finally, a solution to the optimization of switching system logic and PLL AC fault latching frequency strategy after abnormal AC voltage measurement is proposed. The simulation test and on-site test verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme

articleTitle: Strategic Reserve Mechanism Design under the Power Market Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The scale-up of wind and solar energy poses new challenges for the security of electricity supply and power system planning. Thus, various capacity remuneration mechanisms are introduced in electricity markets internationally. Coal power generation is indispensable to China’s power system, mitigating the volatility and randomness of renewable energy and promoting security and stability. This paper conducts an in-depth study on the strategic reserve mechanism for old and decommissioned coal-fired units to ensure the adequacy of power generation capacity. The principles, characteristics, and applicability of the strategic reserve mechanism are analyzed according to China’s national conditions. Meanwhile, a strategic reserve trigger mechanism based on the day-ahead spot market is designed to deal with the shortage of power supply during special periods and ease high electricity prices. The case studies show the effectiveness of the presented modeling framework and the advantages of the strategic reserve mechanism.

articleTitle: A Moving Target Defense Strategy Against FDIA Based on Flexible Switching of Spare Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: False Data Injection Attack(FDIA) is a typical network attack, which can bypass the Bad Data Detection(BDD) and affect State Estimation(SE), the estimation results is vital for power system, thus posing a great threat to the security of power system. In this paper, a new defense scheme is proposed, which is based on flexible switching of spare lines. By switching on the spare lines of some working transmission lines flexibly, the transmission line parameters in the power system topology can be changed, so as to reduce the possibility of FDIA. The impact of switching spare lines on power system operation and FDIA by ergodic method is analyzed. An optimization algorithm is designed to find the least system generator cost for power grid operator and the least attack space for attackers, this algorithm is tested in the IEEE 5-bus system and IEEE 30-bus system, and the results show that the scheme has a good performance in resisting FDIA.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Isolated Bi-Directional AC/DC Converter Controlled by Single Phase Shift Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A single-phase-shift control (SPS) plus variable-frequency control (VF) control strategy for isolated bidirectional AC/DC converters is proposed. The isolated bidirectional AC/DC converter topology consists of a dual active bridge (DAB) and a synchronous rectifier (SR). The proposed strategy converts the non-linear relationship between shift compared to output power in single phase shift control into a linear one by means of frequency control, making the control simple. The transfer function of the control is obtained by modelling the DAB small signal system and the optimal control parameters are obtained after frequency domain analysis. At the same time, the control method can effectively reduce the switching losses and the smaller value of the intermediate capacitor parameter reduces the size of the converter. The control principle of this isolated bi-directional AC/DC converter is described and analyzed in detail, and finally the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: GRA-NGBoost based System Inertia Prediction for High Wind Power-Penetrated Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasingly penetration of wind power generation, the system inertia presents nonlinear and time-varying characteristics. Accurately predicting the variation tendency of the system inertia is helpful for operators to identify the time period when the system inertia is less than the critical level, and to take corresponding remedial measures in advance. Driven by the virtual inertia control technology, the virtual inertia provided by renewable units also needs to be taken into account. This paper proposes a GRA-NGBoost based system inertia prediction method for high wind power-penetrated grids. Case study on the modified IEEE RTS-79 system show that the proposed method has high accuracy, low sample dependence, and good fitting capability of the system inertia, which is of great significance for operators to prepare appropriate unit schedule plan under high risk low-inertia operating scenarios.

articleTitle: Demand Response Featured Dynamic Voltage Regulation of Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This With high proportion of distributed power sources integrated into the grid, the active distribution network achieves the economic and safe operation of the grid through the comprehensive application of demand response. In this paper, a voltage optimization method based on demand response is proposed. According to the dynamic combination of interruptible and transferable load and dual energy storage, a day-ahead reactive power optimization model is established to minimize the voltage deviation of distribution network. The optimal decision variables include discrete and continuous, and the second-order cone method can linearize the mixed nonlinear model and simplify the model, so the mixed integer second-order cone programming model is used in this paper. The feasibility and effectiveness of the optimization model are verified by the improved IEEE 33-bus power distribution system.

articleTitle: Real-time Energy Management of a Low-Carbon Micro-Grid Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To minimize total operation cost considering carbon emission, the energy management problem of a micro-grid is formulated by scheduling conventional generators (CGs), energy storage systems (ESSs) and power trading with the main grid. It is proposed in this paper to convert the energy management problem to a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and solve it with soft actor-critic (SAC), a cutting-edge deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm. The agent is able to capture uncertainty of load and renewable generation (RG) from large volumes of historical data in training and able to provide scheduling plan from real-time measurement of uncertainty once training is completed. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and its advantage over deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) in both operation cost and constraint violation.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study on Condition Monitoring of Power Network Asset Using PMU Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Current asset management for distribution networks has adopted a passive strategy - either run to failure or perform field inspection of limited assets within a fixed period. This paper aims to study the feasibility of using high-resolution data recorded by phasor measurement units (PMUs) for real-time asset monitoring. Accelerated ageing experiment on a laboratory transformer and the insulator pollution experiment have been performed. The PMU measurements collected from both experiments are used to evaluate the asset health conditions by examing the standard deviation of the signal to noise ratio (SNR) after the statistical analysis and noise segregation of the original PMU measurements. A comparative study between the traditional condition assessment method and the proposed method demonstrates the feasibility of using the PMU data to evaluate the asset health conditions.

articleTitle: Research of Real-Time Monitoring and Control Technology for Distributed Energy Storage Based on 5G
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the guidance of the "double carbon" goal, China energy system is undergoing profound changes. The development of new energy storage is an important way to improve the flexibility of China power system, build a new power system and ensure the realization of the "double carbon" goal on schedule. The "Virtual Power Plant" technology can realize the aggregation and optimization of energy storage devices, realize the multi energy complementarity on the power side, promote the flexible interaction on the load side, and provide a new operation scheme for building a security, economic, efficient and reliable power grid. However, at the same time, the massive distributed loads typical of the new energy storage are distributed everywhere. How to realize the real-time, security and reliable monitoring and control has become an important problem affecting the wide application of the new energy storage technology. Focusing on the real-time, security and reliable monitoring and control of the distributed energy storage loads, this paper proposes a real-time monitoring and control technology for distributed energy storage based on 5G to ensure the security and reduce the time delay of application data interaction. It provides a feasible and effective solution for the main station of power system to realize real-time load control and meet the needs of peak cutting and valley filling.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Study of Fuel Cell Hybrid Topology for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper performs sizing determination and energy management of four common fuel cell hybrid systems and compares their performance. Control-oriented models of external properties for fuel cells, batteries, and ultracapacitors are developed. Capacity settings for different systems are determined by analyzing the power and energy constraints of the driving conditions. An energy management strategy based on the dynamic programming approach is implemented, with the optimization objective of minimizing hydrogen consumption. Hydrogen consumption and the aging state of power energy devices are used to evaluate the performance of candidates. The results show that there is no topology with optimal fuel economy and aging performance at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Characteristics of Single-Phase Transformer under DC Bias
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to study the influence of DC bias on the electromagnetic characteristics of the transformer, firstly, the equivalent circuit model of the single-phase transformer is established according to the mechanism of DC bias. Secondly, the model is simulated by using the MATLAB software. Finally, the results show that the DC bias makes the hysteresis loop, magnetostrictive curve and excitation current waveform lose their original symmetry, indicating that a distortion phenomenon occurs, and the peak values of excitation current, magnetic flux density and deformation increase significantly, which shows that the loss of the transformer increases and the vibration intensifies. As the DC current increases, the degree of this distortion will be further exacerbated. In addition, the magnetostrictive curve also has saturation characteristics and hysteresis characteristics.

articleTitle: Pre-synchronization Control Strategy of VSG Based on Power Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) has attracted extensive attention for its similar moment of inertia and damping characteristics to the conventional synchronous generator (SG). In view of the large impulse current when switching from islanded to grid-connected operation, this paper proposes a pre-synchronization control strategy based on power compensation. The output voltage angle and amplitude of VSG are compensated by using the principle of traditional droop control, so as to track the angle and amplitude of the grid voltage and reduce the impulse current to realize smooth switching from islanded to grid-connected operation. Finally, the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation results in MATLAB /SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Coordinated Impedance-Reshaping Control Strategy for Suppressing High-Frequency Resonance of DFIG System Connected to Parallel Compensation Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a coordinated impedance-reshaping control (CIRC) strategy for the rotor side converter (RSC) and grid-side converter (GSC) control is proposed to suppress the HFR of the DFIG-PCG system. The impedance of RSC-induction generator (RSC-IG) is reshaped by introducing a high-order coefficient into the original impedance, while the impedance of the GSC is reshaped by considering the grid-side current control. A damping controller is designed to reshape the impedance of the DFIG system by the cooperative control of RSC and GSC. Compared with the conventional HFR suppression method relying on DFIG’s electricity parameters, the proposed CIRC strategy can effectively suppress the HFR of the DFIG-PCG in a wide range frequency based on the determined coefficients of impedance reshaping, which makes the reshaped impedance of DFIG is calculated no matter the DFIG parameters loss, thereby avoiding the strategy failure when some electricity parameters are losing. Finally, a time-domain simulation model of the DFIG-PCG is established on MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the proposed CIRC strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Adaptive Control Strategy of Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator control introduces the synchronous generator rotor motion equation into the control of the grid-connected inverter to realize the friendly grid connection of the distributed power source. However, a part of the dynamic adjustment performance of the grid-connected inverter is lost. Improper selection of the moment of inertia and damping coefficient of the virtual synchronous generator may cause the "rocking" oscillation phenomenon, which is similar to the synchronous generator, appearing in the grid-connected inverter, and even cause the grid-connected inverter to be off-grid. Therefore, the virtual synchronous generator parameter adaptive control is proposed for the moment of inertia and damping coefficient. Firstly, the mathematical model of the virtual synchronous generator is established, and the influences of moment of inertia and damping coefficient on the performances of virtual synchronous generator is analyzed. Furthermore, the adaptive control of moment of inertia and damping coefficient is introduced into the virtual synchronous generator control. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation. The results show that the parameter adaptive virtual synchronous generator control improves the system response speed and reduces effectively the virtual synchronous generator frequency and power overshoot, compared with the fixed-parameter virtual synchronous generator control.

articleTitle: Research on The Cascaded Fast Power Control System For Renewable Generations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The power electronic based photovoltaic power generation, wind turbine and other renewable power generation systems have the potential of millisecond level power control. Based on the analysis on the demands of fast power control in grids with high renewable generation penetration, this paper proposes the structure of fast renewable energy power control system. The information transmission delay, MCU processing delay and the MPPT tracking delay are analyzed. A novel algorithm is implemented to enable the renewable power generations to quickly respond to the control commands from the power grid and realize rapid bi-directional power adjustments. The proposed methods could participate in the primary frequency and voltage regulation in the power grid.

articleTitle: Evaluation Index System and Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Power Quality Governance Effect in Distribution Station Area
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Evaluation of power quality governance effect is of great reference significance for the optimization of the governance scheme. Considering the physical characteristics of power quality and governance benefits comprehensively, an evaluation index system of power quality governance effect including three-dimensional indexes of power quality, economic benefits, and service evaluation is established. Secondly, based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a governance effect evaluation model of power quality is established. The comprehensive weighting method combined with analytic hierarchy process and entropy weight coefficient method is adopted to determine the index weight. The membership function is constructed by the assignment method revised by experts and customers. Finally, a case study of a city distribution network is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed governance effect evaluation index system and evaluation model.

articleTitle: Detection of Price Multiplicity Based on Rank of Submatrix
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Linear programming model is usually used to solve the real-time market clearing problem in electricity markets around the world. Locational marginal price (LMP) is widely used for its effect to reflect the network congestion cost and the marginal cost of power generation. However, in the actual solution process, it is faced with price multiplicity, which affects market fairness. Changing the pricing process to solve it will lead to a large number of redundant calculations. Therefore, accurate and efficient detection of price multiplicity is needed. In this paper, a detection method of price multiplicity based on rank of submatrix is proposed. On the basis of a set of solutions obtained by using KKT conditions, the variable equation in the form of a matrix is further obtained. By simplifying rank of coefficient matrix, a price multiplicity detection method is obtained. Numerical examples are given to test the effect of the above price multiplicity detection method.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Optimal Control of Photovoltaic Energy Supply Greenhouse Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
