abstract: A large number of PV are connected in rural areas, but the PV consumption rate is low. The development of facility agricultural load provides a new way for the local consumption of DPV. However, due to the lack of certain control means, the agricultural production law does not match the output of DPV, and the effect of improving photovoltaic consumption is not obvious. In order to deal with the uncertainty of photovoltaic output, considering that the prediction accuracy increases with the decrease of time scale, a multi time scale optimal control strategy of photovoltaic energy supply greenhouse based on model predictive control is proposed, which takes the energy consuming equipment in the greenhouse as the control object to realize the matching between its operating power and DPV output. Based on the active power output of each equipment in a long-time scale and based on model predictive control in a short time scale, the active power output increment of each equipment is solved by rolling optimization, and the future plan is revised to ensure the photovoltaic absorption rate of the greenhouse system and reduce the operation cost. The feasibility of the strategy is verified by the actual operation data of greenhouse.

articleTitle: A Peer to Peer Transaction Based Pricing Model of Distribution Networks with 100% Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The proportion of distributed renewable energy sources in the distribution networks is increasing. 100% renewable energy which means zero marginal cost is an inevitable result of development. Thus, how to determine the price of electric energy during the transactions is an urgent topic to be discussed. Besides, peer-to-peer (P2P) transaction is gradually be introduced to the distribution network operation with more and more distributed energy sources connected. Therefore, this paper proposes a zero marginal cost pricing model based on P2P transaction in distribution network, and the objective is to maximize social welfare. The pricing model is based on an iterative algorithm of P2P transaction, quantity available is provided by prosumers and price is proposed by consumers in each iterative. The benefits of each subject and the physical constraints of distribution networks are also be comprehensively considered. Cases show the effectiveness of the model. In the IEEE 15 buses system, three prosumers with photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage (ES) are located, the pricing strategy generated by the model could reasonably be determined by the P2P transaction mentioned and used for distribution network operation. And it could coordinate PV and ES in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Multi-time Interval Optimization Scheduling Method for Inter-connected Power Systems Considering Operation Risk and Flexible Adjustment of HVDC Tie-lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the acceleration of energy transformation process, to promote inter-regional resource complementarity and improve the level of new energy consumption, a multi-time interval optimization scheduling method of interconnected systems is proposed, which considering the operation risk and the flexible adjustment of DC transmission lines. Firstly, the power adjustment model of DC tie line is established to make full use of the adjustment ability of tie line to improve the flexibility of system operation. Secondly, the system operation risk model is established from the perspective of wind curtailment and load shedding, and the upper and lower bounds of the acceptable wind power domain are set as optimization variables to achieve the balance between economy and risk. Then, to make full use of the latest source-load prediction information to improve the optimality of decision results, a multi-time interval optimization scheduling model of inter-connected systems is established by combining rolling optimization with real-time adjustment, and the solution method is given. Finally, the simulation results verify that the proposed method can effectively promote the new energy consumption of the interconnected system and ensure the load power supply.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Power Transformer Based on DGA and Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming to improve fault diagnosis performance of power transformer, a novel approach based on dissolved gas analysis and information fusion technology is presented in this paper. The diagnosis results obtained by grey relation analysis, fuzzy logic, and back propagation neuron network are employed as basic probability assignments of D-S theory. Then, compatibility ratio is used to solve the possible conflicts among different sub-evidences. Finally, fault diagnosis result is obtained thorough decision-making criterial. The experimental result suggest that the proposed approach has better performance than that of conventional methods, and fault diagnosis accuracy up to 93.18%.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Integrated Electricity-Heat-Hydrogen Systems Considering Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to support the carbon neutrality target, the integrated energy systems (IESs) will play a huge role by virtue of its advantages of multi-energy complementation and energy cascade utilization. This paper developed a detailed mathematical model for integrated electricity-heat-hydrogen systems (IEHHSs), and established the comprehensive model of hydrogen energy. Besides, the low-carbon and economic operation of IEHHS is achieved based on the carbon benefits and integrated demand response, and the proposed model is validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Improved Impedance Arc Model Based on Cassie Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the low-voltage distribution system, to prevent the damage caused by fault arc, it is very important to analyze its characteristics accurately. An impedance arc model based on Cassie model was proposed to solve the problems that the traditional arc model have errors in the zero-rest phase of arc current, the current change rate before and after zero-crossing, and the fault characteristics of high and low frequency oscillations. Using Matlab/Simulink simulation, the results show that the improved Cassie model of arc fault current was consistent with the traditional model , and it can better reflect the fault characteristics such as zero-rest phase of the arc current, which verifies the feasibility and accuracy of the fault arc simulation of the new model.

articleTitle: Layered Optimization for Low-Carbon Energy-Traffic Systems Based on Dynamic Hydrogen Price
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a layered optimization strategy is put forward to realize the low-carbon and economic operation of energy-traffic systems based on dynamic hydrogen price. Firstly, a dynamic hydrogen price mechanism related to the share of renewable energy in the energy supply is proposed and introduced into the distributed energy station (DES) optimization, which will promote hydrogen generation using renewable power and reduce the DES construction and operation cost. Based on the dynamic hydrogen price optimized by DESs and the traffic condition on roads, a minimum cost path (MCP) can be selected by the raised user-centric path optimization method for hydrogen fuel vehicles (HVs) to refuel from the DES with low-cost and/or low-carbon hydrogen. Finally, the simulations verify the feasibility of the raised optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Cases-Based Power System Economics Course Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The case-based teaching method is a promising student-centered teaching strategy, which can effectively solve the problem of disconnection between engineering courses, talent training systems and practical application scenarios in graduate education. In this paper, a curriculum design framework for power system economics with case module integration is proposed. The framework contains five modules and includes a variety of cases involving nodal tariffs, dispatching, planning, low-carbon development, and new technologies. The framework design has achieved good teaching results and is conducive to the training of comprehensive talents who can skillfully apply engineering management and economic decision-making to solve low-carbon electricity marketization problems.

articleTitle: Coordinated Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems with Hydrogen Electrolyzer Units
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To use more green electricity, more renewable energy sources are employed in the distribution power systems. The combination of wind power with the hydrogen electrolyzer unit is one of effective ways to utilize renewable energy by converting electricity to hydrogen. In addition, more natural gas-fired units increase the couplings between the power systems and the natural gas systems. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct coordinated scheduling for integrated power and natural gas systems in consideration of hydrogen electrolyzer units that are used to produce hydrogen from wind power. The revenue from hydrogen production is established as a function of a part of wind power. To consider the distribution topology, the spanning tree constraints are used to ensure the radiality of the distribution system. The DistFlow model and the piecewise linear method are used to deal with the nonlinear models of the distribution system and the natural gas system. Furthermore, the carbon emission is included in the optimization objective to guarantee an optimal carbon emission with an optimal operational point. The entire problem is established as mixed integer linear programming model. Tests on a revised IEEE 33-bus system associated with a 20-node natural gas system show that the coordinated scheduling on integrated power and natural gas systems with hydrogen production from wind power can achieve an optimal operational cost.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Active Arc Extinguishing Technology for LVDC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the current situation of the lack of electricity loads in LVDC system, the power supply principle of some conventional loads is analyzed, the DC power supply test or transformation of such loads is realized to meet the application requirements of the system on this basis. In addition, the arc problem of load application in LVDC system is analyzed, and an arc-free plug-in method of DC loads based on capacitors and semiconductor switches is proposed, of which he load and capacitor are connected in parallel and then connected in series with the semiconductor switch. Through the arc extinguishing characteristics of the semiconductor switch and capacitor, arc free disconnection can be realized. The test results show the effectiveness of the above method.

articleTitle: Coupling and Fault Analysis of Electro-Magnetic-Structural Field of Transformer Based on COMSOL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the core of multi-energy conversion equipment, the reliability of transformer operation is very important for the safe operation of equipment and even the whole system. In the process of operation, transformer is affected by the joint action of electromagnetic field, structure field and other physical fields, and its internal deformation is affected by this. Transformer winding deformation is one of the common abnormal states in the process of transformer operation, and winding deformation leads to insulation problems and partial discharge. Therefore, in this paper, the finite element software CMOSOL was used to build the transformer model with the coupling of electromagnetism and structure to observe the stress of the windings and the iron core from both theoretical and simulation aspects. The magneto-strictive vibration of the core and the electric vibration of the winding cause the vibration of the transformer. The stress changes of the windings and the iron core were analyzed by simulating the deformation of the transformer windings. It is concluded that the windings are more prone to displacement when they are faulty. It not only increases the displacement of the fault phase but also causes the vibration of the other two phases.

articleTitle: Multi-service Scheme for Electric Vehicles Considering Performance-based Regulation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a multi-service scheme for electric vehicles (EVs) to participate in energy and frequency regulation markets, considering the performance-based regulation mechanism. Due to the spatial characteristics of the charging cost distribution, we first propose a charging scheduling model for EVs among different charging stations. After that, the performance-based mechanism is applied in frequency regulation service to improve the enthusiasm of EVs in frequency regulation. The linear constraints of power, state-of-charge, and scheduling for EV are constructed, and a Mixed Integer Linear Programming model based on revenue maximization is established to coordinate the energy arbitrage and the performance-based frequency regulation. Finally, numerical case studies are also provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Self-Healing Fault Reconstruction Strategy for Island Emergency Power Grid Based on Floyd-MPSO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the island power system, due to the special geographical location of the island, variable and unpredictable weather, power outages occur from time to time and power cannot be reliably guaranteed, so it is necessary to establish an emergency power grid to ensure the power supply of important loads in case of faults, and distributed power supplies (DGs) can play an important role with their characteristics of rapid response, simple structure and flexibility. In the fault reconstruction recovery, firstly, the structural characteristics of the distribution network are reasonably optimized to reduce the complexity of the solution; secondly, the key influence of the DG start-up sequence on the recovery path is discussed based on the start-up and operation characteristics of the DG. In order to ensure fast and stable recovery of more important loads, the Floyd-MPSO algorithm is combined with the minimum path cost and the maximum recovery of important loads as the objective, and the power balance and other constraints, in which the Floyd algorithm is used to search in advance to obtain the shortest path matrix among DGs with the optimized distribution network as the base, and then the inertia factor of the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm is adjusted adaptively to improve the defect that the particle is easy to fall into the local optimal and cannot jump out.The results verify that the combination of the two can improve the effectiveness and speed of fault reconstruction.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Model for Thermal Power and Renewable Power Considering Carbon Trading Effects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an energy-saving dispatching model for thermal power and a collaborative dispatching model for thermal power and renewable energy power considering carbon trading constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed models is verified through a city grid in north China. By controlling the carbon emission trading price and the ratio of free quota, the sensitivity of total generation cost is analyzed. The decision making of policymakers could be well supported by the analytical results.

articleTitle: Study of "Home Port" Energy Storage System on the Tower of Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the expansion of the power grid, China's requirements for intelligent inspection are also increasing. A robot "home port" battery storage system has been designed to meet the charging needs of transmission line inspection robots at work. This paper firstly introduces the working principle of lead-acid batteries, the phenomenon of battery polarization and the method of depolarization, then selects the parameters of lead-acid batteries in the home port in combination with the working condition of the inspection robot, and finally selects the outer size of the insulation box and the optimum heating power of the heating band through simulation analysis, thus completing the design of the robot "home port" battery storage system. The design of the battery storage system is completed.

articleTitle: Valuation of Load Forecasts in an Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Load forecasting is one of the bases of power system economic scheduling. High accurate load forecasts help the power system operator make better resource allocation and thus reduce the operational cost. The system operator can buy load forecasts in the data market and then combine them in an ensemble model to enhance the quality of final forecasts. Consequently, the operator should share forecast providers (agents) with the operational profit (or reduced cost) fairly. However, data from different agents affect the ensemble forecast jointly, making it hard to quantify the contribution of each individual forecast. There are few works regarding load forecast valuation in an ensemble model, especially in the electricity market. To fill this gap, this paper investigates valuation approaches. Four profit-sharing schemes with different computational complexity and synergy considerations are proposed and compared. Case studies on a real-world dataset illustrate how forecasts can be evaluated in an ensemble model.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Battery Energy Storage Systems: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The wide application of battery energy storage in the power system and the frequent occurrence of thermal runaway incidents involving it have driven up the demand for its reliability analysis. Research on the reliability of battery cells and battery energy storage systems has been carried out from various perspectives. However, there is no comprehensive reliability analysis of the battery energy storage system, combined with its role in the operation of the power grid. In this paper, the basic framework of reliability analysis of battery energy storage systems is proposed, and a specific analysis of battery modules with complex reliability mechanisms is conducted. As two important factors affecting the reliability of battery modules, the performance degradation of battery cells and thermal runaway propagation are introduced in detail. Besides, the potential harm to the power grid caused by the reduced reliability of battery energy storage is analyzed. Finally, some suggestions for reliability analysis of battery energy storage systems are presented.

articleTitle: Cooperated Bidding of Aggregators to Meet Eligibility Requirements of Ancillary Service Market
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of demand side resources, an aggregator could participate in both in energy market (EM) and ancillary service market to increase revenue. Considering the impact of eligibility requirements of ancillary service market on the procedure of bidding, this paper analyses two kinds of eligibility requirements, including minimum reserve capacity requirement and minimum duration time requirement. Then, two cooperation models of aggregators to meet eligibility requirements is proposed. Based on the mechanism of cooperation before bidding, the resources which cannot meet the eligibility requirements can cooperate and then participate into the market, which meets eligibility requirements through cooperation. Based on the above two cooperation submodels, we establish the cooperated bidding model. The effectiveness of the cooperated bidding models is verified through the cooperation between two aggregators in day-head 24 hours.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Control Strategy for Transient Performance Improvement of DC/DC Converter in Distributed Power Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive predictive correction control method for DC-DC converter based on sequential neural network. In this method, NARX network is used to predict the output voltage in the transient process of the converter, and the reference value of the controller is compensated and corrected, so as to realize the adaptive control of the converter. Simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed method. Compared with traditional PI control, the proposed method can effectively suppress voltage fluctuation in the transient process and significantly shorten the adjustment time of the converter, which is expected to be applied in high-performance regulated voltage power supply and distributed power generation.

articleTitle: Distributed Power Management and Coordinated Control for AC/DC Hybrid Microgrids Based on Solid-State Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For better utilization of renewable energy with high penetration and fluctuation, the solid-state transformer (SST)-interfaced AC/DC hybrid microgrid (MG) has received great attention and aroused increasing demand for utility grid support and power management functions. under the condition of plug-and-play, the existing study on system economy and scalability for SST-interfaced AC/DC hybrid MGs is insufficient. Therefore, a distributed power management and coordinated control strategy is proposed. According to power quality requirements and the operation cost of controllable units, the whole system realizes stable economic operation and minimizes the influence on the distribution network. To improve storage performance and service life, the accurate and balanced power allocation of various energy storages is achieved based on adjacent or local information. Besides, the proposed control strategy can improve the reliability and adaptability of the whole system under different operation modes, such as SST-enabled mode, SST-disabled mode, MG islanding mode, and their switched states. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed system and control strategy are tested on the real-time simulation platform.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheme of Distributed Network Restoration Based on Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing scale of power system, the traditional power restoration method is getting more difficult to meet the requirements. The general distributed power restoration scheme includes non-fault outage area search, restoration area search and DG restoration search. Through the steps of search, region confirmation and data calculation, power supply can be restored in the non-fault outage area. At present, Soft Open Point (SOP) has a broad application prospect in distributed network. By analyzing the basic structure and control mode of SOP, a power restoration model with SOP is proposed, and the control strategy and iterative model are adjusted according to the SOP output parameters. After the above adjustment, the IEEE69-bus model is taken as an example to analyze the power restoration in non-fault area. By comparing the power restoration schemes, it can be concluded that the distributed network with SOP can achieve better restoration result.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Supply-Demand Matching between Highway Operational Energy Consumption and Renewable Energy Integration: A Case Study of Panzhihua-Dali Highway within Sichuan Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Highway transportation is one of the main areas of energy consumption and carbon emission, facing great pressure of carbon peak and carbon neutralization. Building a green comprehensive energy system for highway transportation is conducive to dealing with the volatility of renewable energy and other adverse factors, promoting the highway transportation industry to change the energy structure and improve energy efficiency, to reduce carbon emissions. The core of green low-carbon highway transportation is to control resource occupation, reduce energy consumption and reduce carbon emissions. With the construction of green energy and renewable energy systems, it is not only of great significance to guide the construction of green energy and renewable energy systems, but also of great significance to the construction of green energy and renewable energy systems for the operation of new roads. In this paper, aiming at the problems encountered in the current construction of green and low-carbon highways, based on the analysis of the working characteristics of highways during the operation period, combined with the existing classification of highway energy consumption, the highway is divided into seven types of energy consuming facilities according to the scene, such as tunnels, toll stations, operation management centers, maintenance centers and service areas, which are divided into electricity, gasoline, diesel, hydrogen, liquefied gas and water according to the type of energy consumption, The corresponding energy consumption composition system is formed. Taking the energy consumption structure and energy consumption level during the operation period of Panzhihua-Dali highway and the analysis of local new energy collection as an example, the feasibility of matching supply and demand between energy consumption and renewable energy during highway transportation operation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Harmonic Source Localization Based on the Joint Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a new strategy for harmonic current sources localization in power systems. Based on the fast independent component analysis method, the harmonic current profiles are calculated according to the measured voltage data. Then the slow variations associated with the load patterns are separated based on the moving average filter. Seeking low computational complexity, dimensionality reduction is realized by using the fast independent component analysis. To accurately and effectively locate the harmonic source with minimal measured voltage, the joint entropy method is used based on a threshold value and localization algorithm, which can locate multiple harmonic sources without any additional inputs, i.e., the system harmonic impedance and topology. Computational simulations are conducted employing the IEEE 37-bus test system by taking account of three different harmonic sources, i.e., residential, commercial, and office harmonic sources, and simulation results in IEEE-37 test system verify the accuracy, validity, and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Steady-State Optimal Power Flow in Integrated Electricity and Gas Transmission Systems with Hydrogen Injections
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Hydrogen is a promising clean energy source for the future energy system. The power-to-gas facilities produce hydrogen from surplus renewable generations, and inject it into the natural gas transmission pipelines for transportation and further use. The operating condition of the Integrated Electricity and Gas Systems (IEGS) should be fully aware and optimized, for restraining the injection of hydrogen within a secure range. This paper proposes a steady-state optimal power flow technique for IEGS with distributed hydrogen injections. First, the IEGS is reformulated in an energy-balanced form considering the impact of hydrogen injection. Then, the steady-state optimal power flow problem is formulated, considering the security constraints of the Wobbe index, the composition of hydrogen, and the Gross Calorific Value at various gas buses. Finally, the proposed technique is validated using IEEE 24-bus RTS and Belgium gas transmission system.

Author Keywords: integrated electricity and gas power flow

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Trading for Multiple Microgrids Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a stochastic programming based distributed method to solve optimal trading strategies among multiple microgrids (MGs) under uncertainty from wind power generations. Firstly, scenario generation and reduction technologies are adopted to predict and select the most representative scenarios of wind power automatically. Then, uncertainty from wind generations is integrated into the operating model of individual MGs and addressed by the stochastic programming method. Furthermore, in order to ensure the independence and privacy of energy trading processes, a distributed solution method is developed based on an alternating direction multiplier method. Finally, numerical tests with three MGs are implemented to show the effectiveness of the proposed distributed trading method.

articleTitle: Active Fault Current Limitation for VSC-MTDC System During Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous development of offshore wind farms (OWFs), voltage source converter based multi-terminal high voltage direct current (VSC-MTDC) system has become an effective and economical way to connect onshore mainland grid. However, with massive integration of OWFs, the VSC-MTDC system faces the challenge to avoid increasing system fault currents during frequency regulation. To solve this challenge, an active fault current limitation (AFCL) method is proposed for the frequency regulation of VSC-MTDC system. In the AFCL method, 1) an adaptive coefficient is conducted to suppress the fault current according to the current injected by VSC stations; 2) a coordinated control method based on virtual synchronous generator is developed to support frequency, in order to provide inertial for AC system. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed scheme for frequency support and AFCL are validated by case study.

articleTitle: Optimal Distribution Network Planning for Massive Distributed Resources Accommodation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of power technology, the penetration rate of different distributed resources in the distribution network continues to increase. In order to effectively reduce the impact of the high uncertainty of these distributed resources, distribution network managers need a faster and more efficient optimization method to plan the distribution network. Therefore, a new distributed algorithm-based Distribution Network Planning (DNP) method is proposed in this study. In the proposed planning method, two main parts of investment cost are comprehensively considered, construction cost and operation cost, an optimization model for distribution network planning is established and solved by the distributed Bias Min-consensus algorithm, which greatly improves the solution speed of the algorithm. Besides, k-means method is adopted to extract the set of uncertain scenarios. To evaluate the efficiency of the proposed method, a 24-node test system was used.

articleTitle: Dual Power Switching Sensing Method for Important Load Based on Power Line Carrier Impedance Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The problem of "dual power supply single meter" refers to that the important load adopts dual power supply, but only one electric energy meter is used for electric energy measurement. It makes difficult to determine which transformer area the electric energy consumption of this load is calculated in when the dual power supply is switched. In practice, due to the lack of cooperation between various departments, the dual power supply switching of important loads in the transformer area cannot be handled in time, resulting in unqualified line loss. This paper proposes a dual power switching sensing method for important load based on power line carrier impedance characteristics. When the dual power switching occurs, the network of the important load metering point changes. The change of input impedance of measuring point is sensed through the frequency sweep signal injected, so as to realize the automatic identification of dual power switching. By setting a reasonable threshold, several groups of confirmatory experiments proved the effectiveness and scientificity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Blind Source Separation of Vibration Signal of Single-channel Converter Transformer Based on CEEMDAN-KPCA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of the converter transformer is of great significance to the power system. The vibration signal on the surface of the converter transformer tank can well reflect its internal operating state. However, the vibration signals of the core and winding of the converter transformer are highly correlated, and there is a phenomenon of frequency aliasing. This paper proposes a blind source separation algorithm for the vibration signal of a single-channel converter transformer based on CEEMDAN-KPCA. The reliability of the algorithm is verified by means of simulation signal separation, actual converter transformer measurement signal analysis and unoptimized algorithm separation effect comparison, which is of great significance to converter transformer fault monitoring.

articleTitle: Energy Trading Strategies of Multiple Integrated Energy Service Providers Based on Cooperative Games
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of integrated energy system and its market operation, it is of great importance to investigate the energy interaction model and remain allocation of multiple integrated energy service providers (IESPs) in the market. This is why the centralized-decentralized trading model of IESPs based on cooperative games is constructed in this study. First, an energy management model for the integrated energy service providers is established based on which we develop the centralized-decentralized trading model of multiple IESPs based on cooperative games considering the IESPs joining the centralized trading and decentralized trading at the same time. Then the Sharpley Value and interactive power contribution method are adopted to realize the fair allocation of the alliance remaining.

articleTitle: Multi-frequency Dynamic Phasor Detection Based on Sparsity Adaptive Compression Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The widespread access to distributed energy sources leads to the generation of broadband dynamic signals in the distribution network, which seriously degrades the power quality of the system. However, the spectral interference between harmonics and interharmonics in broadband dynamic signals is more serious, and traditional methods are not able to accurately analyze broadband dynamic signals. Therefore, the combination of precise phasor measurement and the ability to analyze harmonic and interharmonic phasors becomes a great challenge. In this paper, a sparsity-based adaptive compressive sensing algorithm is proposed for estimating the Taylor-Fourier coefficients in a multi-frequency dynamic phasor model. The short-time Fourier transform phasor measurement results are corrected to improve the phasor measurement accuracy and identify the most relevant components of the signal. Later, the TFM method is validated using a composite test based on the test conditions of the synchronous phasor standard, and the simulation results are presented. The simulation results show that the algorithm of this paper has a higher accuracy in the estimation of harmonic phasor and maintains a certain superiority among the compared algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Charging Control of Electric Vehicles Considering Electricity Market Incentives and Frequency Limit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A large number of renewable energy resources connected to the power system brings great uncertainty to the operation. Therefore, the demand for frequency regulation resources is increased by independent system operators (ISO). In order to regulate the frequency of the power system, enhance the anti-interference ability of the power grid and handle emergency, this paper proposes a multi-time scale charging control for electric vehicle aggregation (EVA) to participate in frequency regulation in the electricity market, including the day-ahead dispatch and real-time emergency control. Electric vehicle (EV) charging demand is considered in all scales and EVA allocate power to individual EV by Benders decomposition. The method is verified by applying the historical data of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) market. The results show that the effect of frequency regulation is directly related to the quantity of the frequency regulation capacity. When an emergency occurs in the power system, EVA can provide emergency capacity to reduce the frequency deviation. This paper considers EV aggregator and ISO comprehensively, and provides a solution for their better interaction.

articleTitle: Research on the Practical Technology for Power Supply Reliability Improvement of 10kV Distribution Network Based on Short Insulating Stick Live Working
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Improving power supply reliability is an important measure to create high-quality life for the people and promote the high-quality development of the city. As an important part of uninterrupted operation, live working is a key technical method to improve the reliability of power supply in distribution network. In 2020, State Grid Shanghai Urban Electric Power Company (SUEPC) proposed Short Insulating Stick Live Working (SISLW) in distribution network for the first time in China. In addition, SUEPC participated in the development of a series of short insulating stick tools and led the working instructions for short insulating stick bridging and bypass live working. As a result, a systematic and standardized method of the SISLW for distribution network has been established. It filled the blank of live working in terms of short insulating stick in China. Compared with the hot stick working or the insulating glove working, the safety, rationality and feasibility of the SISLW, which greatly improves work efficiency and reduces the training time of operators, is validated by the engineering application. With the assistance of the SISLW, SUEPC became the first prefectural electric power company in China to achieve Average Service Availability Index (ASAI) of power supply reliability over 99.999% in 2020.

articleTitle: Static Security Assessment of Electric-gas Coupling System Using Equivalent Sign Function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A static security assessment method for electric-gas coupling system is proposed in this paper. When modeling natural gas systems, the generalized gas equations are improved by sign-function equivalent method, which simplifies the programming process for gas flow calculation. Considering the difference between the operation of the natural gas system and the electric power system, the impact of the gas system failure on the whole coupling system is transferred to the impact on the output of the coupled generation units. Therefore, the analysis of the contingency of the whole electric-gas coupling system can be focused on the N-1 analysis of the power grid, which can simplify the calculation and take into account both the failure of the gas system and power system at the same time. The proposed method was verified on a coupling test system which combined the IEEE 39-bus system and Belgium 20-node natural gas system. The results show that the static security assessment method can screen out the dangerous conditions in the electric-gas coupling system, which can provide certain guidance for the system operators and is of great significance for the security operation of the whole system.

articleTitle: Two-Level Optimal Day-ahead Scheduling Strategy for AC Aggregators Based on Single Load Temperature Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The use of a large number of air-conditioning loads in summer has become the main reason for the increase of peak-valley difference of power grid load. Using a large number of air-conditioning loads to participate in the peak cutting of power grid can greatly improve the characteristics of power grid in summer, which is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power grid. This article from the perspective of load aggregators, temperature control is proposed based on a single air conditioning load before the peak clipping two-level optimization scheduling strategy, the upper to load optimization goal of maximizing the interests of polymerization, the lower the minimum user does not comfort level as the optimization goal, using the sequential quadratic programming method and particle swarm algorithm based on the integer programming for a single specific regulation of the air conditioning load of the values, guarantee the poly Business interests and user comfort level, as well as the diversity of regulating behavior. The simulation results show that the proposed scheduling strategy is reasonable and effective, and has high practical value. Compared with the scheduling strategy based on packet control, aggregators have higher benefits and users have better comfort level.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Scenario Generation Based on Edge-Cloud Collaborative Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the expansion of the power system and the growth in renewable energy penetration, the installed capacity of distributed photovoltaics in the power system will increase significantly in the future, and the amount of related data will increase sharply in the future. Traditional centralized cloud management is difficult to afford the massive data processing business to guarantee service quality. This paper proposes an edge-cloud collaboration architecture based on Kubernetes. At the edge, we cluster the distributed photovoltaics to the nearby centralized photovoltaic power plants with strong correlation and synthesize as a virtual station. Subsequently, we use historical meteorological and power data to predict the next day power curve. At the cloud, we generate the scenarios for the centralized station based on the day-ahead power data uploaded by the edge, then we obtain the scenarios for distributed photovoltaic cluster by converting the scenarios of centralized station with the capacity conversion formula.

articleTitle: Risk Classification Assessment of Distribution Network With High Penetration Rate of Distributed New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: IEEE As a number of new energy sources are connected to distribution network, it has brought unavoidable risks to the distribution network. However, there is no risk assessment method for high-penetration new energy sources, and traditional risk assessment methods are difficult to quantitatively assess the risk. In order to accurately evaluate the operation risk of new energy distribution network with high penetration rate, a set of risk indicators is constructed from four aspects: voltage over-limit risk index, thermal stability over-limit risk index, dynamic stability over-limit risk index, and harmonic over-limit risk index. The evaluation index system of distribution network including new energy and high penetration rate, considering that there are many risk assessment indicators of distribution network, lack of intuition, and it is difficult to directly apply to actual planning and design work, the evaluation indicators are divided into three levels, using the entropy weight method assigns weights to the risk indicators of each level of the distribution network in turn, and then adds the standardized indicators by weight to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result of univariate quantification. Finally, through the test and analysis of standard examples, the validity and accuracy of the method proposed in this chapter are verified.

Author Keywords: New energy with high penetration rate

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of Pin Insulators Incipient Fault in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The waveform of cracked pin insulators’ incipient fault signals is often ignored in disturbance events, and it can easily transform into permanent faults such as explosion and disconnection. Exploring the dynamic arc development process of the cracked fault and capturing its waveform characteristics are the basis for detection and identification. Based on magnetohydrodynamics simulations and validation experiments, the waveform characteristics of arcing in the crack are explored. The results show that compared with the external surface discharge, the internal arc is less twisted, the heat dissipated power is small, the time of forming surface flashover is short, and the variance ratio of current is high. The results laid a foundation for further research of cracked pin insulators’ incipient fault.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Load Disaggregation Based on Multiple Optimization of Appliance Features and CNN-NLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Non-intrusive load disaggregation technology can effectively mine customer-side appliance information, which is the basis for the grid to carry out interactive customer load response. In this paper, a non-intrusive load disaggregation model with multiple optimization selection of appliance characteristics is proposed. First, an adaptive sliding data window is designed for appliance operation characteristics to obtain a more complete power segment and adjust the network input and output dimensions. Second, extracting and deepening appliance features by fusing shallow convolutional neural networks (CNN) with two-layer nested long and short-term memory networks (NLSTM). Finally, experimental analysis on the REDD dataset shows that the multiple selection, deepening and reuse of appliance features significantly improve the accuracy of load decomposition while reducing training time.

Author Keywords: nested long and short-term memory network

articleTitle: Research on Grid-friendly Control Methodology of Direct-drive Wind Turbine Set
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Rapid development of power electronics technology has boosted the development of clean energy to a new height, but also brought a series of power quality problems which even threat the stable operation of power grid. Resonance caused by grid-connected wind turbines and the lag problem of discrete control systems gradually intensify with the increase of number of grid-connected units. Thus, a grid friendly control methodology of direct-drive wind turbine is researched in this paper. Considering the delay of capacitor current feedback and discretization control system, a repetitive predictive control strategy is proposed to improve its stability and controllability, whose effectiveness is verified by simulation and physical test.

articleTitle: Visual Calibrator for Configuration File of Intelligent Substation Reconstruction and Expansion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper introduces a visual calibrator for configuration file of intelligent substation reconstruction and expansion based on Linux system, which can realize the comparison of SCD file and configuration file of bus protection process layer before and after intelligent substation reconstruction and expansion, and prevent the occurrence of wrong modification of bus protection configuration file. Firstly, this paper introduces the overall architecture of the calibrator, including the visual calibration module of reconstructed and expanded equipment and the interval calibration module of process layer configuration file; Then it focuses on the function and mechanism of the core cyclic redundancy check module of the calibrator. The Visual verification module and configuration file interval verification module realize the comparison of SCD files and bus protection configuration files by calling the core cyclic redundancy verification module; Finally, the function and application effect of the calibrator are demonstrated by applying it in the reconstruction and expansion of a substation. The visual calibrator for the configuration file of intelligent substation reconstruction and expansion lays a foundation for the realization of intelligent operation inspection of intelligent substation.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Distribution Network with the Improved Deep Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the sustainable goal, a large number of renewable energy and non-traditional loads, such as electric vehicles and etc., bring many challenges to the power stability and reliability of distribution network. Distribution network state estimation can make the staff receive the state of the power grid in real time and provide the data basis for the subsequent optimization scheduling. It is of great significance to carry out research on distribution network state estimation. Therefore, aiming at the characteristics of poor observability and large fluctuation of distribution network, this paper puts forward a state estimation method for distribution network based on improved residual network (ResNet). In the offline training stage, the neural network is trained by collecting historical data, and the mapping between input and output is constructed. In the online application stage, the real-time measurement data is injected into the model obtained from offline training to complete the real-time state estimation of the distribution network. Simulation results on IEEE 33 standard system show that the proposed method, which expected to play a role in real-time state estimation of distribution network next, has better estimation accuracy and robustness than other methods.

articleTitle: Robust Day-ahead Optimization Scheduling Model for Regional Network with High Proportion of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, in order to promote the realization of dual carbon goal of China, many high-energy-consuming enterprises have chosen to build their own regional grids with high proportion of renewable energy to reduce environmental pollution. To decrease the impact of the renewable generation on the local power grid, some high-energy-consuming enterprises choose a combined operation mode of the regional grid as 'isolated + connected' gird, that is, the high-energy-consuming load will be supplied by an isolated grid and connected gird at the same time. Either of the grid cannot accomodate the fluctuation of renewable energy, the load will be transferred between the two grids to maintain power balance. Based on the operation characteristics of such regional power grids of high-energy-consuming enterprises, this paper proposes a dispatching method that considers the uncertainty of wind power output in the decision-making stage in the day-ahead, so as to optimize the start-stop status of the units and the grid-connected mode of the load. The model is modeled by the method of affine tunable robust optimization and solved by dual transformation. Finally, combined with the actual network structure and operation mode of a heavy-load electrolytic aluminum enterprise in Northeast China, the simulation results verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Simulation Platform Based on Mutual Load Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Nowadays, most of transformers working in fault simulation platform operate at rated voltage. In addition, research on the platform mostly focuses on partial discharge fault. In order to be closer to the real operating conditions of the transformer, more comprehensive research should be done on the reproduction of the rated operating conditions of the transformer and the simulation of transformer faults, such as winding deformation and overheating faults. The mutual load method is used to build a platform in which the transformer operates at rated voltage and current. On this basis, four typical transformer fault simulation schemes are designed. Faults set in the platform include a variety of typical faults, such as partial discharge, winding deformation, multi-point grounding of the iron core, etc. Construction of the platform may promote the research of transformer fault simulation and corresponding defect detection.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Virtual Impedance Adjustment Based on Average Consistency Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The independent and stable operation of micro-grid provides technical guarantee for Self-Sustained Highway. At present, there is a contradiction between voltage and power regulation in traditional secondary control. In this paper, a virtual impedance adaptive adjustment based on consistency algorithm is proposed to solve the above problems. Firstly, adjacent DGs communicate to exchange information of real-time power. Calculating compensation from adaptive impedance layer with consistency algorithm. The deviation of primary control is adjusted by dynamic virtual impedance. This method can distribute active power according to capacity, and reduce the voltage deviation at the same time. The effectiveness of the method is validated by the simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: A Medium and Long Term Orderly Charging Load Planning Method for Electric Vehicles in Residential Areas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The orderly charging load forecasting for Electric Vehicles (EVs) in urban residential areas(RAs) is of significance for planning the charging facilities and analyzing the load carrying capacity of distribution network as well as its expansion and reconstruction. In this paper, a mid-and long-term load forecasting method for EVs orderly charging in RAs is proposed based on the number and charging probability of EVs. Nonlinear programming is used to solve the optimization objective function of orderly charging, and the typical daily load characteristics in urban RAs are used to forecast the orderly charging load of EVs and the overall load in the station area on working days and at weekends in the past three years and the target year. Simulation results show that orderly charging can improve the capability of distribution network in residential areas to accommodate EVs and postpone its upgrade and reconstruction time.

articleTitle: An Optimal Method for Locating and Sizing Distributed Generations Considering Critical Infrastructures Interconnection for Urban Distribution Network Restoration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The urban distribution network will separated from the large-scale centralized power system when disasters occur, causing a series of internal random faults and resulting in serious shortage of energy supply. Distributed Generations (DGs) with renewable energy is significant to restore critical loads and the energy supplying of important interconnected infrastructures to maintain the operation of cities. This paper proposes an optimization method for locating and sizing DGs: (1) Monte Carlo simulation to set faulted scenarios of the urban distribution network after disasters. (2) A mixed integer second-order cone program (MISOCP) is proposed to minimize the number and capacity of DGs, considering the constraints of DGs, water supply network, distribution network and water-electricity coupling relationship. (3) Representative planning solutions are selected from the aspects of power supply reliability, DGs configuration economy, and faulted lines severity. (4) It is proved that the optimization method is effective, multiple-selectivity and forward-looking for the loads restoration and emergency response after disasters, so as to promote the sustainable development of cities with DGs’ low-carbon and flexibility.

Author Keywords: distributed generations with renewable energy sources

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Grid-connected and Islanding Operation for Turbo-generator Units Based on Improved Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to improve the regulating ability of turbo-generator units under different operation conditions, a control strategy of grid-connected and islanding operation for the unit based on fuzzy PID controller is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of steam turbine and its regulating system is established, and then the structural characteristics and control performance of different control modes are analyzed in detail. Based on this, corresponding control strategies are selected to meet different control objectives of units under grid-connected and islanding operation. At the same time, this paper improves the fuzzy PID controller using particle swarm optimization algorithm with the intention of improving the dynamic response ability of the unit, in which the PID parameters can be adjusted adaptively in real time based on the optimized initial parameters. Finally, the grid-connected and islanding operating states of the unit are simulated and various kinds of disturbances are set. The results show that the proposed control strategy can meet the control requirements of the unit under different operation conditions, and the improved fuzzy PID controller has good performance.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of International Power Grid Development and Carbon Neutral Development Roadmap
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper established an index system of power grid development level, covering six Level 1 dimensions of scale and speed, safety and quality, coordinated development, low-carbon development, service capacity and intelligent level, and incorporating 18 quantifiable indexes belonging to source, network or load side, to comprehensively and quantitatively evaluate the power grid development level. Power grids in various countries are at different stages of development. Developed economies outperform developing economies in terms of power grid safety and quality and low-carbon development level, while the latter boast certain strengths in power grid development speed and electricity price level. China occupies a leading position in the world in terms of power grid development. Under the goal of carbon neutrality, some countries have studied and formulated the low-carbon development goal of power system and the development path of power grid.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Power Stations Modeling and Analysis of Influence on Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to clean and efficient characteristics, distributed photovoltaic (DPV) power stations have developed rapidly. A large number of DPV power stations are connected to the distribution network, which leads to many problems. This paper focuses on analyzing the impact of DPV power stations on the influence of distribution network voltage. In this paper, DPV power station model firstly is established, and then the influence mechanism of node voltage is studied after DPV power stations connected from the perspective of voltage variety. A detailed model of DPV power station and IEEE33 node model containing DPV power stations are built in PSCAD\EMTDC, and the influence of DPV on distribution network voltage is simulated and analyzed when DPV power stations are connected in different scenarios with different penetrations. The simulation results show that DPV power stations have a certain lifting effect on the node voltage of the distribution network, which lays the foundation for the further development of DPV.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Gas-Electric Coupling System Considering Gas Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The gas-fired unit in the gas-electric coupling system is used as the load of the gas network, and its working state will be subject to the operation state and gas supply strategy of the natural gas system. So, the assessment of power grid risk must take into account the influence of the reliability of the gas network. In this paper, the gas-electric coupling system is modeled, the sequential Monte Carlo method is applied to simulate the natural gas network fault, and the gas supply flow is calculated for the pipeline network in different scenarios. The uncertainty of natural gas supply caused by the fault is transmitted to the grid side, and the risk evaluation index of the power system is established. Combined with specific examples, the risk assessment of node voltage and line load is carried out.

articleTitle: Enhanced Voltage Control in Distribution Networks: A Data-driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Traditional voltage/var control(VVC) method assume the prerequisite of an exact distribution network(DN) model that keep unchanged during the whole control period, which may not hold in practice. In this paper, we proposed a data-driven enhanced voltage/var control algorithm(DaE-VVC) to regulate voltage profiles in DN with an incomplete model. The proposed method can estimate the DN topology and line parameter with satisfactory accuracy using the measurements of bus voltages and real/reactive power injections. The proposed algorithm can be integrated into the centralized control center without any additional hardware cost. Case studies on balanced modified IEEE-33 bus system demonstrate the performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: S-SCDN Concept and Its Situation Awareness Visualization Application Scenario Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Substation centralized medium voltage distribution network (SCDN), makes the large-scale complex medium voltage network into a dynamic radial network with a fixed static topology and a central substation as a unique power supply source. A novel concept of “Supply Region of substation centralized medium voltage distribution network (S-SCDN)” is proposed to generate a “one map” as the core technology of the “urban distribution network brain”. The prototype of SCDN and S-SCDN and single line diagram prototype are proposed, and their basic characteristics are studied. Then, the application scenario analysis based on S-SCDN single line diagram including a situation awareness dynamic visualization platform under SCDN/S-SCDN concepts is also proposed, which indicates that S-SCDN single line diagram provides a new analysis tool for urban complex distribution network with a wide application.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Location Algorithm for Hybrid Lines Based on Corrected Travelling Wave Time Intervals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution hybrid lines, especially the underground cable sections, require higher fault location accuracy. Researches have shown that the length error of overhead lines has little effect on the online measurement of cable wave velocity, while the impact on the fault section identification process cannot be ignored, and the error factor of the overhead line length need to be considered to implement the correction of the time interval; utilize the fault point-section terminal (FST) fault location mode to replace the conventional fault point-line terminal (FLT) mode can effectively eliminate the fault location error and the offset of the line inspection point caused by the length error of the overhead line. Based on the above analysis, this paper proposes a corrected time interval and FST mode based travelling wave fault location algorithm for hybrid lines. The line inspection points could be accurately located by utilizing the actual measured time difference of the initial fault travelling wave reaching the measuring end and the corresponding fault section of each corrected time interval, and combining the online actual measured cable wave velocity under the condition of considering the length error of the overhead line. The simulation results indicate that the method can effectively implement the fault location of the hybrid line of the distribution network, and the result of which is accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Optimization of Regional Integrated Energy System Cluster Based on Multi-agent Game
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The regional integrated energy system cluster is of positive significance for the development of the low-carbon power system through multi-source integration and multi-regional coordination. Aiming at the defect that the centralized optimal dispatching method cannot reveal the interests of multi-agent, and to protect the privacy of participants, a distributed cluster optimization model based on multi-agent game is proposed in this paper. A stackelberg game with the operator as the leader and the regional integrated energy system as the follower is established. The operator can improve its profit by adjusting the internal electricity pricing strategy. On the basis of realizing internal power optimization, each region is regarded as a prosumer to participate in intra-cluster transaction, so as to achieve cluster coordinated optimization. Then, the validity of the method proposed in this paper is verified by a case analysis, which provides a reference for the optimization of the integrated energy system cluster.

articleTitle: Incentive Demand Response Considering Life Degradation of Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To promote the development of the power market in China, the participation of demand response in the power market is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper designs a trading mechanism and clearing model which is suitable for the current power spot market in China considering incentive demand response and energy storage refinement model. First, according to the bidding information, the spot market bidding model with incentive demand response is constructed and the market-clearing model with incentive demand response is proposed. Then, to minimize the generation cost, the energy storage and power unit are coordinated and optimized Finally, an example is given to verify the practicability of the proposed method and the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Reactive Power and Voltage Control Strategy for Regional Power Grids with High Penetration of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy brings a great challenge to the voltage stability and reactive power balance of power grids. Unpredictable, intermittent, and irregular renewable energy sources can amplify the voltage fluctuations greatly. Thus the problem of power surplus emerges more frequently, leading to a more difficult control task. For renewable energy power plants in certain locations, it is beneficial to make use of the seasonal information and the pattern of power generation during the day or night. Meanwhile, the utilization of the traditional Automatic Voltage Control (AVC) and the coordination of the reactive power resources among different power plants can help to maintain the reactive power balance and the voltage stability in the regional power grids. Therefore, this work establishes a reactive power and voltage distribution model for the renewable energy power plants. Furthermore, based on this model, it proposes a coordinated control strategy for reactive power and voltage, by taking into account the coordination of various time scales as well as multiple reactive power resources. It has been shown to achieve a more stable control for reactive power and voltage in regional power grids. The results are validated via comprehensive simulation studies.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Frequency Regulation Reserve with Multi-aspect and Multi-level Performance-based Reserve Requirement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Frequency regulation reserve in auxiliary service of power grid are mainly provided by traditional units such as thermal and hydro generation units. With the rapid development of renewable energy, various load side resources also have potential to provide frequency regulation reserve. Yet, they have differences in frequency regulation performance. Distinguished from the method of setting entry threshold in the existing market, this paper establishes multi-aspect and multi-level performance-based constraints, and proposes an optimal dispatch of frequency regulation reserve with multi-aspect and multi-level performance-based reserve requirement, which achieves optimal combination of various frequency regulation resources for meeting multi-aspect and multi-level performance requirements. The simulation case study verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Power Supply Cloudsim: An Extension of CloudSim for Modeling and Simulation of Power Supply Devices in Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the number of internet data centers (IDC) increases, the energy consumption of modern data centers is growing rapidly, which takes an increasing part of global electricity consumption. The data center load, as a flexible electricity load which can be scheduled spatially and temporally is increasingly drawing attentions in the research of demand response and distributed network planning. However, there are hardly software which is dedicated to simulating the electrical characteristics of data centers, and most of the existing data center simulation software ignores the characteristics of data center power supply devices, which is not fit for verifying the demand response method proposed by the researches in electrical field. In view of this, we modified the most popular data center simulation software CloudSim by adding modules which can model the data center power supply system. A simulation of a typical day is implemented on the modified platform, which has verify the effectiveness of the modified software.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Strategy of Wind-Solar-Hydro Power Generation System Based on Pre-day and Real-Time Two Stage Joint Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the short-term uncertainty of active power output of wind power and solar power, the power generation plan cannot guide the actual operation of multi-energy power system accurately. The model proposed in this paper includes two stages: current-ahead plan and real-time correction. The current-ahead plan gives the unit combination results and planned output curve of conventional units. The real-time stage describes the uncertainty of power system in a typical scene and corrects it based on the day-ahead results. Through the integrated optimization, pre-ahead plan can take into account the actual error scenarios, and the optimal operating cost can be obtained. Using a new energy base in southwest China as a practical example, the optimal joint optimization results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Temperature Prediction of Box-type Transformer High-Voltage Bushing Based on ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of high temperature of transformer components and high accident rate of transformer bushing caused by closed environment and poor heat dissipation performance of box-type transformer, a prediction method of high-voltage bushing temperature of box-type transformer based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed. Firstly, the sliding window method is used to construct the sample sets. Then, a transformer high-voltage bushing temperature prediction model based on ELM is established. ELM model has fast learning speed and good generalization performance. Finally, taking the relevant monitoring data of high-voltage bushing of a box-type transformer as an example, the field data are preprocessed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through analysis, and the effects of the number of hidden layer neurons, activation function and sliding window width on the prediction effect are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Building EV Chargers to Provide Reactive Power Compensation for Urban Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As electric vehicles (EVs) are widely promoted as an important way to reduce carbon emissions, the number of chargers is also increasing. However, the low utilization rate of chargers causes a waste of resources, so it is urgent to tap its potential and expand its application scenarios. In addition, as a large number of renewable energy sources and EVs are connected to distribution networks (DNs), the uncertainty of source and load causes frequent fluctuations in DNs which increases the demand for voltage regulation. In order to improve the utilization rate of chargers and solve the problem of off-limit voltage, a control strategy of chargers participating in DNs voltage regulation considering demand response is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the model of the charger and reactive power model is established. Then, the active power control strategy of chargers considering demand response is proposed, and the selection process is constructed according to users' wishes. Finally, the voltage regulation strategy of the charger is proposed and its feasibility is verified by simulation. The results of this paper can be used for reactive power compensation of DNs considering the demand-side response.

articleTitle: Virtual Inertia Control for Renewable Energy Integration Based on the Improved SOGI-FLL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The combined inertia control based on the frequency difference and frequency derivative is an effective control method for the grid-following converters to participate in the frequency regulation. The accurate detection of the frequency difference and frequency derivative is the key to improving the stability of the converts’ combined virtual inertia control. The second-order generalized integrator-based frequency-locked loop (SOGI-FLL) is able to directly detect the frequency derivative, but in the case when the harmonic content in the voltage signal is high, the detection of the frequency derivative will be interfered. Therefore, this paper proposes a virtual inertia control method based on the improved SOGI-FLL. By adding the front-end cascaded SOGI-FLL, the interference from harmonics on the frequency derivative is eliminated. In addition, the PSCAD simulation are performed to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Location Algorithm for Hybrid Lines Considering Online Cable Wave Velocity Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A novel double ended fault location algorithm for hybrid lines in distribution network was proposed in this paper. After analyzing the characteristic of traveling waves in hybrid lines, some conclusions have been made as follow: Length error of over head line has little influence on wave speed calculation on line; Fault point-section terminal location mode which can decrease location error caused by line length error, has been adopted instead of fault point-line terminal mode. According to the conclusions above, a new algorithm for novel algorithm for hybrid lines travelling wave fault location was presented. Simulation results show that this algorithm can locate the fault point effectively, and has a high value of application.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Ground Fault Identification Model via Feature Extraction and AdaBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The paper presents single-phase grounding fault calculation algorithm is prone to influences from operation modes and configuration parameters. To solve such problems, this paper proposes a novel calculation method based on physical model-machine learning compound drive. First, the feature project is established based on the zero-sequence circuit.
