And the planning results reveal the prospects and potential of this model in achieving a low-carbon power system.

articleTitle: Study on the Typical Business Model of Clean Energy Utilization System Based on Flexible Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the background of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals and energy Internet, the grid connection of a high proportion of clean energy generating units leads to a significant increase in the randomness and uncertainty of the power system. To ensure the supply-demand balance and economic operation of the power system, we should first systematically sort out and clarify the callable flexible resources on each side of "source-network-load", build a clean energy utilization system, and then design a reasonable business model to stimulate all kinds of flexible resources to deeply participate in the market, realize their flexibility value, and improve the regulating ability of the system at the same time. Then, we design a reasonable business model and stimulate all kinds of flexibility resources to participate in the market, realize their flexibility value, and improve the regulating ability of the system. In this paper, we study the market trend of flexible resources, starting from the types, characteristics, roles, and commodity properties of source-network-load flexible resources, and design the business model and general architecture of the clean energy utilization system in the physical layer, information layer and service layer of the energy Internet. The proposed business model, transaction path, and overall architecture will provide a path and decision support for the clean energy utilization system based on flexible resources to participate in market competition and improve the system resource optimization allocation and service capability.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Information Mining Method for Defect Record of Traction Power Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The defect record of traction power supply equipment not only describes the defect situation of the equipment, but also provides historical experience for the defect treatment of similar equipment. The recognition of named entity information of the defect record is the premise of constructing the knowledge graph. In order to mine the entity information of defect records more efficiently and accurately, this paper proposes a named entity recognition algorithm to solve the current situation of lack of utilization and analysis of defect records of traction power supply equipment and low efficiency of manual information processing modes. The bidirectional encoder representation from transformers (BERT) pre-training language model is used as the encoding layer of the word vector, the bidirectional long short term memory (BiLSTM) is used as the character label prediction layer, and the conditional random field (CRF) is used to output the global optimal label. The defect records of the traction power supply equipment of a maintenance department from 2016 to 2019 are used as the data set for case study, and, the comprehensive evaluation index of entity recognition of the model has reached 94.66%, saving 98.50% time compared with manual recognition. The results show that the entity information recognition algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively and accurately mine the defect record information of traction power supply equipment.

articleTitle: Planning Method of Fast Charging Station for Urban Commercial Vehicles with Fine Road Network Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Increasing the proportion of electric vehicles (EVs) is conducive to energy conservation, emission reduction and national energy security. Commercial vehicles, including taxis and ride-hailing, are important part of EVs. At present, the bottleneck of the development of EVs lies in the limitation of the distribution of fast charging stations, so it is necessary to put forward the planning method of urban fast charging stations serving commercial vehicles. In this paper, origin-destination matrix based on gravity model and actual road information is used to establish a fine road network model. This paper models fast charging demand, establishes the user charging decision-making model, measures the user charging waiting cost based on queuing theory, and establishes a two-layer solving model with the goal of optimizing the comprehensive economy of distribution network, charging station operators and owners. A heuristic algorithm is used to solve the problem, and an example is given to verify the effectiveness and usability of the planning method.

articleTitle: MPC-Based Virtual Synchronous Generator for LVRT Capability Enhancement of DFIG-Based Wind Farm with Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: More and more large-scale wind farms are interfaced into the power grid to achieve sustainable development and environmental protection, and the penetration rate of wind power generation in the power system is increasing. To improve the frequency support ability of wind turbines (WTs) and weaken the adverse effect of phase locked loop, virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control of WTs is in the ascendant. However, the VSG-controlled doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm does not have sufficient capability to ride-through grid faults such as voltage drops. In this paper, a model predictive control-based VSG control for DFIG is proposed, which can limit the current surge and accelerate the decay of the transient flux component under symmetrical voltage faults and suppress the transient and negative sequence rotor current components under asymmetrical voltage faults. At the same time, a calculation method of power reference values of DFIGs and battery energy storage system under voltage faults is proposed, which can reduce the decline of wind farm output active power while providing the required reactive current to the power grid. Finally, simulation and experimental results verify that the proposed control strategy is effective in enhancing the low-voltage ride through capability of DFIG-Based wind farms.

articleTitle: Flexibility Oriented Combined Heat and Power Dispatch under Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The flexible resources of district heating system (DHS) can effectively cope with the fluctuation of photovoltaic (PV) output and improve the security of electric power network. A stochastic optimization method is proposed in this paper for power distribution network with high penetration of PV based on probabilistic forecasting and aggregate flexibility of DHS. Firstly, an adaptive robust optimization framework is used to aggregate the flexible resources of DHS, and the heat output interval is derived to achieve the decoupling of integrated electric-heating system. Then, the PV forecasting result is obtained by nonparametric probabilistic forecasting. Accordingly, PV scenarios with temporal correlation are acquired using Copula formulations. Based on the typical PV scenarios and aggregate flexibility of DHS, the stochastic optimization for combined heat and power dispatch is established. The case study demonstrates the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: System Design of Risk Assessment in Power Market
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the modernization of the society and the advancement of power market, it is increasingly important for power trading operators to correctly and accurately identify the risks in the power market. This paper presents a systematic approach to study the degree of risk in the electricity market. The system is divided into three parts, namely power market risk identification based on K-fold cross-validation and Stacking fusion, power market risk analysis based on logical reasoning and improved evidence theory, and power market risk level assessment based on Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA). In simulation, the algorithm example validates, compares, and illustrates the effectiveness and accuracy of the system. Conclusion: It is demonstrated that studying from multiple perspectives and avoiding too much expert scoring can improve the accuracy of the power market force risk assessment system.

articleTitle: Architecture and Function Design of Virtual Power Plant Operation Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the architecture and function design of the virtual power plant operation management platform of China Southern Power Grid. Firstly, the business process of virtual power plant operation management platform is designed, then the system construction principles, overall architecture and functional application are proposed, adapting to multiple types of resources, multiple application scenarios, and multiple interaction subjects. A new power dispatching mode considering aggregation optimization, flexible dispatch and market operation of massive decentralized and adjustable resources, providing technical support for the business development of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Regional Development Stage Division Method Based on LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the differences in resource endowments and development foundations, the development trends of regions are different. As the electricity transmitted by the power grid continues to increase, accurately predicting the development trend of regional power grids under limited data and dividing the development stages of power grids can effectively identify the needs of power grid construction and investment in different regions. To accurately identify regional development potential and optimize power grid decision-making, a regional development stage division method based on long short-term memory (LSTM) model is proposed. Firstly, the historical data of power grid development in each region is collected. Secondly, the data is divided into test set and training set, and input to the LSTM unit for data prediction to form an LSTM development prediction model. Taking the historical development data of power grids in different regions as input, the LSTM model is used to predict the development data and form the regional development curve. The principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimensionality of the high-dimensional development data. The Logistic growth curve model is used to fit the development data and divide the development stages of the regional power grid. Finally, three typical cities are used as practical examples to analyze the applicability of the method.

articleTitle: A Method for Distributed Robust Optimization Considering the Uncertainty of Source and Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the implementation of the dual carbon policy, the penetration rate of renewable energy in the power system has gradually increased. At the same time, some flexible loads also show uncertainty, and the two-way interaction between loads and renewable energy becomes more and more frequent, which brings great challenges to the forecast, dispatch and operation of new power systems. Given the above problems, considering the uncertainty of new energy output and load, based on the probability prediction theory, a probabilistic power flow model at both ends of source and load is proposed. By introducing conditional value-at-risk, a distributed robust optimal scheduling method considering the economy, safety, and low carbon is proposed, taking into account the efficiency and robustness of the solution. Finally, the feasibility and practicability of the proposed algorithm are verified through the improved 11 nodes, and the influence of Wasserstein radius and risk coefficient on scheduling is analyzed. Dispatchers can choose different parameters to obtain the optimal scheduling plan according to the actual situation.

articleTitle: Degradation Cost-Minimization Method on Net-Zero Energy Architectures with Intelligent Parking Lot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Net-zero energy architectures integrating renewable sources, electric-hydrogen hybrid energy storage system (HESS) and zero-emission vehicles can play a vital role in the future low-carbon society. Considering the diversity of electric vehicle charging types, and the service life of HESS will affect the power distribution of the net-zero energy architectures, this paper proposes a degradation cost-minimization method combined with the intelligent parking lot (IPL) for economic power-allocating. Finally, we verify the adaptability and economic advantages of the proposed method in random charging scenarios and analyze the impact of charging types on optimal scheduling.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of Park-Level Multi-energy Systems with Gas-Heat Energy Storages
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As a means to increase the consumption rate of clean energy, the park-level multi-energy system (MES) is being paid more and more attention by scholars. This paper proposes a day-ahead economic dispatch of park-level multi-energy system with gas-heat energy storages and high penetration of renewable generation. In this paper, the objective function of the MES is established, and the related constraints are described. The operation of the MES when there are gas storage equipment and heat storage equipment, as well as power-to-gas equipment is also discussed. The proposed mathematical model is established using MATLAB and solved by Gurobi. We also observe the operation mode and the cost of the MES under different renewable energy penetration rates. It is concluded that the presence of energy storage and energy storage capacity help to increase the consumption ratio of wind and solar energy.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimal Scheduling of Rural Integrated Energy System Considering the Uncertainty of Wind-Solar-Load Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of "carbon peaking and carbon neutrality" target and further promotion of the rural revitalization strategy, the efficient and environmentally friendly energy use in rural areas has attracted widespread attention. Therefore, this paper studies the optimal operation of rural parks. Firstly, the steady-state models of rural park such as biomass combined heat and power, ground-source heat pump and other multi-energy devices are established. In order to reduce the influence brought by the uncertainty of wind-solar-load power, the output models of wind-solar-load power considering the prediction error are established and a scenario optimal method is proposed. Then, the stochastic optimization model of the rural integrated energy system is constructed with the objective function of maximizing the expected revenue of park operators in multiple scenarios. Finally, a rural park in Shanghai is taken as an example and the result shows that the scenario optimization method considering the uncertainty of wind-solar-load power increases daily revenue of the rural park operator by 441.4 yuan compared with the worst case without scenario optimization, which proves that the scheme can effectively improve the revenue of rural park operators.

articleTitle: Topology Identification in LV Distribution Network Based on SAE and Modified DBSCAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The mistakes in topology records of low voltage distribution network influence the economic operation of the power grid. However, most existing methods to detect the customers who do not match the records are not always reliable and can’t realize automatic identification. This paper proposes an identification method based on stacked autoencoder (SAE) and modified Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN). SAE is applied to reduce the data dimensions and extract nonlinear feature vectors from voltage time series. The modified DBSCAN can adjust parameters adaptively and cluster the feature vectors to identify the customers with wrong transformer connectivity, which improves the automation management level in distribution network. Case studies on real datasets have verified that the proposed method has high identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Coordination and Optimization Scheduling Strategy for Distribution Network Based on Composite Demand Side Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: How to improve the level of renewable energy consumption is the bottleneck of the vigorously developing of renewable energy. Distribution network has a certain amount of flexible load resources, how to effectively use these resources to fully absorb renewable energy and reduce the operation cost of power network is one of the research hotspots. The traditional time-of-use pricing policy is a rough demand side management mode for large regional distribution network, which has poor adaptability to regional load and power characteristics. In this paper, a control strategy of composite demand side response is proposed to further improve the regional photovoltaic consumption level. Firstly, the incentive demand response (IDR) is used to re-divide time-of-use price peak and valley periods based on user load curve and photovoltaic (PV) output curve. Then, based on the dissatisfaction function, the demand-side response model of reducible load and time-shifting load is modeled, and the adjustment range calculation method of user load is derived. Finally, based on the above results, centralized scheduling control is carried out by the dispatching center, and an optimal scheduling model is established to minimize the PV discarded and system operating cost. At last, the validity of the method is illustrated by examples.

articleTitle: Economic Evaluation of Grid-side Energy Storage Trading on Multiple Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The rapid growth of renewable installation poses new challenges to the stability of power grids. Energy storage is a promising technology to reduce the impact of high renewable penetration. Grid operators are investing in more storage facilities to enhance the reliability of their power grids. The profitability of energy storage projects is vital to capital recovery. Some believed grid operators as the system operator has already charged fees for providing stable and reliable transmission services, and they should not gain profits from electricity markets. China has decided to allow grid-owned energy storage to engage in market trade. This movement opens up another question about how to efficiently run these storage systems and benefit from market trade. This paper performs a cost-benefit analysis for grid energy storage when participating in electricity markets in China.

articleTitle: Construction and Verification of AGC Full-Time Dynamic Simulation Models for Cross-Level and Multi-Region Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the existing simulation software cannot accurately simulate the characteristics and control effect of the cross-level and multi-region AGC system, an AGC model suitable for the electromechanical transient, medium and dynamic simulation of the long-term power system is proposed.The model includes a three-layer structure with master station side, power plant (centralized control) the side, and the unit side. supports to customize regional control strategies for each power grid, including the Fixed Frequency Control (FFC), the Fixed Tie-line power control(FTC) and the Tie-line Load and Bias Control(TBC). Various AGC Frequency instruction allocation methods such as priority and specified ratio. Its regulating quantity can be allocated by priority mode and fixed proportion mode. The model is implemented in the full-time dynamic simulation program power system (PSD-FDS), and the accuracy of the model is verified of China based on the PMU data in an asynchronous test of Southwest Power Grid. The simulation results show that the model can provide an effective simulation method for system frequency and tie-line power control and the AGC strategy optimization.

articleTitle: A Review on the Research Methods for Suppressing Conducted Disturbance in Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the recent development in power electronic technologies, designers and manufacturers intend to increase the switching frequencies to achieve smaller size of the converter. However, the high currents gradient di/dt and high voltage gradient du/dt in the circuits will generate high differential mode (DM) noise and common mode (CM) noise, which seriously affect the normal operation of the equipment and adjacent other equipment. So it is necessary to study the methods of conducted disturbance suppression in drive system. The methods are broadly classified based on two criteria. One is the reduction of the conducted disturbance after generation. The other is the reduction of the conducted disturbance at the generation stage itself. This paper also discusses the characteristics and application prospects of the above suppression methods. In the end, this paper clarifies the principles that should be considered when adopting different conducted disturbance suppression methods in practice. The study in this paper can contribute to the further development and practical application of the conducted disturbance suppression methods of drive system.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation of a Multi-port Power Electronic Transformer System in Multiple Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Increment of intermittent renewable energy sources (RESs) and uncertain load demands in the power electronic transformer (PET) system challenges the existing operation and market clearing strategies. To cope with the above challenges, this paper proposes a novel two-stage coordinated operation strategy for the PET system to address the bi-level clearing problem in multiple markets. In the first stage, an optimal bidding scheme for the PET system in day-ahead energy and reserve markets is formulated to maximize the expected profit, considering the uncertainties of the output power from RES and the demands from loads in the balancing market. In the second stage, a real-time bidding scheme is developed for the PET system in the intra-day balancing market. The proposed two-stage operation strategy is formulated as a bi-level stochastic optimization problem. Karush–Kuhn–Tucker conditions and duality theory are used to convert the proposed nonlinear bi-level problem into a linear single-level one. Numerical studies show the effectiveness of the proposed strategy and its solution methodology.

articleTitle: Real-Time Pricing Strategy for EV Charging Station Alliances Based on Mobile Online Information Interaction Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Currently, the majority of public energy-supplying facilities for EVs (electric vehicles) are EVCSs (electric vehicle charging stations). By analyzing the recent competitive complexion of charging service providers, a deduction is made that the EVCSs are organized as alliances, whose decisions are basically motivated by the objective of revenue. Based on this deduction, a mobile online information interaction framework for EVs and EVCSs is constructed, which is a low-delay real-time mobile application with no tendentiousness. Within the framework, the objectives of EVs and EVCSs are modeled, and the digital map service is integrated as the basis of user service while improving the precision of the mathematical model of the driving process. Furthermore, a real-time pricing strategy for CSAs (charging station alliances) is proposed, and a modified PSO (particle swarm optimization) algorithm is applied to solve the model. Finally, a case study in a real urban area is implemented to verify the practicability of the framework and the effectiveness of the pricing strategy.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Interval Optimization Method for Urban Integrated Energy System Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy sources, the operation of urban integrated energy system faces significant uncertainty. To promote the high proportion of renewable energy sources in urban integrated energy system, this paper proposes a hybrid interval optimization method, realizing flexible resources cooperative optimization under multiple uncertainties. Firstly, the dispatch model of user-side flexible resources is constructed considering aggregation feature. Then, the range of interactive power between urban distribution network and superior power grid is optimized considering building parameters, renewable energy sources and load uncertainties. Finally, the test results show that the proposed hybrid interval optimization method can avoid short-term violent fluctuations of interactive power on the premise of meeting the requirements of system scheduling, and provide reference for optimal operation of superior power grid.

articleTitle: A Load Curve Forecast Method for Active Distribution System Based on Button-to-up Spatial Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the construction of the active distribution power system and the applications of modern technology such as active demand response and big data analysis, the influence of flexible load on load forecasting should be the focus at the planning level of the active distribution system. A load curve forecast method for active distribution system is put forward. First, the area is divided into unit of power area according to the nature of land and function boundary. The load demand of each unit area is divided into rigid and flexible demand. Then the transferable load and adjustable load regulation model are established which are used to simulate the regulation action effect on the load demand curve under the active regulation strategy. Finally the load demand curve is obtained through all the unit area load superposition from button to up. In case study, compared with the traditional load forecast results, the load demand will be more close to the actual operation condition considering the active management strategy of flexible load demand, which can provide guidance for the future construction of active distribution network and the implementation of active management strategy.

articleTitle: Two-stage Voltage Optimization Control for Active Distribution Network Considering Source-Load Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at achieving voltage optimization control of active distribution network (ADN) with high proportion of distributed generators (DGs) and large-scale random loads of electric vehicles (EVs), a two-stage coordinated voltage optimization control method of ADN considering the uncertainties of sources and loads was proposed. In the day-ahead stage, an hour-level time-scale active-reactive power joint optimization model considering source-load prediction error and EV uncertainty was constructed. Taking capacitor banks and OLTC as main voltage control units, the day-ahead active power output plan and the intra-day switching plan of main voltage control units were formulated to minimize the voltage violation risk. In the intra-day stage, the voltage state of ADN is obtained through the state estimation, and the online voltage sensitivity is used as the basis of multi-resource collaborative control. Based on the model predictive control technique, a linearized voltage prediction model and a rolling optimization model were established to realize the voltage closed-loop control. The control goal is to minimize the voltage deviation of each node and make the controllable resources track the output arrangement made in the day-ahead stage. Taking the IEEE-33 distribution network as a simulation example, the effectiveness of the two-stage voltage optimization control method proposed in this paper was verified.

articleTitle: Robust Universal Droop Control for Multi-paralleled VSCs in High PV Penetrated DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the proliferation of PV generation, dc microgrid has attracted extensive attention because of its high flexibility and efficiency. For high PV penetrated dc microgrids, the instability issues caused by the external impedance become the key bottleneck for efficiently integrating and utilizing PV generations. In this paper, a detailed and systematic model of universal droop control-based voltage source converters (VSCs) considering instantaneous power of ac- and dc-side is derived, especially in high frequency range. The formulated model can effectively guide the design and implementation of subsequent control strategies to cope with the instability issues caused by external impedances. The stability of the formulated model is theoretically analyzed and demonstrated. The accuracy of the formulated model and the effectiveness of the corresponding robust control strategy are validated in time-domain PSCAD/EMTDC platform.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Verification Technology of Bus Protection SCD File in Intelligent Substation Reconstruction and Expansion Project Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of wrong modification of bus protection SCD file during the implementation of intelligent substation reconstruction and expansion project, an intelligent verification of bus protection SCD file of intelligent substation reconstruction and expansion project based on convolution neural network is proposed for the first time, which can verify the correctness of bus protection SCD file modification of 220kV intelligent station before and after reconstruction and expansion. This method first analyzes the interaction between bus protection and virtual terminals of different types of interval devices, and leads to the feasibility of using convolution neural network to check the correctness of SCD file modification of bus protection. Secondly, the principle and training process of convolution neural network are introduced in detail. Then it focuses on the realization of SCD file intelligent verification based on convolution neural network, and gives 9 kinds of neural network structure parameters trained under different types of intervals and different construction methods; finally, taking the main transformer extension SCD check neural network as an example, the trained network parameters are analyzed to verify the superiority and rationality of the neural network structure parameters and learning parameters given by this method. It has been verified that the correct rate of 9 kinds of neural networks can reach more than 95%.

articleTitle: In-Depth Review of Optimized Scheduling Techniques of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The increasing power demand globally paired up with the rising ecological challenges have pushed the importance of distributed energy resources (DERs) in to the spotlight. Virtual power plant (VPP) conceptualization has assumed pivotal importance for realization of true potential of distributed energy resources. In this review article, Optimized scheduling concept is analysed via an in-depth comparative analysis as it plays a key role in optimizing the use of internal resources for efficient participation as a single unit. It is a key process for balancing the load demand and power production capabilities of virtual power plants for its smooth and efficient operation and connectivity to power grid and electricity markets. Various optimization techniques along with their key characteristics, objective functions, associated uncertainties and control approaches are discussed in this paper. It is hoped to be an epicentre of information for the researchers exploring optimization issues of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Overview of the Energy Internet Integrated Energy Business Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of energy technology and system, the energy Internet has gradually become an important technical means to improve energy utilization efficiency and promote energy conservation and emission reduction. Through the complementary and utilization of various energy sources of cold, heat and electricity, energy interconnection can be realized. In the context of the energy Internet, the supply, transmission, consumption, and storage of multiple energy sources also change accordingly, and each energy service provider should provide corresponding service measures, so it is important to study the integrated energy business model of energy Internet. This paper mainly summarizes the typically integrated energy business models at home and abroad, analyzes their service targets, contents, characteristics, etc., and finally puts forward several suggestions and prospects for the integrated energy business models.

articleTitle: A Novel Mechanism for EV Aggregators in Balancing Market Based on Multiple Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the popularization of Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the continuous upgrading of Vehicle to Grid (V2G) discharging technology, electric vehicles, as a kind of high-quality energy storage resource, play an important role in the balance regulation of power system. Due to the limited contribution of charging and discharging power for single EV, EVs participate balance market generally by virtual power plants or EV aggregators. This paper proposed a three-round bidding mechanism for balance market based on game theory. Stackelberg model was implemented to simulate the interaction between system operator (SO) and aggregators, and incomplete information game was introduced to simulate the competition between different types of aggregators. A numerical case with four trading periods and five types of aggregators was implemented, while the bidding results of different types of aggregators participating in each period were analyzed. The effectiveness and practicability of the proposed scheme and strategy was proved by case study.

articleTitle: V2G Multi-Objective Optimization Considering Data-Driven User's Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The development of mobile energy storage unit, Electric Vehicles, makes it possible for V2G (Vehicle to Grid) technology to participate in grid load optimization. However, since electric vehicles are different from conventional energy storage devices, EVs have the characteristics of random traffic behavior and uncertain choices from users, which is an existing problem in current V2G research. This research focus on the charging characteristics of electric vehicles in typical regional, and study the energy storage control strategy in the interaction between electric vehicles and the grid, V2G. It focuses on solving problems such as V2G modelling and simulation based on user behavior and optimization of cluster V2G energy storage scheduling strategies.

articleTitle: Health Status Assessment of Distributed Low-Carbon Energy Station Based on Grey-TOPSIS Improved By Prospect Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integrated energy system with distributed low-carbon energy station (DLCES) as the core has become the development direction in the future, and reasonable evaluation of the health status of DLCES can effectively promote the safe and stable operation of DLCES. A health status evaluation system covering system level and equipment level is proposed, the optimal weight is obtained by group G1 method and projection pursuit method, and a Grey-TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model based on prospect theory is constructed. Firstly, considering the needs of DLCES low-carbon operation evaluation and health operation evaluation, a health status evaluation system covering system level and equipment level is proposed; Secondly, the subjective weight obtained by G1 method and the objective weight obtained by projection pursuit method are combined by using the idea of nonlinear programming. Considering the decision-maker's non absolute rational psychology, an improved grey TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model based on prospect theory is proposed; Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the evaluation system and evaluation model proposed in this paper, which is conducive to mastering the health state of DLCES.

articleTitle: Improving Resilience of Distribution System with Aggregated Distributed RESs and Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of smart grid technology, flexible resources like renewable energy sources (RESs) and controllable loads (CLs) are widely utilized to improve distribution system resilience. However, the control strategy and aggregation method of distributed RESs and CLs pose several challenges, such as increasing complexity problem of optimization models. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimization scheme for critical load restoration with coordinated control strategy, as well as distributed energy resource management systems (DERMSs) and load aggregators (LAs). Besides, a DERMSs-distributed system operators (DSO)-LAs interaction framework is also formulated. Finally, the proposed optimization method is validated on a modified IEEE-37 node test feeder to verify the effectiveness that aggregated RESs and loads can significantly improve the critical load restoration effectiveness.

articleTitle: Accurate and Efficient Linear Surrogate Models for Conversion Losses in Hybrid AC/DC Microgrids based on Hard Constrained Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Fast and accurate conversion loss models are becoming crucial for the reliable and efficient operation of hybrid AC/DC microgrids (MGs). However, the traditionally applied conversion loss surrogate modeling methods are either too simple to capture the nonlinearity of the conversion losses, or too complex to fit in MG energy management problems. In this study, a neural network-based linear surrogate modeling method is developed to provide fast and accurate approximations of conversion losses. We first generate the training and test data using PLECS simulation models. Then, the neural network is trained using the augmented Lagrangian method to enforce additional hard constraints to the conversion loss-related variables. Once trained, the proposed neural network model is reformulated into a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model, which can be subsequently used in MG energy management problems. We compare the proposed model against other commonly used linear surrogate models on the test data to examine the model performance. The experiment results indicate that the proposed model yields significantly smaller relative error than other commonly used linear surrogate models and can be solved efficiently using state-of-the-art MILP solvers.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Two-and Three-level Converter Systems in PMSG Grid Connection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The paper analyses the performance of the two- and three-level back to back converters in the permanent magnets synchronous generator (PMSG) grid connection. The proposed system is combined with a variable speed wind turbine, nonsalient PMSG, back to back converter, intermediate capacitor bank, LC filter, and grid model. Instead of the neutral point clamped (NPC) converter circuit, the T-type converter circuit is applied as the three-level converter. The T-type converter has fewer components, a more straightforward control sequence, and a shorter commutation path than the NPC converter circuit. The control system includes maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control, machine-side control and grid-side control, all achieved by controlling the switching signals of converters. Two types of converter topologies are simulated through Matlab/Simulink. Extensive experimental results verify that both converter topologies have a fast dynamic response and efficiently transfer power to the grid. By comparison, the three-level converter system has a better total harmonic distortion (THD) performance than the two-level converter system. The THD of the three-level converter system can be significantly improved at low wind speeds. However, although the three-level converter introduces neutral point control, the DC link voltage and reactive power ripples are higher than the two-level converter system.

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbance Detection Based on Improved Robust Random Cut Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Many distribution network disturbances exhibit unique electrical signatures which can be observed from voltage and current waveforms. With the continuous enhancement of Power Quality Data (PQD) acquisition capabilities, it is feasible to continuously monitor the operating status of power nodes from a more detailed perspective. In the past decade, an increasing amount of high-quality PQD has been collected accumulating a massive and unique high-resolution power grid data asset. However, how to obtain valuable information, such as Power Quality Disturbance Events (PQDEs) from massive PQD remains challenging in the research community. In this paper, a reliable PQDEs detection method is proposed based on the improved Robust Random Cut Forest (RRCF). This method achieves accurate detection of PQDEs through the adaptive improvement of pre-filtering based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) and redundant interpolation. Numerical test results on the synthetic PQD and the realistic pollution experiment of a silicone rubber insulator in a salt fog chamber demonstrate the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of the proposed approach in practical online detection.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Energy Management Method Based on Virtual Impedance for Fuel Cell Shipboard Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Fuel cells are being increasingly used in shipboard microgrid applications because of their low carbon, low noise, and high efficiency. However, the system stability, energy storage durability, and fuel economy of fuel cells should be improved. Therefore, a novel hierarchical energy management method was proposed for achieving virtual impedance droop control according to the ship's operating conditions and lithium battery state of charge (SOC). Unlike the decentralized energy management method, the proposed method can simultaneously achieve lithium battery SOC recovery and improve fuel economy. These results were verified through simulations.

articleTitle: MPC Based Coordinated Control Method for Distributed Energy Storage in Distribution Network with Balanced Economy and Robustness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel two-stage model predictive coordinated control (MPC) method for the coordinated control of distributed energy storage (DES) in distribution networks to realize the balanced economy and robustness. In the day-ahead optimization stage, firstly, the battery life of DES under different operation modes is quantitatively evaluated with the rain-flow calculation method, and the impact of time-of-use electricity price (TOU) and the randomness of renewable energy and load are considered in detail. Then, the day-ahead economic operation benchmark plan of DES is formulated with the objective of overall economic optimization. In the intra-day optimization stage, based on the voltage sensitivity matrix and charging and discharging characteristics of DES, a unified state-space based MPC coordination control model is constructed to sense the trend of system nodal voltage as well as the state of charge (SOC) of DES ahead of time, so as to implement advanced optimal regulation and rolling control for each DES to ensure the track of the economic optimization plan formulated. Meanwhile, the voltage fluctuation and out of limit phenomenon caused by short-term source load power fluctuation can also be effectively suppressed, and the robustness of system operation is effectively enhanced. Finally, the numerical analysis is carried out on the modified IEEE-33 nodes distribution network, the results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Method for Estimating the Composition Ratio of Substation Industry Based on K-Means++ Clustering and Sparse Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to match and fuse the information collected by energy management system and electricity consumption information collection system, a substation industry composition ratio estimation method based on sparse coding and K-means++ clustering is proposed to achieve the purpose of estimating the load industry composition ratio based on energy management system data and past electricity consumption information collection system data in the absence of electricity consumption information collection system data. Taking the actual grid data as an example, the K-means++ algorithm is firstly used to cluster the bottom-level customer electricity consumption data classified by industry to obtain the typical daily load curve of each industry; then, based on the clustering results, the electricity consumption data of upper-level substations are decomposed; finally, the industry composition ratio of upper-level substations is calculated based on the decomposition results. The results show that the estimated industry composition ratio of the upper substation is within the acceptable range of error from the actual load situation.

articleTitle: Multi-period Load Restoration in Distribution System Considering Crew Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution service restoration (DSR) is essential to enhance system’s resilience against power outages. Repair of damaged components and network reconfiguration are tightly coupled in DSR. An appropriate repair schedule could accelerate the restoration and a proper configuration could in turn enhance repair efficiency. In this paper, a multi-period load restoration method is proposed to coordinate network reconfiguration and repair procedures. To deal with the dynamic microgrid islands formed by distributed generators (DG), radial topology constraints are utilized to ensure a radial and connected network throughout restoration. Additionally, repair crew dispatch is considered to derive an optimal repair sequence and repair resource allocation. With piecewise linear approximation of power flow constraints, the proposed multi-period DSR problem is formulated as a mixed-integer linear program. The main objective is to maximize picked-up loads through optimal coordination between crew dispatch and network configuration. The effectiveness of the proposed method is investigated on a modified IEEE 33-bus distribution test system with multiple damaged components. Numerical simulation results have shown that the proposed method offers a viable solution to minimize the duration and size of power outages.

articleTitle: Studies on Electricity Theft Detection Approach Based on LSTM-SAE and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The methods of electricity theft diversified and became more camouflaged against the backdrop of creating the smart grid in all respects. Existing detection methods struggled to meet the application's requirements. As a result, using long and short term memory stacked auto encoder (LSTM-SAE) and support vector machine(SVM), this research developed an electricity-stealing identification model. For high-dimensional nonlinear time series, LSTM-SAE has good feature extraction capabilities, making it suitable for mining the deep properties of electricity consumption data. SVM is applied as classifiers, whose parameters are optimized by particle swarm optimization(PSO) algorithm. Features extracted by LSTM-SAE to output the results through SVM classifier. Through the experimental simulation of actual power grid data, false positive rate(FPR) and detection rate(DR) demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Bi-level Approach to Transmission Network Planning Considering Operational Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With a large scale integration of fluctuating wind power, it is imperative to improve the operational flexibility in transmission network planning on the basis of considering system security and economy to achieve the goal of safe wind power consumption and reliable power supply. In this paper, a bi-level transmission network planning model considering operational flexibility is proposed to optimize the solution of transmission lines capacity and new thermal generator to be installed. The upper-level model minimizes the investment cost and the operation cost. The lower-level model calculates the lack of flexibility and loss of load of the system based on the line capacity and installed units from upper layer. Both upper and lower models can be transformed into mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problems. The effectiveness and validity of the proposed method are illustrated on the IEEE-RTS system.

articleTitle: Cascade Optimal Operation of Community Integrated Energy System Based on Improved Soft Actor-Critic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Integrated energy system realizes multi-energy complementarity through coupling mechanism between multiple energies. It can significantly improve the efficiency of energy utilization, thereby contributing to low-carbon transformation of global energy system. However, existing research has not fully considered the field of optimal operation of integrated energy system from the perspective of energy supply structure, which is likely to cause energy loss in whole system. In order to solve the above problem, a cascade optimization operation strategy of community integrated energy system based on improved Soft Actor-Critic algorithm is proposed. Firstly, considering diversified demands of community integrated energy system, load is divided according to energy grade, and a cascade optimization model of community integrated energy system is established. Moreover, the cascade optimization operation problem is transformed into a reinforcement learning framework. The corresponding Markov decision process model is constructed and the rationality of action selection is guaranteed by combining domain knowledge rules. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method in improving energy efficiency and reducing operating cost of the system is verified by a case.

articleTitle: Engineering of g-C3N4-Based Photocatalysts for Enhanced Hydrogen Evolution from Water Splitting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting using semiconductors is considered as one of the most promising green technologies to solve energy crises and environmental issues by converting solar energy into hydrogen fuel. The development of visible-light-responsive and highly efficient photocatalyst is the key issue in in the field of photocatalytic study. Polymeric graphitic carbon nitride (g-C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) has gained tremendous research interest owing to its visible-light responsivity, excellent thermal and chemical stability, easy synthesis and low cost. However, g-C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> prepared with thermal polymerization method has low specific surface area, high recombination probability of photogenerated electron and hole, as well as limited utilization of visible light, which inhibit its performance in photocatalytic conversions. Realizing its large-scale application in photocatalysis requires advances in improving its activity with controllable strategies. This review briefly summarizes the recent advances in designing g-C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-based photocatalysts with boosted activity for hydrogen production from water splitting reaction.

articleTitle: An Online Learning Method for Industrial Demand Response Based on Load Disaggregation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Industrial demand response (DR) plays an important role in the demand side management. In this paper, a DR pricing problem is formulated in which the utility offers an incentive price to industrial users and a linear response function of industrial user is considered. We propose an online learning and pricing algorithm considering load disaggregation with error to learn the industrial users’ DR potential and determine the real-time price to minimize the difference between total response and the target. Specifically, EM algorithm and random exploration are applied to estimate model parameters. Numerical simulations validate the performance of the proposed algorithm. Comparison with a baseline method without load disaggregation and a baseline method ignoring load disaggregation error demonstrates the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimization Based Electricity Selling Strategy for an Inter-Provincial Trader Considering the Uncertainty of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to promote the optimal allocation of power resources nationwide, China is building a unified national power market gradually. In the initial stage of market construction, provincial power companies, as inter-provincial traders, participate in the two-level operation market on behalf of market members in the province. However, the uncertainty of renewable energy output brings difficulties to the formulation of inter-provincial trading strategies. For the provinces with surplus new energy, how to formulate the optimal electricity sales strategy under the two-level market environment, so as to reduce the market operation cost and increase the consumption of new energy, is an urgent problem to be solved at present. Therefore, this paper discusses the trading framework of grid companies participating in the inter-provincial market under the two-level market environment firstly. Then a two-level optimization model considering the uncertainty of new energy output in the province is established. The proposed model also optimizes the market operation cost under the risk scenario by using the conditional value at risk (CVaR) method and formulates the optimal inter-provincial electricity sales strategy. An example including one power selling province and four power buying provinces is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. Finally, the IEEE30-bus system is used to simulate the intra-provincial topology for power flow calculation, and the applicability of the proposed model is verified.

articleTitle: Power System Forced Oscillation Caused by Malicious Mode Attack via Coordinated Charging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For the huge charging demands of numerous electric vehicles (EVs), coordinated charging is increasing in power grid. However, since connected with public networks, the coordinated charging control system is in a low-level cyber security and greatly vulnerable to malicious attacks. This paper investigates the malicious mode attack (MMA), which is a new cyber-attack pattern that simultaneously attacks massive EV charging piles to generate continuous sinusoidal power disturbance with the same frequency as the poorly-damped wide-area electromechanical mode. Thereby, high amplitude forced oscillations are stimulated by MMA, which seriously threats the stability of power systems and the power supply of charging stations. The potential threat of MMA is clarified by investigating the vulnerability of the IoT-based coordinated charging load control system, and an MMA process like Mirai is pointed out as an example. An MMA model is established for impact analysis. A hardware test platform is built for the verification of the MMA model. Test result verified the existence of MMA and the accuracy of the MMA model.

articleTitle: Active Structure Control of Floating Wind Turbine Using PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the harsh ocean environment, random wind wave combined loads make the platform and tower top of the wind turbine vibrate greatly, which seriously threatens the safety of the floating wind turbine structure. In this paper, a tuned mass damper (TMD) with limited stroke is placed longitudinally in the cabin of a barge type floating wind turbine, and active control force is applied to it to form an active and passive integrated vibration control system (HMD). Firstly, based on Kane's Dynamics, the motion equation of wind turbine is derived. Combined with the elastic dynamic motion equation of the HMD structure system with one degree of freedom, the general form of the complete nonlinear time-domain motion equation coupled with the HMD system and the wind turbine system is derived. Then, for the nonlinear model, TMD parameters were optimized by minimizing the cost function, and a PID controller was designed by introducing acceleration feedback to obtain the active force. Finally, the suppression effects of TMD passive control and HMD integrated control on the dynamic response of barge type floating wind turbine are simulated under combined wind and wave loads. The results show that compared with the passive control, the vibration reduction effect of the HMD integrated control is significantly improved under the constraints of TMD stroke. Moreover, the vibration reduction effect of PID controller given in this paper is better than LQR controller.

articleTitle: Surrogate-Assisted Evolutionary Optimization of the Emergency Load Shedding with Parallel Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Evolutionary algorithms are widely used for solving the event-driven emergency load shedding (ELS) optimization problem. However, conventional evolutionary ELS optimization methods are inefficient due to the computationally expensive time- domain simulation for evaluating candidate ELS schemes. To improve optimization efficiency, a parallel surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithm for ELS optimization (PSEALS) is proposed in this paper. In the framework of PSEALS, search operators based on differential evolution are used to generate candidate ELS schemes. The data-driven surrogate model is constructed online to evaluate candidate ELS schemes efficiently. According to evaluation results, elitist ELS schemes are prescreened to direct accurate evolution search. The overall framework of PSEALS is organized with the parallel computation method to accelerate the solving process. The performance of the proposed algorithm is verified through the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Design of Peer-to-Peer Transactions for Multi-microgrids Based on Non-cooperative Game Theory and Distributed Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In response to the lack of further game relationship analyses and gaps in the application of artificial intelligence methods represented by machine learning in peer-to-peer distributed trading, this paper proposed a multi-microgrids peer-to-peer trading method based on non-cooperative game theory and a distributed machine learning algorithm. First, the autonomous scheduling and peer-to-peer game trading models of the peer-to-peer market trading subject, i.e., the microgrid, were constructed. Second, the principle of the elastic average stochastic gradient descent algorithm and the distributed machine learning framework based on the algorithm were introduced. Finally, the effectiveness and applicability of the theories and methods proposed in this paper were verified through practical arithmetic simulations. This paper explored the applicability of a distributed machine learning algorithm in peer-to-peer market trading.

articleTitle: Pilot Protection for Hybrid DC Transmission Line Based on Voltage Fault Component
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The boundary and fault-response characteristics are not consistent at the sending and receiving terminals of the multi-terminal hybrid DC power transmission system, so the traditional pilot protection of the HVDC line cannot be directly applied to multi-terminal hybrid DC systems. Therefore, a hybrid HVDC line pilot protection scheme based on voltage fault components is proposed. Cosine similarity is used to measure the difference between the calculated and the measured voltage fault component waveforms to judge forward and backward faults. Combined with the line-selection criterion constructed by using the current fault component, the internal and external faults can be identified effectively. A short window is used to extract the characteristic quantity to improve the protection speed. The protection doesn’t need data synchronization between two ends and doesn’t rely on double-end boundary-feature consistency, which is suitable for both double-terminal and multi-terminal systems. Simulation results show that the protection can quickly, sensitively and reliably identify the internal faults from external ones, and has good ability to withstand the fault resistance, which can be used as quick backup protection for DC power grids.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Optimal Dispatching of Low-Carbon Regional Integrated Energy System Considering Source-Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The optimal dispatching of the regional integrated energy system (RIES) is of great significance to realizing the multi-energy complementarity and economic operation of the system. However, the intermittence of renewable energy and the uncertainty of load demand in the RIES cause the random fluctuations of both supply and demand sides in the system. To solve this problem, a low-carbon economic dispatching model considering fuzzy opportunity constraints is proposed in this paper, taking into account the influence of the uncertainty on both sides of the source and load on the low-carbon dispatching of the RIES. Fuzzy membership parameters are used to characterize the uncertainty of renewable energy and load demand. A credibility fuzzy chance constraint model considering the uncertainty of wind power, photovoltaic and load demand is constructed. After the clear equivalence class transformation, GUROBI is used to solve the fuzzy dispatching problem. Finally, a study case shows that the proposed model can effectively improve the reliability and economy of the optimal dispatching scheme and reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Distribution Network Expansion Planning Considering the Integration of Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Soft open point (SOP) can transfer active power between feeders and compensate reactive power, which help alleviate the operation challenges of large-scale renewable distribution generation (RDG) incorporation, and hence improve the integration capacity of RDG in low-carbon distribution network (LCDN). This paper presents a novel mixed-integer second-order cone programming model to address the expansion planning for the LCDN taking into account the integration of SOP. It co-optimizes the planning of RDG, SOP, capacitor bank, and energy storage system simultaneously with network reinforcement for minimizing the total economic and carbonemission costs over planning horizons. The potential on the economic-environmental benefits of the proposed planning methodology is studied via several test schemes on a 54-node network. The results demonstrate the effectiveness in improving the economy and mitigating carbon emission, when compared with the conventional planning paradigms.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage System Based on Probabilistic Power Flow and the MILP Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Energy storage systems(ESS) play an important role in the new power system to alleviate network congestion and improve renewable energy consumption. When optimizing the design of ESS, the heavy bilateral fluctuation of source and load sides must be considered in the planning model. Probabilistic load flow has advantages in handling multi spatiotemporal generation and load uncertainties. This work proposes a novel optimal planning model of ESS based on probabilistic load flow constraints, aiming to minimize the total cost of system investment and operation. In order to deal with the nonlinear probabilistic load flow constraints, the cumulant method was used to transfer the original nonlinear model into a mixed-integer linear programming model, which can be solved by calling Cplex solver. The case study shows that under high penetration of renewable energy, the optimal ESS planning model based on probabilistic load flow constraints can reduce renewable energy curtailment economically, reducing the risk of redundant investment with a reasonable set of confidence probabilistic load flow.

articleTitle: SOC Consistency Optimization Control Strategy of Flywheel Array Energy Storage System for Grid Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the state of charge (SOC) imbalance of flywheel array energy storage system (FAESS) when it participates in primary frequency regulation (PFR), a SOC consistency optimization control strategy based on hierarchical architecture is proposed. Firstly, the lower controller is designed based on the principle of vector control strategy, and the flywheel charge and discharge control strategy is divided into emergency recovery mode and normal working mode according to SOC to avoid overcharge or over-discharge of flywheel unit. Due to SOC differences among flywheel units participating in primary frequency regulation, some flywheel units will withdraw from operation in advance during charging and discharging, resulting in secondary drop of power grid frequency. To solve this problem, the upper controller is optimized, and an improved equal time allocation strategy is proposed to adjust the output power in real time according to the SOC of each flywheel unit, so that the SOC of the flywheel array gradually becomes consistent during the charging and discharging process, and the balance of the remaining energy of the flywheel array is guaranteed. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink to simulate two typical working conditions of small load disturbance and large load disturbance respectively and compare with the conventional power allocation strategies to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Zeno-Free Distributed Self-Triggered Secondary Control Scheme for Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distributed secondary control of microgrids is usually based on continuous-time-based control and communication assumption, which is neither economical nor efficient. In this paper, a distributed self-triggered control strategy is proposed based on the signum function to reduce the computation and communication requirements. With the self-triggered distributed controller, each DG only makes decision and propagates information to its neighbors at the specific event times, rather than continuously. To monitor the events, a linear clock is established according to the local consensus error and a preset convergence error, and hence the controller can exclude Zeno behavior naturally. By implementing the self-triggered distributed control for active power sharing and implementing a local frequency restoration control, the secondary control of islanded microgrids can be achieved distributedly with very less control actions and communications. Simulation results illustrate the validation of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Prospect Analysis of Integrated Electric Power Service Mode based on Substation-to-Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to promote the development of electric vehicles, a comprehensive energy supply scheme based on substation-to-charging station is designed. Using the idle land resources of the substation to build a new integrated substation can effectively solve the problem of charging the residents' electric vehicles. The new comprehensive station not only has the functions of a substation, but also integrates charging areas, power exchange areas, renewable energy generation areas and energy storage areas. The integrated station provides electric vehicle users with diversified power services such as charging, batteries exchanging, and selling electricity to the grid. On this basis, the introduction of energy storage equipment and power exchange measures can not only improve the charging efficiency, but also help to cut the peak and fill the valley, and stabilize the load fluctuation of the grid. Appropriate construction of renewable energy is considered to promote its local consumption. When a new charging and power exchange station is built, it is necessary to arrange coordination and dispatching strategy which can manage the new integrated stations in a unified way and cooperate with battery and energy storage equipment manufacturers. While dealing with electric vehicle users, the energy blockchain and edge computing technology can be used to obtain the personalized differential price of users in real time and promote the orderly charging of electric vehicles. A typical transaction process between electric users and new integrated station is illustrated. The new integrated station can realize the win-win situation between users and grid.

articleTitle: Energy-Consuming Right Trading: Architectures, Practices and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Facing the increasing burden of the environmental deterioration, demand growth and the shortage of energy resources, China puts forward the energy-consuming right trading systems (ECRTs), for saving energy by controlling the total energy consumption. In order to deeply study the mechanism of ECRT, this paper firstly investigates the current status and related mechanisms of ECRT, analyzes the benefits of ECRT, and puts forward the problems and challenges that the merge of the ECRT and carbon emission right trading (CERT) may face. Further suggestions and strategies are illustrated for different participating entities.

articleTitle: Parallel Simulation Strategy of Virtual Synchronized Power Grid Based on Haar Wavelet Collocation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a parallel simulation method based on Haar Wavelet Collocation Method (HWCM) for dynamic simulation of the virtual synchronized power grid. The wavelet collocation method converts the traditional numerical simulation form based on time discretization to the simulation form based on wavelet coefficient characterization. And the essence of system simulation is further transformed into solving a set of multi-scale algebraic models based on wavelet coefficients. This can better avoid the problem that the simulation step size is limited by the system time constant caused by directly processing the differential operator in the time domain space. In order to further improve the simulation efficiency, the parallel simulation is also studied, and the effectiveness and accuracy of the parallel method based on HWCM are verified in the simulation model of the single-machine virtual synchronized power grid.

articleTitle: Fully Distributed Robust Optimal Control of Cyber-Physical Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Tremendous number of renewable energy sources (RES) and distributed generators integrated into distribution system, power generation uncertainty and massive decision variables bring about significant challenges to distribution system operator (DSO). Benefiting from advanced information technologies, distribution system evolves into cyber-physical distribution system (CPDS), and effective countermeasures can be made under distributed control framework to achieve optimality and resiliency of CPDS. For this purpose, fully distributed robust control strategy is specifically explored in this paper. Firstly, a two-stage robust optimization (RO) model is developed for each sub-area in CPDS, which takes uncertainty of wind power into consideration. After that, based on Consensus-ADMM algorithm, a fully distributed solution strategy of combined Consensus-ADMM and RO model is proposed. Results of study case verify that by adopting our method, accurate robust solution under different uncertainty budge can be obtained adaptively under diverse cyber or physical topologies, which guarantees optimality and resiliency of CPDS.

articleTitle: Fault Indicator Three-Phase Synchronization Method Based on Fault Instant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The fault indicator with the "two remote" (remote signaling and telemetering) function needs synchronous measurement of three-phase current when uploading zero-sequence current information. Based on the zero-sequence current detection method of the fault indicator, this paper proposes a three-phase synchronization method based on the fault instant. Firstly, the fault instant is found out by detecting the fault phase current. The non-fault phase is awakened and the recorded wave data are sampled on this basis. Secondly, the starting point of the three-phase fault can be traced back to the normal operation section with the same cycle wave number. Then the Fourier algorithm is used to calculate the three-phase current phasor to obtain the time synchronization error between fault phase and non-fault phase. Finally by adjusting the synchronization deviation between the fault phase and the non-fault phase, the alignment of the three-phase current sampling value after the fault is realized to obtain the zero sequence current. This method uses fault information to achieve synchronous measurement, which avoids the additional GPS module and reduces the cost. The simulation results show that the proposed method has feasibility and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Scheme of Voltage Sag Treatment by Targeting Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The current research on the treatment of voltage sag mainly focuses on the configuration of the capacity of the voltage sag compensation equipment. Less concentration is given to the access location of the voltage sag compensation equipment. While lacking the pertinence for different voltage sag sensitive users, it also increases the economic cost of voltage sag treatment of the sensitive users. Therefore, the concept of targeting in the medical field has been expanded to the electrical field in this paper. A scheme is proposed based on the targeting method, which takes the installation position of the voltage sag compensation equipment into account. In this scheme, the user’s sensitive equipment is taken as the target to determine the access location of the voltage sag compensation equipment. At the same time, the target function of voltage sag treatment is constructed, and the the capacity of the voltage sag compensation equipment is searched with as the target. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: A Two-step BP Neural Network Based Machine Learning Algorithm for Solving Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to speed up the solution of the unit commitment problem, a two-step BP(Back-Propagation) neural network-based machine learning algorithm is proposed in this paper for performing fast prediction of feasible solutions to the unit commitment. Firstly, this two-step BP neural network is constructed and trained with the training data generated by traditional unit commitment solution method.
