After that, prediction results of the two-step BP neural network are compared with those of the one-step BP neural network and simulation results of traditional unit commitment solution method in a case study to demonstrate this method’s feasibility and better accuracy. The case study shows that it is feasible to use a two-step BP neural network for fast prediction of unit commitment solutions to support electrical power system optimization, with significantly shorter time compared to the traditional solution method and higher accuracy compared to a one-step BP neural network.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Coal-Wind-Hydrogen Integrated System Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The randomness of wind power output leads to a very weak absorption capacity, and there is a serious phenomenon of wind abandonment. The construction of transferable new energy consumption equipment is a possible solution. This paper proposes an optimal dispatch strategy for a coal-wind-hydrogen integrated energy system considering new energy consumption equipment. Wind power uncertainty is described using nonparametric kernel density estimation (KDE). On this basis, short-term dispatch economic optimization is carried out with the goal of maximizing the overall benefit of the composite coal-wind-hydrogen integrated energy system that produces electricity and hydrogen. The simulation results show that when considering hydrogen energy storage, the phenomenon of wind curtailment is significantly improved, which improves the operating economy of conventional units and storage equipment, and improves the economy of system operation while ensuring the new energy storage capacity. This paper provides a new perspective for the formulation of economic operation strategy of coal-wind-hydrogen integrated energy system including wind farms and hydrogen production equipment.

articleTitle: Assessment of Energy Low Carbon Transition in Northwest China Based on Dynamic Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Northwest China is not only rich in traditional energy resources, but also has abundant new energy resources, which make it an important energy base. In the context of the double carbon targets, the energy low carbon transition in Northwest China, as a key region of energy output, is of vital importance. This paper establishes an energy low carbon transition assessment indexes based on the energy supply, energy consumption and low-carbon efficiency, and uses dynamic factor analysis to measure the energy low carbon transition achievements in Northwest China. Based on the scores in Northwest China and other regions, the results of energy low carbon transition are ranked dynamically, and the reasons are analyzed statically according to the scores of each factor. The results show that Northwest China ranks low comparing with the other regions in China. Among them, Shaanxi ranked 13, Qinghai ranked 19, Gansu ranked 20, Ningxia ranked 23, and Xinjiang ranked 27. The reasons include that the economic situation is relatively backward, the transition of the traditional energy progresses slowly and there is difficulty in absorbing of new energy resources. Suggestions are proposed for the troubles of Northwest China to promote the further development of its energy low carbon transition.

articleTitle: Power Safe Transmission Range of Three-Phase Series-Connected Modular Multilevel Converter under Unbalanced AC Grid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Compared with 3-phase parallel-connected modular multilevel converter (PC-MMC), the 3-phase series-connected MMC (SC-MMC) is more beneficial due to possible reduction of construction costs and footprints, which is more suitable for HVDC tapping station. To determine the power safe transmission range of SC-MMC under both balanced and unbalanced conditions, this paper introduced the analytical and point-scanning methods. Firstly, the equivalent mathematical model of SC-MMC was derived. Next, constraints of the operation boundary are discussed and decided. Then, the corresponding boundary control strategy is designed for the possible over power operation of SC-MMC under unbalanced ac grid conditions. The simulation model of SC-MMC and its control systems are built in PSCAD/EMTDC. Simulation results show the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed power safe transmission range boundary control method.

articleTitle: Single-Terminal Travelling Wave Based Fault Location Method in T-Type Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the transmission line with T-type branch, it is difficult to utilize single-terminal power frequency fault information or travelling wave fault information to implement fault location in different situations. This paper analyzes the travelling wave propagation characteristics of the transmission line with T-type branch and proposes a fault branch identification and fault location method based on fault travelling wave catadioptric characteristics. Upload the fault location results of the T-type transmission line based on the single-terminal travelling wave fault location method to the master dispatching station, and utilize the fault location results based on the power frequency fault information at the master station as references to obtain the final fault location results. This method is independent with the polarity relationship between the fault travelling waves, fully utilizes the fault information of the master station and realizes the on-line correction of travelling wave velocity to obtain optimized results. ATP/EMTP simulation results indicate that this method is of high accuracy and certain practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Bi-level Optimal Configuration for Shared Energy Storage Considering Economics of Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Shared Energy Storage (SES) has advantages in improving energy storage utilization, and the optimal allocation of SES is becoming a current research hotspot. The current SES capacity allocation methods ignore the transformer’s economics. In this paper, a bi-level optimization model for SES considering the economics of the distribution transformer is proposed, with the upper-level considering the economic operation of the transformer and optimal capacity allocation of SES, and the lower-level optimizing the energy consumption behavior of users in the microgrid. Simulation results show that SES can enhance power mutualization among users, reduce the scale of energy storage investments, and create a win-win situation for both operator and users.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Transformer Based on ANOVA and SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To improve the diagnostic accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis model, this paper proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method based on analysis of variance (ANOVA) and support vector machine (SVM). Firstly, the characteristics of dissolved gas in transformer oil are screened and dimensionality reduced by analysis of variance. Secondly, the filtered features are put into the SVM model. Finally, the simulation results of using the method proposed in this paper to diagnose the fault of a transformer show that, compared with IEC and Rogers methods, ANOVA dimensionality reduction screening method for model input can better improve model performance, and the diagnostic accuracy of SVM based on ANOVA, IEC, and Rogers are 90.54%, 74.32% and 77.03% respectively, and the superiority of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Protection Based on Phase Difference of Voltage and Current for DC Lines in Hybrid Multi-terminal HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A novel protection based on phase difference between voltage and current for DC lines in hybrid multi-terminal HVDC system is proposed in this paper. On the basis of analysis on fault traveling wave propagation, the Peterson equivalent circuit is derived. Based on this, fault analysis demonstrates that for the three parallel DC lines which connect the LCC station and MMC stations on the receiving side of hybrid HVDC system, for faulty line, at high frequency, the phase difference between the fault voltage traveling wave at the bus and the fault current traveling wave at the measuring point is -90°. Whereas, for non-fault line, the phase difference between fault voltage and current traveling wave is 90°. Thus, the protection is constructed utilizing the phase difference. Simulations verify that the proposed protection can correctly distinguish the faulty line, and can detect the high-impedance faults sensitively. Besides, the proposed protection is immune to fault position and has no requirement for data synchronization.

articleTitle: Value-Based Transmission Planning Considering Load Duration Curve
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Benefit and cost should be considered in planning method under power market environment, which requires a reasonable method to measure the value of invested equipment. Value-based transmission planning recognizes the reliability needs of traditional planning while providing long-term extensions that address economic value. In this paper, the annual value of lines is evaluated with the help of load duration curve, and value indexes are established based on the line's mitigation of grid congestion and line power flow. Furthermore, based on the value indexes and investment cost, a multi-objective transmission planning model is proposed, and an improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the model. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through the case study based on the modified IEEE39 bus system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Production Simulation Results for Transient Stability of Multi-energy Power System Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to improve the safety and stability of multi-energy power system and fully consider the transient response characteristics of various types of power supply, the stability evaluation model of multi-energy power system based on Deep Belief Network is proposed. Multi-layer RBM is used to design the DBN structure, and the characteristics of data distribution in original feature space are learned by unsupervised learning; Then design the loss evaluation function based on neighborhood element analysis, fine-tune the parameters of DBN using supervised learning, and give the solution algorithm. Finally, the stability of combined production simulation results of multiple type units under UHVDC fault is analyzed, and the model effectiveness is verified combined with actual operation data of a western power grid in China,.

articleTitle: An Integrated Multi-resource Clustering Method Based on a High Proportion of Renewable Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The increasing proportion of renewable energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaics in the power system poses a challenge to the operational planning of the power system due to its volatility and the dramatic increase in the amount of data due to the increasing complexity of the system structure. How to form representative typical scenarios to replace the previous day- by-day time-series simulation method for production simulation, in order to achieve results that balance efficiency and accuracy, is a problem worth solving. The scenario reduction method is one of the effective methods, and the k-means method is the more commonly used clustering method. Unlike previous scenario reduction methods that only cluster a single node and a single resource, this paper proposes an integrated clustering method based on the k-means clustering algorithm that clusters multiple resources simultaneously in a complex power system network that considers multiple renewable energy sources, and compares it with a typical scenario clustering method that clusters multiple resources separately and then combines them, using year-round time-series simulation as a reference basis. The integrated clustering has a small error in terms of computational accuracy and computational efficiency, and can effectively reflect the annual characteristics of various resources, which can provide a more reliable basis for the operation planning of power systems.

Author Keywords: the high proportion of renewable energy power system

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Data Generation Method of Electric Vehicle Charging Behaviors Based on Improved Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging behaviors are important for load forecasting, but charging behavior data collection is time-consuming and labor-intensive. To solve this problem, an improved generative adversarial network (GAN) based charging behavior data generation method for EVs was proposed. In this method, convolutional neural network is used as the structure, Wasserstein distance is used as the loss function of the neural network, and conditional labels are added to make the generator learn the probability distribution mapping relationship that meets the corresponding conditions. These methods finally construct the EV charging behavior data generation network. In the end, this paper compares this method with traditional data generation algorithm synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) and conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN). The result shows that this method can effectively learn the distribution rule of small sample data and effectively expand the data scale.

articleTitle: Development of a Pillar-type CVT Leakage Current Sensor with High-Efficiency Magnetization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As an important physical quantity in the power system, current is of great significance to its accurate measurement.In this paper, through the introduction of three mainstream measurement technologies, combined with the actual work needs, the non-contact measurement theory is studied, and the TMR (Tunneling Magnetoresistance) measurement element is selected.Combined with the structural characteristics of capacitive voltage transformer (CVT), a pillar-type CVT leakage current sensor with efficient magnetic concentration was developed, and it was successfully applied in the 220kV Fanjiawan substation.The measurement results show that the CVT leakage current sensor developed in this paper can monitor the CVT leakage current without power failure, and has the characteristics of convenient installation, high safety and high measurement accuracy of measurement results.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Hosting Capacity Assessment and Optimization in Power Distribution System Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power and photovoltaic (PV) are two crucial forms of clean energy utilization, and the renewable energy accessing capacity in power distribution system (PDS) is increasing rapidly. Nevertheless, the exploitation and utilization of wind and solar energy resources lack scientific and reasonable guidance, resulting in a great waste of resources, and even threaten the security and stability of PDS to a great extent. To this end, a renewable energy hosting capacity (REHC) assessment and optimization approach is proposed to effectively analysis and optimize the REHC of PDS. Based on mixed integer linear programming (MILP), a REHC assessment and optimization model is constructed, where all nodes of PDS allow wind power and PV access. Besides, on account of the obstacles brought by the bilinear terms in proposed model, a Big-M based relaxation technique is developed to reduce the complexity of model and improve the solving efficiency. Additionally, the uncertainty of wind power and PV is represented by several typical scenarios that obtained by the proposed scenario generation methodology, which can further reduce the computational burden and improve the accuracy of the proposed approach. Eventually, comprehensive case study on a modified 15-bus PDS validates the efficiency and practicability of the proposed model and approach.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of WT-PV-ES-CSPP Hybrid Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the country vigorously promotes the development of new energy, how to improve the level of consumption of new energy generation has become an urgent issue Under the premise of considering economic cost, an optimal dispatching method of hybrid generation System considering wind turbine (WT) – photovoltaic (PV) – energy storage (ES) -concentrating solar power plant (CSPP) is proposed by using the energy regulation ability of ES and CSPP. The method combines, solar thermal power plants and grid time-sharing tariffs with the optimal scheduling of WT and PV new energy sources, and improves the economic efficiency of the system and the capacity of new energy consumption through joint scheduling. Finally, a typical case in northwest China is simulated, and it is verified that the optimal scheduling method can effectively improve the capacity of new energy consumption and reduce the operating cost of the system by setting different cases for comparison.

articleTitle: An Electric Vehicle Aggregation Region Approach for Active Distribution Network Optimal Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electric Vehicle (EV) dispatchable flexibility shows a great potential to minimize the system operation cost. Numerous EVs increase the aggregation complexity with heterogeneous parameters. This paper establishes a decomposable aggregation region method for EVs to take full advantage of the potential flexibility. The proposed model includes the inner-approximate feasible region and the equivalent system cost function. First, considering the demand and EVs’ parameters, EV loads are modeled by an operation region. Second, an inner approximate region is formulated to obtain the maximum potential flexibility of EV by translating a basic homothetic polytope. Finally, the aggregation model participates in the economic dispatch. Simulation tests indicate the great potential of the method for system day-ahead economic dispatch and guarantee solution feasibility.

articleTitle: Influence of DC Bias on Winding Vibration of Converter Transformer under Harmonic Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of abnormal vibration of converter transformer windings under direct current bias, combined with Maxwell's equations, Lorentz force and related formulas of structural mechanics, based on the finite element simulation platform, a three-dimensional model of converter transformer coupled with multi-physics was built. Considering the symmetric structure of the model, in order to shorten the calculation time, the model is divided into four equal parts to reduce the calculation amount. According to the actual working conditions, a model of the direct current transmission system is built to obtain the harmonic content of the excitation source in the actual operation of the converter transformer. Through the comparative analysis of the magnetic flux density, it is shown that if the harmonic condition is ignored and the excitation source is set to a standard three-phase sinusoidal voltage, the simulation results will have a large deviation from the actual situation. According to the changes of the magnetic field distribution, current magnitude, stress distribution and deformation of the windings before and after the addition of the direct current component, the vibration characteristics of the converter transformer windings under direct current bias are studied. The results show that under the direct current bias, the leakage flux density, current, stress and displacement have increased, and the vibration of the winding is intensified.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Corridor Shape Effect on Geomagnetically Induced Currents Using 3-D Earth Conductivity Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Severe Geomagnetic Disturbances (GMDs) pose a potential threat to the United States bulk electrical system. To assess the system impact, a method to calculate geomagnetically induced currents (GICs) in a power grid using the EPRI 1-D earth conductivity models has been introduced by the NERC reliability standard TPL-007. Under this method, transmission lines are modeled as straight lines between substations. Alternatively, magnetotelluric impedances that reflect the 3-D earth conductivity structure have recently become available in much of the U.S. thanks to the work of the National Science Foundation sponsored Earthscope program. The new 3-D method provides geoelectric fields with much higher resolution than that obtained from the 1-D models. This paper studies the impact of the actual transmission line corridor shapes using 3-D and 1-D methods on a fairly large-scale power system. The study used an actual storm that took place on 07-08 September 2017.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Regulation Market Application Strategy of Integrated Fire-Storage System Based on Q -Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the gradual establishment of market-based trading mode of power frequency regulation auxiliary service, new power supply formats such as integrated fire-storage system are developing rapidly. At the same time, the bidding strategy of integrated fire-storage system in frequency regulation market has become the focus of research in this field. In order to meet the demand of high frequency and high precision market transaction of the integrated fire storage system, a frequency regulation market declaration strategy based on Q-reinforcement learning is proposed. Q-reinforcement learning is a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm. Considering the bidding characteristics of the current frequency regulation market, the environment variables, action library and return function of the frequency regulation market declaration agent of the integrated fire storage system are constructed, and the implementation process of the algorithm is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by constructing an example based on the actual grid data of a province. Example results show that the results of this algorithm are basically consistent with the current target declaration strategy, and its computational efficiency is significantly higher than the existing algorithm, which is more in line with the trading needs of operators of integrated fire storage system in frequency regulation market.

articleTitle: Linear Power Flow Calculation Methods for Urban Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The traditional AC power flow model is accurate, but it needs to deal with a large number of nonlinear constraints, with low efficiency and convergence problems. The use of linearized power flow model can reduce the solution difficulty, which is an effective means to improve the analysis and calculation efficiency of urban networks. The DC power flow model is the most popular linearized model at present, which is applicable to transmission networks. But it cannot satisfy urban networks, has low calculation accuracy and cannot solve the two electrical quantities of voltage magnitude and line reactive power, both of which are important for the stability and control of power system. Therefore, a linearized power flow model and an improved DC power flow model in a hot-start environment are used to improve the calculation accuracy. The IEEE 33-node system is used to test and compare different linearized power flow models, which proves that the hot-start linearized model has higher accuracy and applicability when load variations in adjacent time periods are not significant.

articleTitle: Research on Joint Planning Technology of Source-Network-Load-Storage Based on Typical Daily Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale access of power electronics, the joint planning technology of source-network-load-storage is a new research hotspot. This paper proposes a joint planning method of source-network-load-storage based on typical daily scenarios. First, the historical data of original wind power, photovoltaic, electric vehicle charging stations and loads are preprocessed , use clustering algorithm to create typical day scenes of spring, summer, autumn and winter. Then, comprehensively considering investment costs and operation maintenance costs, a joint planning model of source-network-load-storage is established, the model is converted to convex based on the second-order cone relaxation theory. Finally, a typical daily scenario is used to simulate the distribution system example of Portugal 54 nodes. The consequence of example analysis displays that the combined planning model of source-network-load-storage can reduce the total cost of distribution system planning level year.

articleTitle: Matrix Pencil Based Synchrophasor Measurement Withstanding Out-of-Band Interference
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Out-of-band Interference(OOBI) caused by harmonics and inter-harmonics has become the main factor affecting the accuracy of synchrophasor measurement. To this end, this article proposed a Matrix Pencil(MP) method based on Singular Value Decomposition(SVDMP) for the OOBI contaminated synchrophasor estimation. The proposed method uses Singular Value Decomposition(SVD) to determine the number of components in the input signal and mitigate the noise interference. By solving the eigenvalues of the MP composed of two Hankel matrices derived from input signal, the frequency and attenuation factor can be obtained. Finally, the amplitude and phase of the input signal can be estimated using a Least Square Method(LSM). The performance of SVDMP is validated by various simulation signals model specified in the C37.118.1 standard and by a real grid fault data from a fault recorder installed in a substation.

articleTitle: LVRT Control Strategy of MMC-HVDC Converter Connected to DFIG Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power is often sent out through high voltage direct current transmission system due to its volatility and discontinuity. When wind power is connected to the HVDC, the control strategy of DFIG has certain challenges in dealing with the requirements of low voltage ride through. In this paper, the MMC auxiliary control strategy is used to assist DFIG to achieve low voltage ride through, and the control strategy of wind field side MMC is designed to improve the low voltage ride through ability of the system. The simulation model of DFIG connected to MMC is built in simulation platform to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the control strategy under different voltage drops.

articleTitle: Incorporating Constraints in Reinforcement Learning Assisted Energy System Decision Making: A Selected Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the widespread use of reinforcement learning (RL) in the energy system, the damage to the system caused by the agents' stochastic exploration is beginning to be appreciated. We need to ensure the safety of agents during the whole training process, even at each time step. Therefore, we need to consider how to incorporate safety constraints into RL. In this paper, we summarize two approaches to soft constraints and three approaches to hard constraints, respectively, and provide a comparative analysis of their advantages and disadvantages. Finally, we conclude approaches to how to incorporate constraints in RL, and give an outlook on future research directions.

articleTitle: Prediction of Temperature Distribution of Epoxy in Anode Saturable Reactor Based on Multi-field Coupled Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The Anode saturable reactor (ASR) plays significant role in protecting thyristors in high voltage direct current (HVDC) converter valves, meanwhile, stands the extremely serious electrical-thermal stress in working condition. In this paper, the isometric model of an 8-cores ASR is established for temperature computed with FEM, and the iron core losses and cooling water are considered for the main heat source and dissipation for the temperature rising of epoxy. The calculated temperature distribution shows non-uniform characteristic at vertical, radius and circumferential directions, and the faceted edge of the epoxy and iron cores the location with most serious thermal accumulation.

articleTitle: Integrated Charging Station and Mixed Fleet Planning for Electric Taxi and Electric Bus
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electric buses (EBs) and electric taxis (ETs) are growing rapidly due to they could contribute to transportation electrification. This paper builds an integrated planning model for a heterogeneous fleet composed of EBs and ETs and their associate charging stations (CSs) to meet passenger travel requests together. Accounting for two different transportation modes, we optimize the quantity of EBs and ETs as well as the location and quantity of chargers. We formulate the planning problem as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model. Also, the effectiveness of the proposed model is demonstrated in a numerical case study.

articleTitle: Unit commitment Considering Network Dynamic Characteristics of Electricity-Gas-Heat Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the strengthening of electricity-gas-heat connectivity, an essential problem to be addressed is how to efficiently release the flexibility of integrated energy systems (IES) and wind power accommodation capacity. The slow dynamic propagation characteristics of the network, which includes natural gas and heat in energy transmission, provide a certain amount of energy storage capacity to the corresponding network. As a result, this study provides a unit commitment model for a linked system of electricity, gas, and heat that takes into account the dynamic properties of networks. The dynamic natural gas pipeline storage and heat network transmission delay effect are investigated and modeled. In addition, a unit commitment (UC) model is developed, which takes into account multi-energy complementarity as well as network dynamic characteristics. Then, using piecewise linearization, convert it to a mixed linear integer programming problem (MILP). The proposed strategy can lower the frequency of UC, according to case studies. Meanwhile, the slower emission of gas and heat improves operation flexibility.

articleTitle: Revenue Uncertainty Analysis for Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of mobility on-demand and artificial intelligence technologies, autonomous electric vehicle (AEV)-based ride-hailing fleets are playing an increasingly important role in the urban ground transportation system. Due to the stochastic nature of travel request arrival and charging price, there exists intrinsic uncertainties in decision-making process for AEVs in the autonomous mobility-on-demand (AMoD) system. It is important to investigate the impact of those uncertainties on the power transportation coupling system. In this paper, we propose an operation modeling scheme for AMoD fleet via quantile regression deep Q-learning network (QR-DQN) to analyze the corresponding revenue uncertainties. First, we establish a semi-MDP framework to model the AMoD fleet management and charging scheduling decisions under an uncertain environment. Using quantile regression method, we develop a QR-DQN based decision-making method for AEVs in AMoD fleet. Finally, we conduct multiple experiments based on real-world data to verify the operation characteristic of AMoD system under an uncertain environment.

articleTitle: Regional PV Output Power Forecasting Based on Optimized Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of intermittent, fluctuating and random, the large-scale grid connected photovoltaic plants will seriously affect the stability and economic operation of power system. Carrying out regional PV output power forecasting could provide the dispatching department with reference information of power output, which could help make the dispatching plan and arrange the standby capacity. Therefore, this paper proposed a regional PV output power forecasting method based on artificial neural network, which is optimized by particle swam optimization algorithm. The forecasting accuracy of the proposed method is verified with the historical data of regional PV output.

articleTitle: Research on Database Disaster Recovery and Architecture Design of Power Marketing System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, with the accelerated pace of digital transformation of electric power enterprises, we have put forward new tasks and goals for the construction of marketing informatization, in order to conform to the new situation and new demand of traditional electric power marketing business upgrading. Based on the cloud platform architecture, this paper studies and designs database disaster recovery for the upgrading and iterative construction of power marketing system. It avoids unexpected data loss and system downtime when disasters occur.

articleTitle: Development of Different Energy Storage Systems in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region: Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: China has begun a green revolution inside its power system to keep the net-zero commitment made to the world. To make a smooth transition, many provinces or autonomous regions in China are paving the ground for growing the economy of energy storage. The Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region (XUAR), the largest power producer in northwestern China, has witnessed a drastic shift in the source of power. The local government has made many efforts to accelerate the development of energy storage in the region and counteract the impact of high renewable penetration, but some of the existing policies are not robust enough to encourage the installation of energy storage facilities. The energy storage sector generally lacks incentives to participate in the electricity market due to unreasonable returns from the market trade. In this paper, the investment recovery time of a few energy storage projects with different technology and project size are compared. Long capital recovery time and inadequate profits jointly cause low incentives for investing in energy storage projects. We recommend revisions of current policies with a specific goal to enhance the profitability of energy storage projects, through either lifting the price restraint or granting access to frequency regulation services.

articleTitle: A Novel Distributed Droop Control Strategy of Multiple Interlinking Converters for Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For low-voltage AC-DC hybrid microgrids, an improved distributed droop control is proposed. The control strategy can reduce the unnecessary and excessive power transmission of interlinking converters (ICs) and realize accurate power distribution. Different from the traditional droop control, the improved strategy will establish a new operation target according to the load of AC and DC subgrids. The power sharing concept of distributed generations (DGs) is applied to IC control, which enables flexible power interactions between AC and DC subgrids. The proposed control strategy only allows the leader IC to collect information from the AC and DC side in order to reduce the communication pressure of the system. For the rest of the follower ICs, they communicate with each other to ensure accurate power distribution. Finally, a small signal model is established to analyze the impact of communication delay on the system stability. The AC/DC hybrid microgrid model is built on Matlab/Simulink to validate the performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Optimal Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Considering Concentrating Solar Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: At present, the domestic goal of “dual carbon” has brought opportunities for the development of low-carbon, zero-carbon and negative-carbon industries, as well as opportunities for the development of green and clean energy. At the same time, in order to ensure that the system takes into account new energy consumption and economic operation under the premise of low carbon and environmental protection, and to meet the supply demand of mostly electric loads on the demand side, a low-carbon economic dispatch strategy for integrated energy systems (IES) considering Concentrating Solar Power (CSP) Plant is proposed. Build the low-carbon dispatching operation framework of the integrated energy system and analyze its operation mechanism; establish the low-carbon economic dispatching model with the optimal operation cost of the integrated energy system equipped with the CSP plant, and use CPLEX to solve the multi-objective optimization model. The numerical example analysis shows that the integrated energy system equipped with the CSP plant can effectively improve the online space of new energy and reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Mobile Battery Energy Storage in Distribution Network with Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To address the need for high-quality power, the distribution network (DN) is gradually incorporating battery energy storage (BES) and flexible interconnection equipment, such as Soft Open Point (SOP). This paper proposes a mobile battery energy storage (MBES) planning strategy considering multiple scenarios in DN with SOP. Firstly, the fundamental concepts of commonly used equipment like SOP and energy storage are investigated and mathematical models are constructed. Secondly, taking the minimum annual comprehensive investment and network loss cost of DN as the planning goal, a MBES planning model for promoting the economics of the DN under multiple scenarios is established. The nonlinear programming model is transformed into a second order cone model by linearization and convex relaxation, which can achieve an accurate and rapid solution. Finally, the improved IEEE-33 node example is used for simulation, and the MBES and BES planning approaches are compared. Results show that combining MBES with SOP control can not only enhance system efficiency but also reduce voltage fluctuation, demonstrating the effectiveness of the suggested technique.

articleTitle: Active Constraint Identification Assisted DC Optimal Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The optimal power flow (OPF) is important for the reliable operation and management of power systems. Due to the uncertainties introduced by the increasing penetration of renewable energy resources (RES), more frequent OPF calculations are compulsorily required, posing significant computational burdens to the timely derivation of optimal dispatching solutions. In this paper, an active constraint identification (ACI) approach is proposed to identify the active constraints under different generation and demand conditions so that the OPF computational time can be reduced. The ACI is based on deep convolutional neural networks. Simulation studies are performed on the IEEE 14/118/300 bus systems, and the optimal power flow is solved by using Gurobi/Python. Simulation results of the proposed methods are compared with those of the state-of-the-art to demonstrate the calculation speed improvement of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle Aggregators Participating in Demand Response Pricing Strategy and Benefit Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the pricing strategy and benefit distribution of electric vehicle aggregator (EVA) participating in demand response (DR). By combining the market policy, aiming at the vehicle to grid (V2G) charging scenario, balancing the load variance and user cost, and taking the maximum social benefit as the optimization goal, this paper studies the demand response potential of electric vehicles, obtains the demand response price of electric vehicles by establishing the price negotiation function model, and analyzes the cluster benefits of electric vehicles participating in demand response. Based on the model above, the income distribution strategy of demand response based on Shapley value is adopted to realize the reasonable distribution of cost and benefit. Finally, through simulation analysis, it is verified that the participation of electric vehicles in demand response can effectively improve the social benefit, providing guidance for the promotion of V2G.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Radio Energy Transmission System Based on Magnetic Coupling Resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: At present, most of the sensors in switchgear and monitoring systems are powered by battery. Because the battery is limited, it will affect the continuous operation of the sensor, and often unplugging the battery will also bring security risks. Therefore, it is necessary to study the wireless power supply technology according to the power supply mode of the sensor. Based on Multisim circuit system simulation platform and ANSYS Maxwell electromagnetic field simulation software, a radio energy transmission system based on magnetically coupled resonance technology is designed in this paper. In the scheme, the circuit system and the transmitting electromagnetic coil are designed respectively, the parameter configuration method of the designed system is described, and the series compensation structure is adopted. The simulation results show that the system can realize the infinite energy transmission of 150mm distance, and the output voltage is stable between 3.5V-5V, which meets the power supply needs of sensors in the switchgear. This provides a useful reference for the power supply mode of the sensor and the configuration method of the radio energy transmission system.

articleTitle: Research on Power Consumption Prediction of Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the explosive development of electric vehicles, the demand for charging facilities has increased significantly, which has become a key factor affecting the planning of power grid construction. In view of the charging station number is larger, the overall amount of data is bigger, and a single station data dimension is low, the data quantity is little, study is less, the traditional methods can’t be applied, this paper has carried out the charging power prediction model based on deep learning research, to provide technical support for the new charging station planning.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Multiple Load Aggregators with Considering Satisfaction Index
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Acting as an agent of decentralized users, load aggregator (LA) plays an important role in the microgrid (MG) interaction, how to economically and rationally dispatch its aggregated resources is a critical issue. This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization model that considers both the economics of MG and the satisfaction of LAs. Further, the uncertainty of photovoltaic output is considered in this paper, and we apply scenario-based stochastic programming and conditional value at risk to quantity the uncertainty as well as averse some risks. Finally, a numerical simulation is performed in a three-node MG, the results show that the model proposed can make optimal dispatch under uncertain conditions and obtain the maximum benefit of MG while reducing the changes of electricity consumption habits in LAs.

articleTitle: Fault Characterization and Simulation of High Frequency Voltage-Based Highway Multi-energy Complementary System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to realize the national "Double Carbon" strategy, the integration of energy and transportation is an important technical approach, so there is an urgent need to build a highway multi-energy complementary system for energy supply, load and energy storage equipment. In the highway multi-energy complementary system, the interconnection topology of distributed energy sources will cause the electromagnetic transient characteristics to change when the system fails. In order to investigate the electromagnetic transient characteristics, a mathematical model of power electronic transformer (PET) at all levels is established in this paper, taking the highway multi-energy complementary system as the research object. In the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation environment, a simulation model of the highway multi-energy complementary system is built based on the PET output stage with power outer loop and voltage current inner loop control strategy, and the electromagnetic transient characteristics of the system under single fault and fault coupling are investigated when the PV generator set and the grid are in accident. The results of bus voltage, current, etc. from the simulation can provide some basis for the selection and structure optimization of the relevant parameters of the components in the subsequent PET.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Integration Driven Charging Scheme for Electric Vehicle Based Large Scale Delivery System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Facing a carbon neutrality future, it becomes more and more important to combine the operation of the transportation system with the power system to enhance the capability of integrating renewable energy. In this paper, we focus on the renewable energy integration driven charging scheme for an electric vehicle based large scale delivery system. To cooperatively manage the electric vehicles in the delivery system with stochastic demands, we proposed a deep reinforcement learning based vehicle scheduling method, especially scheduling the vehicles to get recharged with renewable energy. We use the real-world data to model the delivery system with dynamic demands and conduct experiments to explore the load shift potential of the vehicles under the navigation of renewable energy prices. The experiment results show that the proposed method can effectively optimize the scheduling decisions of the vehicles and improve renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: Power Generation Planning Optimization Model Considering Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to its significance over climate change mitigation, most countries have taken into consideration carbon neutrality and decarbonization while making policies. This paper presents an optimization model for power generation planning considering carbon emission constraints. Then a virtual power system that consists of five regional power systems is established to verify the proposed model. The simulation results show that the proposed method can efficiently obtain the optimal power generation plan and provide the estimation of carbon emission of the studied power system.

articleTitle: Prevention Strategy for Subsequent Commutation Failure in LCC-HVDC System under Unbalanced Faults
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: AC faults are the primary cause of Commutation Failure (CF) in LCC-HVDC system. CF can be divided into First Commutation Failure (FCF) and Subsequent Commutation Failure (SCF). The occurrence of the FCF is inevitable if the voltage-drop exceeds the threshold value; however, sometimes it will be followed by SCFs, due to improper control actions. In this paper, a novel strategy is proposed to prevent the occurrence of SCFs, by considering the different inconsistences that occur on the system. Compared with earlier methods, this strategy is more effective in controlling the system, in case of different transients, since the amount of the total phase shift that might occur is considered. By employing this method, the system can be controlled effectively in case of different faults, and SCFs can be prevented. A mathematical model based on sequence components is developed to describe the system, to capture the total amount of phase shift, that occur in the system. Finally, simulation results based on CIGRE benchmark model built in PSCAD/EMTDC are used to verify the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Electricity Dispatch for Base Stations with Battery Storage System: A Case Study in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of newer communication technology, considering the higher electricity consumption and denser physical distribution, the base stations become important commercial load of the power system. Therefore, the electricity consumption analysis and optimization approaches of base stations become meaningful. Referring to the pilot configuration of battery storage system with large capacity in the base stations, the battery storage system can be utilized to schedule the base station’s electricity consumption to minimize total operational cost of base stations. In this paper, the optimal electricity dispatch strategy for base stations with battery storage system is proposed. Firstly, on basis of the linear relationship between the communication load rate and the base station’s electric load, the electric load prediction model of base station considering dynamic communication load rate is formulated. Then, considering the time of use electricity price scenario, the optimal electricity dispatch model for base stations with battery storage system is developed to minimize the total operation cost of the base station. Finally, case studies demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: A Bi-level Transmission Expansion Planning Method Considering Financial Transmission Rights
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the presence of high penetrated renewable energy, an optimal transmission network investment framework requires to comprehensively consider the income of multi-type transmission right of market entities. In this paper, a bi-level model for transmission expansion planning (TEP) considering financial transmission right (FTR) trading is established, while a comprehensive evaluation index for TEP scheme is proposed. The upper-level model includes the step of TEP decisions while lower level model consider the daily market clear scheme and operation scheme. TEP is decided according to two criteria: evaluation indexes and the investment cost. Both the energy trading and FTR trading are taken into account to calculate the economic revenue of the market entities. A modified IEEE 14-bus system is tested. The simulation results show that the proposed bi-level TEP framework helps to promote the consumption of renewable energy, reduce power grid congestion, and ensure the fairness of market participation of market entities.

articleTitle: Restoration Optimization Method of Fault Repair Path in Distribution Network under Extreme Events
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: After the disaster, the power supply company should first consider to complete the repair of distribution network fault quickly and with high quality, and then restore the power supply. Because the distribution network fault lines are often randomly distributed and cannot be accurately predicted, the line repair part needs to plan the repair route according to the real-time situation. At this time, how to choose the path to repair the fault and repair the damaged line as soon as possible has become a problem to be solved by the line maintenance personnel. At present, there are few studies on fault path optimization of distribution network. Considering the limited repair resources, this paper realizes the optimization of fault repair path by establishing the optimization model of fault repair path in distribution network.

articleTitle: Electrical Vehicle Charging Scheduling and Routing Mechanism in Interdependent Power and Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the booming trend in deployments of transportation electrification, the interdependent relationship across power distribution and transportation networks has become a crucial element in recent years. Therefore, analyzing the planning and operation of tightly coupled power and transportation networks is imperative. This article proposes an optimal charging scheduling and routing mechanism for electrical vehicles bi-directional charging infrastructure. The optimization approach mixed-integer linear program (MILP) is utilized to relax the highly congested interdependent networks constraints. Furthermore, Monte Carlo simulation is adopted to maximize overall operating revenue considering charging schedule, routing planning, alleviating traffic congestion, and state of charge constraints. The case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed study.

articleTitle: Strategic Day-ahead Market Participation Considering Financial Transmission Right Position
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the deepening of the marketization of the power industry and the unique attributes of electric power commodities, the settlement price of power transactions often has strong randomness and volatility. At different stages of market transactions, the difference in clearing prices will bring mutual arbitrage opportunities in multiple trading markets. In interrelated markets, participants can take advantage of trading opportunities in different markets to affect the system clearing price to obtain profits. Financial transmission rights and virtual bidding are part of financial derivatives. Due to the interaction between virtual bidding and other economic factors, market participants can arbitrage using the expected price difference between day-ahead and real-time prices. Different virtual bids are placed for the purchased financial transmission rights to maximize the total expected revenue. This paper establishes a three-stage model by considering the dual conditions, the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, and the big-M method of the electric power market. Finally, the effectiveness is verified by simulation of a six-node power system.

articleTitle: A Sensitive Fault Detection Method for AC-DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Intelligent Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a sensitive fault detection method for AC-DC hybrid distribution networks, effectively improving fault detection ability and adapting to complex fault characteristics. First, a comprehensive fault feature is proposed to realize the fusion of multi-dimensional faults, which has the ability of strong fault representation and generalization. Secondly, the intelligent learning algorithm is used to train the fault detection model by a large amount of fault data, and a highly sensitive fault detection model is obtained. Then, a comprehensive fault detection scheme is given to distinguish the occurrence and type of AC-DC hybrid distribution network faults. Finally, a large amount of fault data with generalization ability is obtained based on PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method achieves sensitive and accurate fault detection, can effectively adapt to changes in fault location and fault resistance, and has a strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: A Unified Energy Flow Analysis in Integrated Energy System Considering State Variables of Energy Hub
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the complexity of energy types and coupling relationships in the integrated energy system, the calculation of energy flow becomes more complicated and requires more convenient analysis methods. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a unified energy flow algorithm for integrated energy system. The algorithm abstracts the common coupling equipment between various energy as an energy hub (EH), and constructs the EH state variable column vector to participate in the iterative calculation of the unified energy flow of electricity, heat, natural gas systems. In order to consider the coupling relationship between multiple energy flows, hydrogen is also added to the EH model as a load in this paper. Finally, it is verified on the improved IEEE39-NGS20-HEAT5 example, which proves the feasibility of the algorithm. The results show that the algorithm can improve the convergence and reduce the computational burden.

articleTitle: A Least Square Reduced-Order Analysis and Risk Assessment of Frequency Regulation in Renewable Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the lack of universality and accuracy in the quantitative analysis of renewable power system frequency based on the traditional system aggregation equivalence method, this paper proposes a quantitative analysis method of system frequency based on parameter optimization which considers the common effect of traditional generator units and renewable energy units in the process of frequency regulation. On this basis, the frequency quantitative analysis and risk assessment of the disturbed system are carried out. An example is constructed in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the rationality and correctness of the proposed equivalent model and risk assessment method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Voltage Control Strategy by Grid-Connected PV Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem that voltage violation at photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected point caused by distributed generation and power electronic equipment, it is possible to fully utilize the reactive power regulation ability of grid-connected PV inverter to provide reactive power support to power grid. For this purpose, an adaptive voltage control strategy is proposed to adapt to voltage over-limit scenarios and changes in PV output. Firstly, the mechanism of voltage over-limit of PV grid-connected point and the regulating ability of PV inverter are analyzed. Aiming at the problem of voltage over-limit, it is divided into two different situations, such as large disturbance of external load and slow fluctuation of PV active power, and respectively proposes voltage control strategies. During voltage control, the voltage control effect is improved by reducing the active power and increasing the reactive power regulation capacity of the PV inverter. The simulation result shows that the proposed strategy can effectively reduce the voltage exceeding the range of grid-connected points.

articleTitle: Power System Forecasting-Aided State Estimation Based on Synchronous Phasor Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a forecasting-aided state estimation (FASE) method based on Vector Autoregression (VAR) for power system prediction is proposed, which makes full use of the time correlation of dynamic power systems and the space correlation based on physical constraints of massive synchronous phasor measurement data. The real-time states of power systems can be accurately estimated by the proposed method. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed VAR-FASE method are verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of DC Magnetic Bias Induced by Rail Transit Stray Current on Harmonic Characteristics of Transformer Neutral Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reveal the influence of DC magnetic bias induced by urban rail transit stray current on the harmonic characteristics of transformer neutral current, this paper first analyzes the measured data of shenzhen power grid neutral current, and summarizes the relationship between the measured neutral current characteristics, harmonic content of neutral current, noise level and low frequency component. The transient variation process of DC component of flux linkage under DC magnetic bias is analyzed with flux voltage integral formula. Based on the transformer parameters of a 220kV transformer substation in Shenzhen, a simulation model was established in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the influence of stray current on transformer harmonic characteristics was verified through the simulation of low-frequency sinusoidal current input at the neutral point. The results show that when the positive and negative alternating low frequency stray current acts, the reverse stray current plays a demagnetization role, which reduces the level of dc magnetic bias. The influence of amplitude and frequency factors on the degree of DC magnetic bias caused by positive and negative alternating low frequency stray current is illustrated. The research results reveal the source and influence factors of neutral-point current harmonics in field operation, and provide a basis for studying the influence of harmonics caused by stray current in rail transit on relay protection.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Stability Assessment Method for MMC-MVDC System With High Penetration PV Based on Hybrid Impedance Stability Criterion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Medium-voltage direct current (MVDC) systems are increasingly used for renewable energy sources (RESs) integration and transmission with rapid improvements in power electronic technologies. However, some instability issues may arise due to the dynamic interactions among RESs, converters, and ac grid. This paper proposes a framework of small-signal modeling and stability assessment methods for MMC-MVDC systems with high penetration photovoltaics (PVs). First, a systematic hybrid impedance modeling method for MMC-MVDC system is developed. Then, based on the established model, a hybrid impedance criterion is proposed to evaluate the stability of MMC-MVDC system. And the stability properties of MMC-MVDC are investigated via generalized Nyquist plots. Finally, the time-domain simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed small-signal stability assessment method based on the hybrid impedance stability criterion.

articleTitle: Integrated Power Quality Regionalization Control Method Based on Improved Gray Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a comprehensive regionalization control method based on improved gray relational analysis (IGRA) was proposed to the superimposed power quality control for power system. With isometric important feature sequences preprocessed from the original data, the importance of the information content provided by each power quality indicator was quantified by entropy weight method. Combined the weight and dimensionless time series data, weighted summation method is used to generate the comprehensive sequence of each node. As an important parameter, the similarity of variation trend and numerical distance between reference sequence and comparative sequence is applied to IGRA algorithm to generate the gray relational coefficient which is used to figure out correlation degree for comprehensive data between two nodes. A regionalization strategy according to the correlation degree was defined to figure out the regionalization results and master nodes by hierarchical clustering method. With the proposed method, the regionalization results can be more accurate and reasonable. Then the power quality in each region can be improved by power quality control of the master nodes. Meanwhile, the power quality control device can be saved. The standard IEEE 14 bus system simulation was constructed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Simulation of Noise Level Estimation for Energy Internet Load Data Prediction by Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to estimate the raw data (without noise) from the noisy data, we had proposed an ANN algorithm for simulating the relationships between history noisy data and corresponding raw data, which further made the noise level estimation. As the previous study was not detailed simulated, here we intensively re-estimate the algorithm’s performance with different parameter set combinations, and get useful conclusions, which can help the application of the ANN algorithm in different situations. As preliminary research, we also proposed the future research directions, which may promote the performance of the algorithm to a further higher level.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Time-sharing Optimal Scheduling for Community Integrated Energy System Based on Multi-energy Time-series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Community integrated energy system (CIES) can give full play to the comprehensive advantages of multiple heterogeneous energy, and provide reliable and economical energy supply for users in the community by coordinating various energy equipment. However, in existing research, the scheduling plan of CIES is not arranged according to characteristics of equipment itself. Based on this consideration, this paper proposes a day-ahead optimal scheduling method for CIES based on multi-energy time-series analysis. First, unified scheduling model of CIES is established. Then, the complexity of the multi-energy time-series in CIES is analyzed based on fuzzy entropy, and the scheduling period is further divided according to the response speed of various energy equipment. Next, a day-ahead time-sharing optimal scheduling method for CIES is proposed. Finally, a case study is used to demonstrate the scheduling model, and simulation results show that the proposed method allows for efficient use of various equipment at a relatively small additional cost.

articleTitle: Profits Comparison for Wind Power Incurred by Different Market Participation Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power has undergone rapid development in China. Currently, wind power is gradually regarded as a regular generation source to participate in the electricity market. However, in the current Chinese electricity market, wind power has not fully participated in the market competition. For wind power producers (WPPs), the government subsidies and marketization coexist. Besides, the uncertain nature of wind power will result in revenue losses to WPPs due to the deviation penalty policy (DPP). This paper explores the profits difference caused by various market participation methods and DPP. The settlement process for WPP under different market participation methods and deviation mechanism is modeled, which is built based on day-ahead and real-time two-stages market. An illustrative example is proposed to analyze the best market participation method under various market situations.

articleTitle: Load Probability Prediction Method Considering Parameter Optimization of Improved Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of technologies such as electric vehicles and the increase in the penetration rate of distributed power sources, the randomness and uncertainty of grid loads are gradually increasing. Using effective methods to accurately predict power load can improve the efficiency of power system planning. Hence, this paper proposes a load probability prediction method considering the parameter optimization of improved extreme learning machine (ELM). Firstly, the historical power load data set is collected and preprocessing such as correlation analysis and data elimination is performed. The processed historical data is used as the input dataset for the ELM model. Secondly, the genetic algorithm (GA) is used to optimize and improve the input weight and bias of the ELM model. The quantile regression optimization is used to improve the output weight of the ELM model. According to the calculation result of individual fitness as the termination condition of GA iteration, the improved ELM model parameters are generated, and the load power prediction interval is calculated according to the optimized model. Finally, the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is verified by case studies calculation based on the historical load power data.

articleTitle: Charging Station Planning Considering Pressure Energy Utilization of Natural Gas Pipe Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As an important clean energy source to reduce carbon emissions, the demand for natural gas is increasing day by day. Abundant pressure energy is contained in the natural gas pipe network, but it is wasted in the traditional natural gas pressure regulation process, which is contrary to the theme of low-carbon environmental protection. Fortunately, natural gas pressure power generation technology is maturing. The number of electric vehicles (EV) with mobility and energy storage features is growing. Therefore, thanks to the combination of EV and natural gas pressure, the energy waste dilemma has turned a corner. In this paper, exergy analysis was used to evaluate the power generation capacity of gas pressure energy. Then, the Monte Carlo method is used to establish the charging load of the charging station. In addition, one-time construction cost and long-term operation cost of charging station are taken as comprehensive cost, and the planning model for charging station is established to minimize comprehensive cost. Finally, an example is introduced to verify the proposed planning scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme has a high absorption capacity of natural gas pressure.

Author Keywords: pressure energy of natural gas pipe network

articleTitle: Optimization Operation Method of Multiple Energy Chambers for Efficient Use of Energy in Partitioned Miniaturized Park
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For integrated energy efficiency of miniaturized park is low, the energy complementarity between regions is poor, and the traditional centralized energy supply system can't satisfy with the characteristics of the miniaturized park. In this paper, combining multiple energy chambers flexibly to realize overall coordination of regional energy supply is studied and a multi-objective partitioned optimization operation method of miniaturized park based on epsilon constraint method is proposed. Firstly, the partitioned framework of the miniaturized park is given. Then, the mathematical models of energy production and conversion equipment in the energy chamber are built, aiming at minimizing operating costs and maximizing exergy efficiency. The Pareto front is constructed by using epsilon constraint method, and the optimal operation scheme is determined by fuzzy decision-making. Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed model and scheme is verified by example simulation.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Influence of Wildfires on the Insulation Characteristics of 35kV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, transmission lines have been affected by wildfires and tripping frequently, which has seriously affected the safe and stable operation of the transmission network. In this paper, an experimental research platform was designed and built on the impact of wildfire on the safe operation of 35kV transmission lines, a flame-affected gas gap breakdown voltage test was designed and built, a simulated mountain fire was lit by using a wooden stack fire, the characteristics of the three-phase voltage of the transmission line, the leakage current of the wire to the ground, and the opening triangular voltage change characteristics of the transmission line under the conditions of the mountain fire were studied, the effect of the flame on the breakdown voltage was studied, and the effect of flame temperature, flame height, plasma, etc. on the insulation of the 35kV transmission line was studied. Experimental results show that wildfires can cause single-phase grounding and phase-to-phase short circuits of transmission lines, and single-phase grounding and phase-to-phase short circuits are the result of the combined action of temperature and flame, of which temperature and flame are the main factors causing breakdown. The phenomenon that the transmission line discharges the flame and the voltage of a certain phase affected by the flame is significantly lower than that of other phases during the test process is studied, and the reasons and laws of the influence of the wildfire on the 35kV transmission line are obtained. This paper provides a reference for the follow-up study of the fault mechanism of 35 kV transmission lines caused by wildfires and the proposed corresponding protection measures.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Modular ALK Electrolyzers Paired with Renewable Energy Generation Based on Time-Sequential Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In accelerating the global energy transition, China has proposed to build a high-renewable (RE) power system (innovative power system). However, the large-scale integration of wind and solar power with volatility and randomness will challenge safe and stable operation of the power system. Building a renewable energy-based electric-hydrogen integral system with electrolytic hydrogen production can effectively solve those problems. Alkaline (ALK) electrolyzer is currently the only equipment for large scale hydrogen production considering technology costs, capacity constraints, commercialization and other aspects. This paper puts forward an optimal allocation model for the electric-hydrogen integral system based on time-sequential simulation for RE power plants with ALK to maximize revenue. The model considers the characteristics of annual RE output, ALK start-stop, ALK output constraints and real-time bulk grid tariffs. As an example of an actual RE power plant of China, the model optimizes ALK installed capacity under local RE installation and tariff policy. The performed simulation proves the rationality and correctness of theoretical analysis for the time-sequential simulation model, which can provide essential guidance in planning an electric-hydrogen integrated system.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation and Influencing Factors of Consumption Capacity of Distributed New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution network is an important part of modern power grid, the "last kilometer" connecting thousands of households, and the main battlefield of distributed new energy access and consumption. With the construction of new power system, the access of large-scale distributed generation to distribution network will become more and more obvious. Important changes have taken place in the structural form and functional positioning of distribution network. Traditional planning methods are difficult to meet the planning requirements of high permeability new energy distribution network. Clarifying the key factors affecting the consumption capacity of distributed generation in distribution network, and improving the consumption capacity of distributed generation has become a current research hotspot. Through the evaluation of the influencing factors of regional new energy consumption capacity, and based on the index constraints of thermal stability check, voltage deviation, short-circuit current, system network loss and three-phase imbalance, this paper calculates the sensitivity of different influencing factors. Through the analysis, it is found that the voltage level has the greatest impact, followed by the new energy parallel network and access mode and low-voltage three-phase imbalance, and the power quality has the least impact.

articleTitle: Distributed Secondary Control for Microgrids with Damping Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, consensus-based methods have been widely adopted in AC microgrids. However, the recent growing penetration of unpredictable renewable energy sources (RESs) degrades the operation performance of microgrids, leading the systems easy to suffer instant overshoots under disturbances. To overcome this problem, this paper presents a novel distributed secondary control method with damping compensation for AC microgrids.
