To achieve the equivalent damping compensation, an additional feedback control loop item is designed in the proposed algorithm based on the dynamic model of DGs. Thus, the proposed method can address the rapid frequency/voltage consensus control while avoiding unexpected overshoots against uncertainties. The Lyapunov analysis proves the stability and feasibility of the proposed algorithm. Finally, several studies cases verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Chance-constrained Optimization Model for Distribution Networks Management Considering Source-Network-Load-Storage Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integration of massive DG and various loads brings new opportunities and challenges to distribution networks (DNs). Considering source-network-load-storage interaction, a multi-objective chance-constrained optimization model for DNs management is proposed in this paper, which is supposed to support "carbon neutral" in DN level. Firstly, management model considering energy storage system (ESS) and demand response (DR) technology is proposed, and chance constraints derived from power and energy balance are formulated to address the power fluctuations of DG and load. Secondly, the proposed multi-objective problem for minimizing exchange energy and management budget is transformed by ɛ-constraint method and chance constraints are reformulated by quantiles of probability distributions. A real distribution network in eastern China is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Every point on the obtained Pareto frontier represents a scheme of DR dispatch and ESS allocation, which are optional for DSO.

articleTitle: Analysis and Control of LC-Type Single Active Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, LC-Type Single Active Bridge (LC-SAB) converter is proposed in order to improve the voltage gain and adjustment range of Single Active Bridge (SAB) converter. This converter is formed by adding auxiliary capacitance on the basis of SAB converter. It can be applied to the highway transportation system with renewable energy access such as photovoltaic and wind power. The working principle and soft-switching range of this topology are analyzed in detail, the voltage gain expressions of SAB and LC-SAB converter are deduced, and their voltage gains are compared. In addition, a hybrid control based on LC-SAB converter is proposed. The control method adjusts the switching frequency and phase shift angle at the same time, realizes soft-switching and reduces the range of frequency. Finally, the feasibility of the control method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Distributed Unbalanced Power Sharing with Voltage Distortion Suppression for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale access of distributed generation in the distribution network, operation control of the distribution network faces new challenges. Unbalanced distortion has emerged as one of the critical power quality problems for the distribution network, which has escalated especially due to the high application of unbalanced loads. This paper first quantitatively analyzes the relationship between the sharing of negative current and sensitive node VUF suppression and proposes a distributed control strategy that can share unbalanced power among VCM and CCM inverters accurately and suppress sensitive node VUF effectively. The strategy does not need to know the line parameters and is robust to load changes. Finally, the proposed method is verified through the simulation results based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Operational Risk Indicators of Power System towards Carbon Neutrality
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of carbon neutrality, the proportion of new energy connected to the power system has been increasing. In Northwest China and other regions, new energy is transmitted to the load centers through long-distance DC transmission and short-distance AC transmission simultaneously. The uncertainty of new energy and AC-DC hybrid system leads to a sharp increase in operational risk of power system. Firstly, based on the existing conventional operational risk indicators, the operational risk indicators reflecting the characteristics of new energy integration and AC-DC hybrid transmission are added; Secondly, based on the probability model of new energy power fluctuation, three state probability model of DC system and probability model of AC operation state, the probabilistic operational risk indicators are formed; Finally, through the operational risk assessment of the improved IEEE-RTS79 bus system, the effectiveness of the proposed probabilistic operational risk indicators is verified.

articleTitle: The Depression of Noises in Acoustic Signals of Transformer Based on Adversarial Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Acoustic signals produced by an operated transformer are the important parameters for the assessment of noise level of substation and condition monitoring of transformer. When acoustic signals of transformer transmit in the air, some interference components are inevitably contained in the measured acoustic signals by microphone sensors with the features of diversity and a certain degree of uncertainty. To obtain the real acoustic signals resulting from the transformer, the adversarial convolutional de-noising auto-coder (CDAE) network is proposed and trained to carefully depress the interference components of acoustic signals in an end-to-end manner. The similarity of power spectrum (SPS) is defined to evaluate the de-noising effects of the proposed method. The acoustic signals for an operated transformer in a substation are measured to build the data set. The calculated results have shown that the adversarial CDAE network is capable of eliminating the interference components contained in acoustic signals of transformer with better generalization ability and high accuracy.

articleTitle: A Decomposition Method of Electricity Quantity Based on Typical Load Curve Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the settlement process of electricity spot market, it is crucial to obtain the real-time power of users. This paper designs a method to obtain the typical load curve of the users without smart meters in the spot market and then proposes a power decomposition strategy to determine the Time-of-Use consuming quantity of these users. Firstly, users are classified according to their industry characteristics, this paper assumes that the same type users will have similar daily load curve. Then, the history load data of the users with smart meters is collected, and the typical load curve is determined by an improved clustering algorithm based on these history data. Lastly, the Time-of-Use consuming quantity of the users without smart meters can be determined according to the typical load curve. In addition, an improved load curve clustering algorithm based on FCM is proposed, the improved XB clustering validity index is introduced to judge the effect of the clustering results. The actual power load data of Fujian province are used for case study, results verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-connected Control of Inverter Based on First Order ADRC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Single-phase grid-connected inverters are widely used in residential photovoltaic grid-connected scenarios and there are load switching and environmental disturbances in the grid-connected site at the same time. These complex time-varying disturbance models are difficult to determine. The disturbance compensation method has limited effect, and since the LC filter is of fractional order, the integer order cannot accurately describe the model. In order to solve the above problems, this paper firstly designs a fractional-order PID (FOPID) current inner loop controller based on the LC single-phase grid-connected inverter to make the model more accurate. Secondly, the first-order active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) is designed basis on the fractional-order model. Analyzing the steady-state and dynamic performance of the system in detail. Finally, a simulation platform was built in MATLAB/Simulink. The results show that the designed first-order ADRC strategy can effectively improve the quality of the grid current, the dynamic and steady-state performance of the system are also improved. At the same time, the designed control strategy algorithm is simple and easy to implement, and has high engineering applying value.

articleTitle: A Data Driven Optimization for Multi-energy Adaptive Scheduling in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper deals with energy management in a microgrid dedicated to the power consumption in highway. A data driven optimization method, INNGA, is applied to self-consistent energy scheduling. The goal of optimization is to find the best ratio of consumption of each type energy over time. Meanwhile, the adaptive scheduling performed in INNGA will use as much renewable energy as possible to reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Predictive Current Control of Single-Phase H-bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Single-phase H-bridge converter has the advantages, such as lower power device voltage stress, fewer passive components, and variable output voltage polarity. Single-phase Hbridge converter has been applied in many applications with a wide input voltage range, and it has strong demand background and the value of promotion and application. Predictive current control (PCC) of a single-phase H-bridge converter has the fastest dynamic response when tracking the reference current, but the control delay will cause a steady-state error in the inductor current. To better control the inductor current of a single-phase H-bridge converter, this paper proposes to use the mathematical model of the converter to minimize the error of the predicted current and the reference current, so that the converter has a faster response speed and a smaller current overshoot, the stability of the single-phase H-bridge converter is guaranteed. At the same time, a state observer is proposed to improve the estimation of the inductor current in control delay compensation. The research results show that PCC has a good control effect in a single-phase H-bridge converter.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Generation Scheduling Scheme for High—Renewable Penetrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning has shown significant progress in complex sequential decision-making tasks. Due to the uncertainty of the power system and the volatility of new energy sources, conventional scheduling methods may lose their effectiveness. This paper proposes an approach for solving the high-renewable penetrated power system scheduling problem by Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm. Since the action in the method is constrained within a certain range, the convergence of the algorithm is better. The IEEE 30-bus system is used to verify the method and compared with the Deep Q-learning (DQN) , Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms, the results show that the method in this paper has better results in dealing with continuous action space problems.

articleTitle: Single-Ended Fault Location Algorithm Based on Initial Reverse Polarity Travelling Wave Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a new single-ended travelling wave fault location algorithm, which is based on the initial reverse polarity travelling wave (RPTW) detection and comprehensively utilizes both positive and negative polarity initial travelling wave. Similarly, the initial reverse polarity travelling wave also has an important utility. Researches show that the RPTW detection suffers relatively little interference and has high detection reliability, and the forming time has a specific piecewise linear relationship with the fault location. Analyze the characteristics of the initial RPTW of the "third-first type" bus (the local end of the measuring end is the third type bus, and the opposite end is the first type bus) and identify the forming time. Combining the initial fault travelling wave could effectively determine the line section of the fault point, the nature of the second wave head and the fault location of the bus type, and construct a stable and reliable single-ended travelling wave location algorithm to determine the precise fault location. This algorithm utilizes the initial forward and reverse polarity travelling wave heads, and the detection reliability is relatively high. Simulation results show that the algorithm could effectively determine the fault location and significantly improve the adaptability and accuracy of single-ended travelling wave fault location.

articleTitle: Probability Estimation of Distributed Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on KMC-optimized Copula
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Because of the natural randomness of solar energy and the unique property of distributed photovoltaic (DPV), the uncertainty of its output affects the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. DPV power probability prediction can provide more comprehensive prediction information, and it is one of the most important measures to solve the problem of large-scale DPV integration. Therefore, a DPV probability prediction algorithm based on k-means clustering(KMC)-optimized Copula is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the weather types are classified by the clustering method. Then, according to the characteristics of each weather attribute, the optimal representative weight of the Copula function is constructed via Genetic Algorithm (GA), and the KMC-optimized Copula algorithm is proposed to quantify the dynamic power space correlation between concentrated photovoltaic (CPV) and DPV. Finally, the DPV prediction value is dynamically expressed by the CPV power in the coming prediction duration, and the conditional prediction probability estimation of the DPV power is obtained. The case study shows that the proposed KMC-optimized Copula Model is of great importance for distributed power predictionand compared with the normal Copula model, the model performances of point prediction and probability prediction are both improved under different weather types.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization for the Operation of Distribution System with Constraints of Regional Power Exchange
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In case of outages in main grid, the resilience of distribution network (DS) can be improved by forming microgrid. However, When DS is in island operation mode, tie-line power between DS and microgrid is required to be controlled to reduce the impact on regional power exchange. Furthermore, ignoring the possible prediction error of the output of the distributed generations (DGs) may lead to much power exchange between DS and microgrid, which make microgrid unable to form. To address the above shortcomings, this paper proposes a robust optimization model to consider the uncertainty of DGs output while restricting the regional power exchange prior to the extreme events. Firstly, the output of WT is modeled by the uncertainty sets. Next, a two-layer robust optimization model is formed to schedule the structure of DS and the output of the DGs. Finally, the two-layer model with uncertain variables is transformed into a single-layer mixed integer programming model with only deterministic variables. Solver CPLEX is utilized to solve the proposed model. With such robust optimization, the proposed model can optimally specify the cut-off lines to safely form the microgrid before extreme events occur while considering the uncertainties of the WT. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated with the modified IEEE 33-node distribution test system.

articleTitle: Distributed Generation Using Buck Converters Based on Consensus Control in DC Microgrid Integrations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Traditional centralized control relies heavily on the communication network, and therefore, a single subsystem communication failure could cause the entire microgrid down. Consensus control eliminates the need for the central controller, which is more cost-effective. In addition, because of distributed communication, the microgrid can continue to function correctly even if there are brief communication disruptions. The methodology proposed in this paper is based on consensus control and deployed with multi-agent systems. The entire system could supply the same stable output current according to the different levels of generation. To establish consensus control of the whole microgrid, information exchange in neighbor mechanisms has been designed separately for local control. In addition, the stability and robustness of the entire system will be assessed with load variations at a specific time. Each agent will adjust its duty cycle in real-time based on the information of neighbors, leading to a system-wide consensus. The proposed strategy is emerging as an attractive technology option to promote the use of DG and manage demand loads.

articleTitle: Real-time Decision Making for Power System via Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of intermittent renewable energy sources, modern power systems are facing significant uncertainties as well as voltage deviations. In order to respond quickly to power fluctuations and contingencies such as transmission line tripping due to faults, real-time optimal grid control is required. A real-time alternating current (AC) optimal power flow (OPF) method through deep reinforcement learning (DRL) combined with imitation learning (IL) in continuous action space is proposed in this paper. A Markov decision process (MDP) is constructed to describe the real-time AC OPF problem. This proposed method is tested on the IEEE 30-bus system and the results show the significant potential for the optimal online control for power systems compared with the state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: Risk-Based Power System Resilience Assessment Considering the Impacts of Hurricanes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed to assess the power system resilience considering the impacts of hurricanes. Firstly, the transmission line outage model correlated to wind speed is developed. Then, Probability Load Flow (PLF) considering the random outage of lines and the variation of loads is designed, and Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) is used to improve the efficiency of Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) in solving PLF. Moreover, risk indices, including line overloading, node voltage exceeding limit, load shedding and system collapse, are established to assess the resilience of power systems during hurricanes. The method is tested with a modified IEEE 14-bus system, and simulation results indicate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Roof Photovoltaic Development Potential Assessment Based on Deep Learning of Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The exploitable potential of rooftop photovoltaics has become a highly regarded indicator for achieving national dual carbon goals. In this paper, a high-resolution remote sensing image building extraction method based on the DeepLabv3+ semantic segmentation model is proposed, and a set of assessment methods and steps for the development potential of building roof photovoltaics in the detailed planning stage are established. Relying on deep learning methods and datasets, model training, building extraction, and accuracy evaluation are realized. Finally, the extracted building roof data is used to estimate the total area of the roof in the area, calculate the effective utilization area of roof photovoltaic, and comprehensively estimate the installed capacity of regional roof photovoltaic according to the characteristics of photovoltaic modules and construction conditions, and complete the evaluation of photovoltaic development potential. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can extract buildings with F1 score of 89.33%, IoU of 82.18%, which can achieve effective extraction of buildings, and then can achieve accurate calculation of rooftop photovoltaic capacity and complete the evaluation of photovoltaic developable potential.

articleTitle: State Evaluation Method of Smart Substation Secondary Equipment Based on Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: There are often time-consuming and inaccurate problems in the state evaluation of smart substation secondary equipment in the big data environment. For these problems, a state evaluation method of smart substation secondary equipment based on big data mining is proposed. Firstly, the health index (HI) is introduced to reflect the real health status of the equipment; Secondly, the Go method is applied to the network level health index analysis. Based on the secondary equipment health index, the equipment health index is transformed into the probability of successful operation of the equipment; Finally, the experiment shows that when the data set of secondary equipment is 8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> lines, the accuracy of the proposed method is 95.7%, while the accuracy of the comparison method is only 72.3% and 66.8% respectively. Therefore, the performance of the proposed method in improving the accuracy of condition assessment of secondary equipment is obviously better than that of the comparative method.

articleTitle: Peak-valley Time-of-Use Tariff Formulation Method Based on Net Load Curve
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The purpose of peak-valley Time-of-Use (TOU) tariff is to adjust the source and load power of the power system, aiming to alleviate the supply-demand contradiction. As the construction of China’s new power system moves forward, the installed capacity of uncertain power sources, such as wind power and photovoltaic has increased significantly. And also the power system structure has changed greatly, following great changes of manifestation of the supply-demand contradiction. This paper proposes that the time period and concrete price of peak-valley TOU tariff should be reformulated based on the net load curve. Firstly, the existing problems of current peak-valley TOU tariff are pointed out under large-scale cyber new energy, illustrates the fact that the peak or valley period may not correspond to the actual depths of supply-demand contradiction. Secondly, the paper proposed that the peak-valley TOU tariff should be formulated based on the net load curve, due to that reflecting the actual depths of supply- demand contradiction. Thirdly, the effect of user’s response to TOU tariff on output of those adjustable units is analyzed. Finally, the example verifies that the peak-valley TOU tariff formulated based the net load curve can truly reflect the between supply-demand contradiction of power system. It may stimulate users to adjust their consumption behavior, reduce peak-valley differences of other adjustable units operation.

articleTitle: Lightning Stroke Transient Identification Method for HVDC Transmission Line based on DBN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For the transient protection of HVDC transmission lines, the transient interference signal of lightning stroke may cause the protection malfunction. Research on accurate and fast identification methods for lightning transients of HVDC transmission lines is of great significance to improve the reliability of power systems. This paper proposes a lightning stroke transient identification method based on deep belief network (DBN) and wavelet energy moment, using wavelet energy moment theory to extract the characteristics of three transient time-domain waveforms to generate sample sets, building a training unit based on the DBN algorithm to construct the basic reliability assignment of a transient signal identification framework. Finally, the transient signal discrimination result can be obtained through the decision rule. Through the example analysis of building a simulation model in PSCAD, the results show that DBN has a higher recognition accuracy rate than the shallow machine learning algorithms in transient identification, and at the same time verifies that the method has a certain practicability.

articleTitle: The Three-Level NPC Converter Based Energy Router and Its Application in Flexible Distribution Network Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the high penetration rate of distributed renewable energy in the power grid, the traditional radial distribution network is difficult of tackle the multidirectional power flow. As a multi-port converter, the electric energy router (EER) enhance the flexibility of the distribution network and improves the consumption of renewable energy. In this paper, a three-port EER based on the neutral point clamped (NPC) three-level converter is proposed. An energy storage unit is integrated in the EER through the bi-directional DC/DC converter. A hierarchical coordinated control strategy is established to coordinate the power distribution between the energy storage unit and each port converter, so as to stabilize the fluctuation of renewable energy generation and realize the peak shaving and valley filling with energy storage. Matlab/Simulink is used to simulate the multi-port EER and verify its effectiveness. Through comparison under different working conditions, the simulation results prove the proposed circuit and control strategy.

articleTitle: A Simulation System for Fluctuation Stabilization of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to eliminate the inherent volatility of wind power, improve the absorption capacity and stability of power grid for wind power, in this paper, a simulation system for wind power volatility stabilization is designed, This system includes two simulation modules: The first module analyzes the fluctuation of wind power historical data input into the system, and analyzes the historical data in frequency domain by calling the wavelet packet algorithm in the module. After repeated iterative processing, a suitable wavelet packet decomposition layer will be obtained, at which time the data is processed into low-frequency components; Module 2 will analyze the high-order uncertainty of the intermediate frequency component and the high-frequency component. By calling the nonparametric kernel density estimation algorithm in the module to mathematically model the data, the probability density functions of intermediate frequency component and high-frequency components can be obtained. Finally, the hybrid energy storage system is used to stabilize the intermediate frequency component and high frequency component. The simulation system designed in this paper greatly simplifies the data processing process and improves the computational efficiency of wind power volatility research.

articleTitle: A Systematic Muti-level Evaluation Framework and Approach for Electricity Market Operation Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To ensure the safety, efficiency and stability of the electricity market, the market evaluation is of great importance. During the operation of the electricity market, a large amount of data is being generated continuously. Thus, it is necessary to establish a relatively systematic assessment framework of the effectiveness and risk in electricity market based on big data. This paper analyzes the construction method of the assessment index, introduces the theory of the modern comprehensive evaluation method, and constructs the framework to evaluate the electricity market operation with a multi-dimensional time scale and hierarchical regulation system. A case study using actual electricity market data in China is presented. The proposed framework provides a systematic method to evaluate the market efficiency and risks, which can be used as a decision support tool for market regulators to ensure the effective operation of the market.

articleTitle: Optimal Economic Dispatch of Microgrid with Battery Energy Storage Considering High Penetration of Renewable Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The energy storage device of the microgrid plays a crucial role in reducing the peak regulation pressure and strengthening the economic benefit of the microgrid. Under the consideration the volatility of photovoltaic and wind power, an optimization model, involving the maintenance and management costs of each power supply in the operation of the microgrid, is established with the lowest operating cost as the objective. Additionally, the influence of different penetrations of renewable energy on the battery charge and discharge is investigated. Then, an appropriate penetration of renewable energy is selected to explore the impact of batteries in different capacities on the microgrid.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Day-ahead Scheduling of Regional Integrated Energy Systems Considering Energy Sharing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce carbon dioxide emissions, accelerate renewable consumption rates, and improve economic benefits, a multi-objective day-ahead scheduling model of connected multiple regional integrated energy systems considering energy sharing is developed in this paper. Physical and operation constraints of all equipment within the regional integrated energy systems (RIES) are first mathematically established. A multi-objective day-ahead scheduling model is then introduced to simultaneously achieve the minimum cost, the maximum renewable energy consumption rate, and the minimum carbon emissions goals while allowing energy sharing among regions. The developed scheduling method of RIESs with energy sharing is an effective way to achieve carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals and overall benefits in the energy transition path. The developed model is verified through the modified IEEE 30-bus system, and the results show that considering the energy sharing, the power purchase from the grid is reduced, leading to the reduction of the dispatching cost. The PV curtailment rate and carbon emissions are also reduced when energy sharing is considered in view of the multi-objective optimization structure.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Power System Flexibility Based on K-Means Method and Copula Function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Power system flexibility analysis is important for grid development. For solving this problem, this paper constructs a flexible resource model of the power system to analyze the flexibility. The k-means method is adopted to classify the data. The probability models of wind power, PV output and load fluctuation in each scenario are constructed based on the Copula function, and the conditional probability of adjacent moments is solved by the Bayesian formula. Random sampling is performed based on the probability to generate the time series. The system flexibility margin expectation, shortage expectation and shortage probability are considered, and the operational economy is taken into account to establish quantitative assessment indices. The probabilistic optimal power flow (P-OPF) model with flexibility resources is constructed, and Monte Carlo simulation method is used to calculate the values of the assessment indexes. The IEEE RTS-24 system is used as an example to analyze the system flexibility.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Non-Grid-Side-Converter-Based Varibale Frequency Transformer Under Dual-Side Harmonic Distorted Grid Voltages
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Variable frequency transformer (VFT), a new type of flexible alternating current transmission equipment, is easier to operate under dual-side harmonic distorted grid voltages for its windings are directly connected to two power grids. This paper presents a novel topology of non-grid-side-converter-based VFT (NGSC-VFT). Operations of proposed NGSC-VFT under ideal and harmonically polluted grid voltages are detailed. Control strategy for two series converters is proposed to eliminate the torque and power fluctuations at different frequencies. The effectiveness of proposed topology of NGSC-VFT and corresponding control strategy is verified via simulation studies.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Single-phase Incomplete Grounding of 35kV Transmission Line Under Wildfire Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, there have been many forest fire accidents. Mountain fire disasters have a high probability of causing line trips, resulting in power outages, threatening the safe and stable operation of the power system. In order to study the single-phase fault of 35kV transmission lines caused by wildfires, a simulation test platform for wildfire faults of 35kV transmission lines under wildfire conditions was built, and the single-phase fault simulation test of conductors under wildfire conditions was carried out, and the flames were recorded and analyzed. Test waveforms and phenomena for single-phase conductor tests. The test found that when a single-phase-to-ground fault occurs in a transmission line under wildfire conditions, the voltage amplitude of the faulted phase is not always the lowest, and the voltage amplitude of the non-faulted phase will appear to be the lowest voltage. The equivalent circuit model of single-phase incomplete grounding fault of transmission line is established. After calculation and analysis, it is found that when the grounding resistance is within a certain range, the fault phase voltage will not be the lowest phase. The results of this study can provide theoretical support for the study of measures to prevent wildfire accidents.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Optimal Dispatching Strategy of Integrated Energy system on User-side
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Considering the real-data from the power devices and the high penetration of EV in integrated energy system on user-side (IESU), this paper established the optimal model of dispatching strategy by two stages which are the day-ahead and the intraday re-dispatching of IESU respectively. In the former stage, the EV was considered in the way of demand response. In the latter dispatching stage, two time-scale rolling dispatching model based on the speed of response in different energy system is established and the real-time data are used in the re-dispatching. From the results of case study, three important conclusions are drawn by this article. Firstly, the DR model is effective to EV load, which is useful to reduce the total costs especially in the case of high penetration of EV. Secondly, it is necessary to compensate the margin by uncertainty and the proposed intraday re-dispatching method is applied successfully. Lastly, two time-scale rolling dispatching model is useful to deal with the differences of response character of power system and power system.

articleTitle: Effect of Blending Modification on the Mechanical and Dielectric Properties of Polypropylene for Environment-friendly Cable Insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Polypropylene (PP) has the good potential to be used in insulation material of environment-friendly cable due to its high temperature stability and excellent recyclability. However, the high stiffness and brittleness of PP are the main reasons for its restriction of application in cable insulation. Therefore, how to improve the mechanical properties of PP and maintain its excellent thermal and dielectric performances have been research focus in recent years. In this paper, polyolefin elastomer (POE), styrene-ethylene butylene-styrene triblock copolymer (SEBS) and atactic PP (aPP) were introduced into isotactic PP (iPP) by blending with the mass ratio of 2:3, respectively. The mechanical properties of the three iPP-based blends were characterized by tensile test. Then, the dielectric and AC breakdown characteristics were measured respectively. Furthermore, the melting and crystallization processes were characterized by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC). Results demonstrate that the iPP/SEBS blend shows the best mechanical properties with the tensile strength and elongation at break increasing by 48.5% and 273.4% respectively to the iPP. In addition, iPP/SEBS blend has the highest AC breakdown strength of 54.8kV/mm among the three blends, only 5.2% lower than that of iPP. The DSC results reveal that the melting temperature of three blends has no obvious difference, while the crystallinity of iPP/SEBS is slightly higher than that of iPP/POE and iPP/aPP. The improved mechanical properties of iPP/SEBS is mainly due to the effective stress dispersion of SEBS deformation when subjected to external force, and the highest breakdown strength of iPP/SEBS is attributed to the high crystallinity.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Field Coupling Finite Element Modeling of Converter Transformer Core Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Converter transformer is the core equipment of HVDC transmission technology. Its iron core, as an important component of electromagnetic field and vibration, has been paid much attention by researchers. Due to its large size and high cost, its reasonable simulation is one of the keys to carry out the research on the core magnetic field and solid mechanics of converter transformer. In this paper, two iron core models with different structures are established through the finite element simulation platform, and their electromagnetic field, force, loss and modal distribution at the same time are compared and analyzed. The application value of laminated iron core structure in converter transformer simulation is obtained. Through the comparative analysis of magnetic flux density distribution, stress distribution, shape variable and vibration time-domain and frequency-domain signals, it is proved that the electromagnetic field and structural mechanics of the converter transformer before and after the model similarity correspond to the similarity criteria, which comprehensively verifies the correctness of the converter transformer scale model.

articleTitle: Analytical Analysis of DC Current of the Wind-Coal Bundle System after Fault Considering Control System of LCC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Short circuit current is one of the key basis of power grid planning, especially in wind-coal bundle system. DC short-circuit current contributes to AC short-circuit current when AC side of the system fails. And the transient process of DC short-circuit current is caused by the coupling relationship between high voltage ride through problem and commutation failure after the fault, which is quite different from the process of LCC-HVDC system with thermal power unit as the sending end. So it is necessary to analyze the DC current of wind-coal bundle system. This paper first investigates the fault ride through process of the system after fault. Then the paper describes the response process of DC control system, establishes the transfer function models, and compares the simulation results with the mathematical expression of DC current.
